dialogue.murim.social.first.morning.1: Start with a slow set of forms. Check every step.
dialogue.murim.social.first.morning.2: We have time to go through one strike before breakfast.
dialogue.murim.social.first.morning.3: Repeat yesterday’s combination today. I will watch.
dialogue.murim.social.first.morning.4: Lower your shoulders. Now you can begin.
dialogue.murim.social.first.morning.5: The dew makes it slippery. Check your stance.
dialogue.murim.social.first.morning.6: Warm up your wrists before striking at full strength.
dialogue.murim.social.first.evening.1: Repeat the last step before you leave.
dialogue.murim.social.first.evening.2: Put your sword away. Choose one movement to work on tomorrow.
dialogue.murim.social.first.evening.3: Which strike went wrong? Show me slowly.
dialogue.murim.social.first.evening.4: Enough for today. A tired hand spoils your grip.
dialogue.murim.social.first.evening.5: Check your elbow again. Keep it below your shoulder.
dialogue.murim.social.first.evening.6: Will you put out the lamp after practice? I will put the swords away.
dialogue.murim.social.first.night.1: A senior’s word: the mind should rest at night. The sword can wait for dawn.
dialogue.murim.social.first.night.2: Without ceremony: quiet. Tomorrow the disciples will complain about lost sleep again.
dialogue.murim.social.first.night.3: Keep this in mind: if it can wait, come back in the morning.
dialogue.murim.social.first.night.4: Listen carefully: night on the mountain. The watches stay awake; the rest conserve their strength.
dialogue.murim.social.first.night.5: Briefly: night paths are treacherous. Better wait for morning.
dialogue.murim.social.first.night.6: For the record: at night you hear what the day drowns out. Listen, then go to sleep.
dialogue.murim.social.first.ordinary.1: You are %2$s. Which forms are you working on?
dialogue.murim.social.first.ordinary.2: Your standing is %2$s. How is the stance practice going?
dialogue.murim.social.first.ordinary.3: Even as %2$s, keep returning to simple exercises.
dialogue.murim.social.first.ordinary.4: You are %2$s. Let us find you a suitable practice partner.
dialogue.murim.social.first.ordinary.5: You are %2$s. Make sure the juniors can see your feet when you demonstrate a form.
dialogue.murim.social.first.ordinary.6: You are %2$s now. Is there an exercise you want to work through?
dialogue.murim.social.first.weak.1: Your feet are too close together. Set them wider apart.
dialogue.murim.social.first.weak.2: Keep the pace slow with the juniors. Check their accuracy first.
dialogue.murim.social.first.weak.3: Your breathing is uneven. Pause before repeating the form.
dialogue.murim.social.first.weak.4: Your grip has slipped. Adjust it and try again.
dialogue.murim.social.first.weak.5: Keep your balance after the strike. Do not lean too far forward.
dialogue.murim.social.first.weak.6: Repeat the stance without your sword. We will add the arms later.
dialogue.murim.social.first.strong.1: Your strength is convincing. Now show restraint.
dialogue.murim.social.first.strong.2: Your breakthrough deserves a bow. Keep your judgment.
dialogue.murim.social.first.strong.3: The first generation is not blind: you have grown stronger.
dialogue.murim.social.first.strong.4: I yield the way. We should discuss swords without an audience.
dialogue.murim.social.first.strong.5: Strength you have. Now let there be calm too.
dialogue.murim.social.first.strong.6: Real strength is quiet. You are still loud.
dialogue.murim.social.first.equal.1: We are equal in strength. Discipline remains to be seen.
dialogue.murim.social.first.equal.2: Your sword has reached our realm. Let us test the form in practice.
dialogue.murim.social.first.equal.3: The same realm is not the same skill. Ready for a test?
dialogue.murim.social.first.equal.4: Now we compare clean movement, not the amount of qi.
dialogue.murim.social.first.equal.6: I want to see how you take a blow.
dialogue.murim.social.first.lower.1: Start with the first movement. I will show you the rest afterwards.
dialogue.murim.social.first.lower.2: Keep your own pace instead of trying to match mine.
dialogue.murim.social.first.lower.3: I will adjust your stance. Remember where your feet are.
dialogue.murim.social.first.lower.4: Take the sword in both hands. Check your grip.
dialogue.murim.social.first.lower.5: Breathe out as you strike. Keep your shoulders loose.
dialogue.murim.social.first.lower.6: Do not try to copy a difficult form straight away. Practise the basic stance and footwork.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.outsider.1: Do you want to learn? Speak to the Sect Leader about joining first.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.outsider.2: A lesson is in progress here. Walk around the edge of the training ground.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.outsider.3: Put your weapon away. The disciples might take it as a challenge.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.outsider.4: Did you need me, or are you looking for another instructor?
dialogue.murim.social.coach.outsider.5: Use the gate. Keep clear of the fence while the disciples are practising.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.outsider.6: You are out of breath from the climb. Rest, then we can talk.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.punished.1: Finish the assigned work, then we will return to the exercises.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.punished.2: You have been told the terms. Ask again if you have forgotten.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.punished.3: Keep the argument out of the lesson. Resolve the offence first.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.punished.4: I have heard your explanation. Now show me how you will put it right.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.punished.5: Afterwards we will begin with a simple exercise.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.punished.6: Check your work before handing it in. Spare yourself having to redo it.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.review.1: Your timing was good at the review. Repeat that counterstrike.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.review.2: Go through your mistakes with your instructor after the win.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.review.3: Think back to the last exchange. Where was your opponent open?
dialogue.murim.social.coach.review.4: A good bout. Now show me the same step slowly.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.review.5: Keep your wind-up accurate. There is no need to rush it for an audience.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.review.6: Rest after the review. We will go through it later.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.secret.1: A new form? Show it without qi first.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.secret.2: Ease off. I need to see your wrist movement.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.secret.3: Move clear of the others. That technique needs room.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.secret.4: Show me just the opening. Stop there for now.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.secret.5: Check a technique yourself before teaching it to the juniors.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.secret.6: Break the form into steps. Start with the first.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.loot.1: Put down your load. I cannot check your grip with your hands full.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.loot.2: Deliver the supplies, then we will return to the form.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.loot.3: Loosen your shoulders after carrying a heavy load.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.loot.4: Delivered it? Give your arms a rest now.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.loot.5: Take the load to the storeroom. It is in the way here.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.loot.6: Unload that bag before practising your strikes.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.friendly.1: Show me what is giving you trouble. I will take a look.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.friendly.2: We have time to work through one form. Which will it be?
dialogue.murim.social.coach.friendly.3: Good to see you on the training ground. Where shall we start?
dialogue.murim.social.coach.friendly.4: Ask again if you need to. I will show you more slowly.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.friendly.5: I remember our practice session. Repeat that step.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.friendly.6: Show me yourself first. Then I will make corrections.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.morning.1: Start with your stance. Plant your feet firmly.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.morning.2: Loosen your shoulders before the form.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.morning.3: Take a slow step. Keep your feet apart.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.morning.4: Breathe out before striking. Keep your chest relaxed.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.morning.5: The path is slippery. Check your footing before you start.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.morning.6: Take a practice sword. Go slowly through the first set.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.evening.1: You raised your shoulder on the last strike. Start with that tomorrow.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.evening.2: Finish the form and put your sword away.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.evening.3: What gave you trouble today? Show me one movement.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.evening.4: Enough repetitions. Tired legs will lead to mistakes.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.evening.5: Check your grip before you rest. Your wrist should not hurt.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.evening.6: One last set. Slowly, without forcing it.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.night.1: Rest. You will perform the form more accurately after sleep.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.night.2: Keep the sword quiet. People are asleep here.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.night.3: If it is about a form, show me in the morning light.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.night.4: Do not practise difficult combinations alone at night.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.night.5: The path is dark. Put your sword away while you walk.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.night.6: Has your breathing settled? Then go to bed.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.ordinary.1: You are %2$s. Show me which form we should start with.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.ordinary.2: Your standing is recorded as %2$s. Now let us check your grip.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.ordinary.3: Even as %2$s, you can benefit from practising a simple step.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.ordinary.4: You are %2$s now. Choose a movement to work through.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.ordinary.5: You are %2$s. Go slowly when demonstrating a form to the juniors.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.ordinary.6: You are %2$s. You still need to keep your wrist relaxed.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.weak.1: Your stance is unsteady. Set your feet a little wider.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.weak.2: Keep a slight bend in your knees.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.weak.3: Your shoulders are tense. Lower them and try again.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.weak.4: Shorten the wind-up. Work on accuracy first.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.weak.5: You lose your footing after striking. Keep some weight on your rear foot.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.weak.6: Take a break. Then repeat just the first step.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.strong.1: Stronger than the coach? Good. I still see three mistakes.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.strong.2: Your qi has grown. Now learn not to waste it.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.strong.3: Congratulations on the strength. Basic movements still apply.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.strong.4: Pass that strength on to the juniors along with discipline.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.strong.5: Good. Now learn to hold back your qi when it is not needed.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.strong.6: I teach the strong less, but expect more of them.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.equal.1: Your strength matches mine. Let us test your control.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.equal.2: At this realm you start teaching, and keep learning.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.equal.3: Equal qi? Good. Show the form without a wasted step.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.equal.4: I will not yield in discipline. We will test your breathing in practice.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.equal.5: We are equal in strength. Now let us see which of us learns better.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.equal.6: Equal is equal. Show your breathing once more.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.lower.1: Leave the difficult combination for now. Show me the first strike.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.lower.2: Repeat the step without your sword. Find your footing.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.lower.3: Stop watching your feet. Look up at your opponent.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.lower.4: Keep your feet from crossing when you turn.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.lower.5: Breathe evenly. Keep your shoulders down as you inhale.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.lower.6: Repeat the basic stance. We will add the rest later.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.outsider.1: Hear your elder: those seeking strength must climb the mountain on their own feet.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.outsider.2: The council sees this: the head receives visitors. This yard is for practice.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.outsider.3: Remember your duty: we notice a stranger’s sword before learning their name.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.outsider.4: Mount Hua is poor, but does not trade in its name. What is your business?
dialogue.murim.social.elder.outsider.5: Understand one thing: the gate opens to those who knock, not to those who climb the fence.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.outsider.6: An old man says it so: this is no inn, but we do not refuse a traveller a cup of water.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.punished.1: Hear your elder: after punishment, deeds speak. Start with the basics.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.punished.2: The council sees this: the sect remembers an offence, but allows you to mend it.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.punished.3: Remember your duty: a bow does not erase responsibility. Serve your sentence.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.punished.4: I speak seriously: let every movement be cleaner than your excuses.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.punished.5: Understand one thing: the punishment will end, the habits will stay. Make them good ones.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.punished.6: An old man says it so: err once, do not err twice. That is what mending is.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.review.1: Hear your elder: your sword spoke well at the review. Do not let it grow conceited.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.review.2: The council sees this: winning a review begins your work; it does not earn a holiday.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.review.3: Remember your duty: even the kitchen is discussing your last bout.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.review.4: I speak seriously: a fine review. Now try defeating your own laziness.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.review.5: Understand one thing: they still talk of the review. Do not let rumour outrun your stance.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.review.6: An old man says it so: a won review does not excuse you from the line. Tomorrow you stand in the row like everyone.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.secret.1: Hear your elder: that art is not taught in an ordinary formation. Who taught you?
dialogue.murim.social.elder.secret.2: The council sees this: the yard fell silent after that move. Guard that knowledge.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.secret.3: Remember your duty: a powerful art needs judgment, not an audience.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.secret.4: I speak seriously: they are already retelling your technique. Let skill keep ahead of rumour.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.secret.5: Understand one thing: your move is whispered about at the tables. Modesty suits the strong.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.secret.6: An old man says it so: behind such an art stands someone's labour. Remember that.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.loot.1: Hear your elder: the supplies reached the sect. Your sword served everyone today.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.loot.2: The council sees this: what you brought will remain in our merit ledger.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.loot.3: Remember your duty: back with supplies? Good. Do not mistake the sect’s share for your own.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.loot.4: I speak seriously: a full storeroom strengthens Mount Hua as much as a fine strike.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.loot.5: Understand one thing: what you brought has gone to use. Do not forget to check in at the treasury.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.loot.6: An old man says it so: spoils into the common pot, and the porridge is thicker. Thank you.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.friendly.1: Hear your elder: I remember your help. We can speak without ceremony today.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.friendly.2: The council sees this: your favour made the work easier. Thank you.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.friendly.3: Remember your duty: good to see you. That kindness is not forgotten.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.friendly.4: I speak seriously: there is always time for someone who keeps their word.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.friendly.5: Understand one thing: you are not the kind who forgets a debt. That is valued.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.friendly.6: An old man says it so: good deeds do not vanish on the mountain. Not yours, not others'.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.morning.1: They are gathering on the training ground. I will go and watch practice.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.morning.2: Morning forms first, breakfast after. You know the routine.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.morning.3: The basics help on distant adventures too. Return to practice when you have time.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.morning.4: I speak seriously: morning is short. Begin with steady breathing.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.morning.5: Understand one thing: dew is still on the leaves. The best time for the first form.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.morning.6: An old man says it so: morning is generous with strength to those who rose on time.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.evening.1: Hear your elder: evening shows what remains of the day’s effort.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.evening.2: The council sees this: put the sword away, but remember today’s mistakes.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.evening.3: Remember your duty: quiet at last. What did today teach you?
dialogue.murim.social.elder.evening.4: I speak seriously: the day is ending. Tomorrow we start with the basics again.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.evening.5: Understand one thing: evening totals the day. How did it close for you?
dialogue.murim.social.elder.evening.6: An old man says it so: the lamps are lit. Time to put the sword down and remember the faces beside you.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.night.1: Hear your elder: the mind should rest at night. The sword can wait for dawn.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.night.2: The council sees this: quiet. Tomorrow the disciples will complain about lost sleep again.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.night.3: Remember your duty: if it can wait, come back in the morning.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.night.4: I speak seriously: night on the mountain. The watches stay awake; the rest conserve their strength.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.night.5: Understand one thing: night paths are treacherous. Better wait for morning.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.night.6: An old man says it so: at night you hear what the day drowns out. Listen, then go to sleep.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.ordinary.1: Hear your elder: your standing is %2$s. Let your deeds match it.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.ordinary.2: The council sees this: you represent Mount Hua today. Remember your standing: %2$s.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.ordinary.3: Remember your duty: being %2$s does not exempt you from the basics.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.ordinary.4: I speak seriously: the sect has work for you. Your current standing is %2$s.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.ordinary.5: You are %2$s now. Come and see me if you need an old record.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.ordinary.6: An old man says it so: being %2$s means people watch you. Do not fail those who watch.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.weak.1: Standing requires a foundation. Yours does not yet provide it.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.weak.2: Your sword protects the juniors, not your title. Strengthen it.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.weak.3: Excuses are easier before the council than before an enemy.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.weak.4: Seniors can be ashamed of themselves. Let that shame lead to practice.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.weak.5: Words are not enough for the council. Show in deed what you have learned and where you have improved.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.weak.6: Standing is given on credit. Repay it with work.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.strong.1: I see strength above my own. The sect has gained hope.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.strong.2: Your breakthrough is acknowledged. Restraint is the next test.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.strong.3: We need a strong sword. We need the mind behind it even more.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.strong.4: An elder may yield in strength without yielding in responsibility.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.strong.5: The sect will not forget your growth. Remember for whom it is.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.strong.6: Strength creates a debt. Do not neglect it.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.equal.1: Reached our realm? The council will want to see more than qi.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.equal.2: We are equal in strength. Now show mature judgment.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.equal.3: I will examine your basics. A strong art does not cancel the test.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.equal.4: My realm is %3$s. Equal realms make this a serious conversation.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.equal.5: Equality imposes duties. Do you know which?
dialogue.murim.social.elder.equal.6: The council watches. Do not disappoint it.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.lower.1: The path to my realm is long. Good that you have begun.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.lower.2: A senior sword first listens to a junior’s breathing.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.lower.3: I do not need your excuses. I need your diligence.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.lower.4: Respect for seniors begins with honesty about your own weakness.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.lower.5: The beginning is always hard. Continue, and the mountain will open.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.lower.6: Every plum began as a bud.
dialogue.murim.social.head.outsider.1: Who are you looking for? If you wish to join, we can talk here.
dialogue.murim.social.head.outsider.2: Welcome. Practice is under way on the training ground. Let us step aside.
dialogue.murim.social.head.outsider.3: Put your weapon away for now. Introduce yourself first.
dialogue.murim.social.head.outsider.4: Do you have business with the sect? I am listening.
dialogue.murim.social.head.outsider.5: Guests should use the gate. The guards will show you through.
dialogue.murim.social.head.outsider.6: You should rest after the climb. Shall I have someone bring you water?
dialogue.murim.social.head.punished.1: You have been told the terms. Finish them, then we will discuss your lessons.
dialogue.murim.social.head.punished.2: I know about the offence. Put it right, then return to your usual work.
dialogue.murim.social.head.punished.3: An apology is a start. You also need to put right what you did.
dialogue.murim.social.head.punished.4: Ask if the terms are unclear. There is no reason to keep quiet.
dialogue.murim.social.head.punished.5: Take care of this calmly. I need to see it resolved.
dialogue.murim.social.head.punished.6: Come and speak to me when you have finished. I will hear you out.
dialogue.murim.social.head.review.1: You did well at the review. Who helped you prepare?
dialogue.murim.social.head.review.2: Congratulations on your win. Rest after the bout.
dialogue.murim.social.head.review.3: The disciples are discussing your bout. Talk them through what worked.
dialogue.murim.social.head.review.4: Your instructor will be pleased with the result. Go and see him.
dialogue.murim.social.head.review.5: The juniors want to see you practise. Can you spare them some time?
dialogue.murim.social.head.review.6: There is time before the next review. Attend to your usual lessons for now.
dialogue.murim.social.head.secret.1: I did not recognise that form. Who taught it to you?
dialogue.murim.social.head.secret.2: Keep difficult techniques clear of the juniors. They have not learned when to step back.
dialogue.murim.social.head.secret.3: Check that the training ground is clear before you demonstrate.
dialogue.murim.social.head.secret.4: People are already bringing you questions. Say so if you are unsure of the answer.
dialogue.murim.social.head.secret.5: Discuss that art with your instructor. Has he seen you use it?
dialogue.murim.social.head.secret.6: If you found an old record, show Tae Seong. He can help you read it.
dialogue.murim.social.head.loot.1: The supplies arrived. Thank you; we needed them today.
dialogue.murim.social.head.loot.2: Show what you brought to Tae Gyun. He will enter it in the merit ledger.
dialogue.murim.social.head.loot.3: Back from the road? Put down your load, then rest.
dialogue.murim.social.head.loot.4: We have supplies in the storeroom now. We can turn to other work.
dialogue.murim.social.head.loot.5: Give the supplies to the storekeeper. Let him check for damage.
dialogue.murim.social.head.loot.6: The disciples will have food. That is what I am thanking you for.
dialogue.murim.social.head.friendly.1: Good to see you. Do you have time to talk?
dialogue.murim.social.head.friendly.2: Your help came at a good time. Thank you.
dialogue.murim.social.head.friendly.3: Come in. I have just finished the records.
dialogue.murim.social.head.friendly.4: I have time for your question. Go ahead.
dialogue.murim.social.head.friendly.5: We have few people to call on. I am glad I can ask for your help.
dialogue.murim.social.head.friendly.6: How are your lessons going? We need not always talk about assignments.
dialogue.murim.social.head.morning.1: Dawn has come. Go to the training ground; your instructor is waiting.
dialogue.murim.social.head.morning.2: Morning forms, then breakfast. Make sure you eat.
dialogue.murim.social.head.morning.3: Start with the basics today. Your instructor can tell you what to repeat.
dialogue.murim.social.head.morning.4: Good morning. Did you sleep well?
dialogue.murim.social.head.morning.5: There is dew on the paths. Watch your footing on the way to practice.
dialogue.murim.social.head.morning.6: The cook is already at work. Go to the dining hall after practice.
dialogue.murim.social.head.evening.1: The day is nearly over. How did practice go?
dialogue.murim.social.head.evening.2: Put your weapon away and rest. You can review your mistakes with your instructor.
dialogue.murim.social.head.evening.3: Quiet at last. Did you need something?
dialogue.murim.social.head.evening.4: You can continue tomorrow. It is time to eat.
dialogue.murim.social.head.evening.5: Is anyone still on the training ground? Remind them about supper.
dialogue.murim.social.head.evening.6: The lamps are lit. Let us join the others.
dialogue.murim.social.head.night.1: It is late. Get some rest; practice can wait until morning.
dialogue.murim.social.head.night.2: Keep your voice down. The disciples are asleep.
dialogue.murim.social.head.night.3: If it can wait, come back in the morning.
dialogue.murim.social.head.night.4: The posts are manned. You need sleep as well.
dialogue.murim.social.head.night.5: It is easy to lose your footing on the path at night. Do not go far alone.
dialogue.murim.social.head.night.6: Cannot sleep? Sit for a while, then go back to your room.
dialogue.murim.social.head.ordinary.1: The roster lists you as %2$s. Ask if you have questions about your duties.
dialogue.murim.social.head.ordinary.2: You are %2$s now. What brings you here today?
dialogue.murim.social.head.ordinary.3: Being %2$s leaves plenty to learn from your instructor. Go and see him.
dialogue.murim.social.head.ordinary.4: You are %2$s. Consider what work you could help the sect with.
dialogue.murim.social.head.ordinary.5: You are %2$s now. Tell me if you need help with the work.
dialogue.murim.social.head.ordinary.6: The juniors look to you as %2$s. Explain your decisions to them.
dialogue.murim.social.head.weak.1: Do not take everything on at once. Recover your strength first.
dialogue.murim.social.head.weak.2: Ask your instructor to check your basics. He will find suitable practice for you.
dialogue.murim.social.head.weak.3: The sect can wait. Your health comes before an urgent assignment.
dialogue.murim.social.head.weak.4: Go to your instructor and tell him what you are struggling with.
dialogue.murim.social.head.weak.5: Tired? Rest. If you are hurt, see the healer. Do not hide an injury.
dialogue.murim.social.head.weak.6: Keep practice light today. There is no need to exhaust yourself.
dialogue.murim.social.head.strong.1: You have grown stronger. Help the juniors if they need protection.
dialogue.murim.social.head.strong.2: The disciples will struggle against you. Hold back in practice bouts.
dialogue.murim.social.head.strong.3: The people at the gate need to feel safe. Strength alone will not see to that.
dialogue.murim.social.head.strong.4: Give the juniors room on the training ground. They may be slow to move aside.
dialogue.murim.social.head.strong.5: I am pleased with your progress. How are the new lessons going?
dialogue.murim.social.head.strong.6: If someone asks for help on the road, stop and hear them out.
dialogue.murim.social.head.equal.1: Let us discuss who needs help in the sect at present.
dialogue.murim.social.head.equal.2: I would like your opinion on the juniors’ lessons.
dialogue.murim.social.head.equal.3: You spend a good deal of time with the disciples. How are they doing?
dialogue.murim.social.head.equal.4: My stage is %3$s. I still need help running the sect.
dialogue.murim.social.head.equal.5: Sit down. There are a few matters I want to discuss with you.
dialogue.murim.social.head.equal.6: We have few strong fighters. We must also look after those still learning.
dialogue.murim.social.head.lower.1: Ask your instructor what to work on today.
dialogue.murim.social.head.lower.2: Take your time with the difficult form. Learn the simpler one first.
dialogue.murim.social.head.lower.3: I want to know whether you are getting enough help in your lessons.
dialogue.murim.social.head.lower.4: If you cannot manage an exercise, ask to see it again.
dialogue.murim.social.head.lower.5: There is still much for you to learn. That is why we have instructors.
dialogue.murim.social.head.lower.6: Keep practising. Bring your questions to your instructor or to me.
murim.bubble.social.respect.3: A bow to a strong sword.
murim.bubble.social.mock.1: Is the title stronger than the stance?
murim.bubble.social.mock.5: A loud title, a wobbly step.
murim.bubble.social.mock.6: The stance is worse than the title.
murim.bubble.social.advice.4: A title cannot practise for you.
murim.bubble.social.challenge.2: Test our swords on the square?
murim.bubble.social.challenge.4: Let us have an honest bout.
murim.bubble.social.challenge.6: Let us do it fairly on the square.
murim.bubble.social.acknowledge.4: The mountain raised a strong sword.
murim.bubble.social.art_junior.3: I wish I could do that!
murim.bubble.social.art_junior.5: So that is what higher arts look like!
murim.bubble.social.art_junior.6: I wish I had such nerve.
murim.bubble.social.art_elder.4: Such an art must be guarded.
murim.bubble.social.art_elder.6: Do not show it without need.
murim.bubble.social.rumour.5: They say %s commands a higher art.
murim.sect.position.summons: Mount Hua’s head summons you to discuss a new office.
murim.sect.request.completed: Favour completed. The reward is in your merit ledger.
dialogue.murim.social.opt.requests: How can I help the sect?
dialogue.murim.social.opt.decline: I decline for now. We can discuss it later.
dialogue.murim.social.business: Offices are earned by deeds, and favours entrusted to those who keep their word. What shall we discuss?
dialogue.murim.social.offer.first.1: You earned the First Disciple of Yul office: first realm, 60 merit, a review victory and service. A new responsibility within your generation. Will you accept?
dialogue.murim.social.offer.first.2: I offer you leadership of the third generation. You have a real review and service behind you, not merely a loud sword. Agreed?
dialogue.murim.social.offer.first.3: Mount Hua needs a First Disciple of Yul. Your deeds give you the right to accept, and the right to decline.
dialogue.murim.social.offer.first.4: The First Disciple leads by example. Scriptures and the head’s audience open to you; rewards of two merit or more gain one extra. Ready?
dialogue.murim.social.ceremony.first: Before ancestors and disciples: First Disciple of Yul. Lead the juniors and guard the basics. Your generation remains unchanged.
dialogue.murim.social.offer.elder.1: Peak realm, 150 merit, a review, the vault, teaching juniors and defending roads. The council offers you an Elder’s office. Will you accept?
dialogue.murim.social.offer.elder.2: You already lead a generation. It is time to care for the whole mountain. The council is ready to name you Elder.
dialogue.murim.social.offer.elder.3: Your service is proven. I offer you an Elder’s office for the sake of those who follow us.
dialogue.murim.social.offer.elder.4: An Elder may enter the treasury and council homes; service merit rises by half, at least one extra point. Ready to answer for our mountain?
dialogue.murim.social.ceremony.elder: Before Mount Hua’s council: Elder. May your word protect our people as your sword does.
dialogue.murim.social.declined: Your refusal is accepted. Our trust remains. Raise the matter yourself when you are ready.
dialogue.murim.social.requests.1: The mountain needs swords and care. Choose work you can do.
dialogue.murim.social.requests.2: A favour is voluntary. Once accepted, keep your word.
dialogue.murim.social.requests.3: How will you help Mount Hua? I will explain before you agree.
dialogue.murim.social.requests.4: Service earns merit. Empty promises earn nothing.
dialogue.murim.social.request.vault.1: Finished the second lesson and reached the second realm? Prove restraint: win a new review after accepting. Then the Scripture Hall opens to you, and I add 8 merit.
dialogue.murim.social.request.vault.2: The hall is not opened for old fame. Take the favour, win the next review and return for the pass.
dialogue.murim.social.request.vault.3: A new review is needed: show that a strong sword can practise restraint. After the victory the hall pass is yours.
dialogue.murim.social.request.vault.4: The pass is entrusted to the proven. Finish the second lesson, reach the second realm, then win a new review. That is the path.
dialogue.murim.social.request.vault.acti: Favour accepted. You now need a new review victory. Return to Tae Rok or the head for the pass.
dialogue.murim.social.request.vault.done: You may enter the Scripture Hall now. And 8 merit points for you.
dialogue.murim.social.request.training.1: After the second lesson and second realm, lead a session: win spars against three different Yul disciples. No lethal strikes. Earn 6 merit and scripture access.
dialogue.murim.social.request.training.2: The juniors need an example. Accept and win three teaching spars against different Yul disciples.
dialogue.murim.social.request.training.3: Three bouts with one disciple do not count. We need a session for three different juniors.
dialogue.murim.social.request.training.4: Explain with sword and restraint. Spar with three different Yul disciples, then report to me for scripture access.
dialogue.murim.social.request.training.a: The session is yours. Win spars against three different Yul disciples; report to the coach, Tae Seong or the head.
dialogue.murim.social.request.training.d: You have taught the juniors. Here are your 6 merit points. You may now enter the Scripture Hall.
dialogue.murim.social.request.pills.1: I will give you three Snow Plum pills. Take them to Gyeong Cho at the medicinal pavilion for 6 merit.
dialogue.murim.social.request.pills.2: The healer needs three Snow Plum pills. You receive them on accepting; only Gyeong Cho accepts delivery.
dialogue.murim.social.request.pills.3: These pills are for the wounded, not your breakthrough. Give all three to Gyeong Cho.
dialogue.murim.social.request.pills.4: The treasury has accounts; the healer has patients. Deliver the three supplied pills to the medicinal pavilion.
dialogue.murim.social.request.pills.acti: You have the pills. Take all three Snow Plum Pills to Gyeong Cho. To him alone, no one else.
dialogue.murim.social.request.pills.done: All three pills arrived. The wounded will be grateful. Your 6 merit is recorded.
dialogue.murim.social.request.bandits.1: Taking road patrol duty? Defeat three bandits in the ordinary world, then return and report. You will receive 10 merit points and a Snow Plum Pill.
dialogue.murim.social.request.bandits.2: Bandits trouble the roads again. Three bandit victories after accepting will prove your service.
dialogue.murim.social.request.bandits.3: Mount Hua needs a patrol, not your vanity. Three bandits, then return for your reward.
dialogue.murim.social.request.bandits.4: Teaching juniors does not defend a road. Only real bandits defeated after accepting count here.
dialogue.murim.social.request.bandits.ac: Patrol begun. Defeat three bandits; report to Gyeong Tak, Tae Seong or the head.
dialogue.murim.social.request.bandits.do: The road is safer. Receive 10 merit and a Snow Plum pill.
dialogue.murim.social.time.morning.3: Morning does not wait for the lazy.
dialogue.murim.social.time.morning.5: The dew will dry, laziness will remain.
dialogue.murim.social.time.morning.6: The first breath of morning is the cleanest.
dialogue.murim.social.time.day.1: The yard expects work during the day.
dialogue.murim.social.time.day.2: There is still time to practise before evening.
dialogue.murim.social.time.day.3: Today’s training has not been cancelled.
dialogue.murim.social.time.day.4: The day’s work shows in the evening.
dialogue.murim.social.time.day.5: The sun is high, work is on the yard.
dialogue.murim.social.time.evening.1: Evening is time to review mistakes.
dialogue.murim.social.time.evening.4: Let us talk before the night’s rest.
dialogue.murim.social.time.evening.5: The bell will soon call to rest.
dialogue.murim.social.time.night.2: Night at the posts, rest in the yards.
dialogue.murim.social.time.night.3: Leave a long talk until morning.
dialogue.murim.social.time.night.4: Dawn will soon demand your strength.
dialogue.murim.social.time.night.5: Better to avoid the night paths.
dialogue.murim.social.opt.news: What is the mountain talking about?

murim.footwork.death_locked: Underworld King Step unlocks at the 3rd star
murim.guest.spar_won: Cho Gan: a precise strike. Take this page; the lesson reward is given once.
murim.guest.spar_end: Cho Gan: enough. Step back and catch your breath.
murim.guest.kwon_phase: Kwon Yeon: first check whom you struck! Step away from the pulse.
npc.murim.ha_yun.title: Cult agent
dialogue.murim.guest_ha_yun.contract: I will investigate the camp. Leave our people alone.
dialogue.murim.guest_ha_yun.greet: A smile does not make a contract cheaper. A courier vanished at a camp. Want to know who is behind it?
dialogue.murim.guest_ha_yun.lead: Start with the Green Forest camps. Defeat Han Dok, then look for Kwon Yeon. Leave your allies alone today.
dialogue.murim.guest_ha_yun.challenge: I challenge you. Give me time to step away.
dialogue.murim.guest_ha_yun.identity_lin: I will not name my master. A borrowed seal will not reveal him. My contract is honest for now. Break it and we test our strength.
npc.murim.cho_gan.title: Wandering rival
dialogue.murim.guest_cho_gan.lesson: Teach me to read a heavy windup.
dialogue.murim.guest_cho_gan.spar: Let us begin a practice duel.
dialogue.murim.guest_cho_gan.greet: Strike harder and you tire sooner. Show me what you need that strength for.
dialogue.murim.guest_cho_gan.lesson_line: Step aside after the swing. Strike once while he draws his weapon back, then move out. Your first victory earns a page of Six Elements.
npc.murim.bae_do.title: Merchant informant
dialogue.murim.guest_bae_do.greet: Silver first, information later. My invoices are clean... if you skip the fine print.
dialogue.murim.guest_bae_do.tip_line: Han Dok guards a bandit camp. Once he falls, Kwon Yeon will arrive there. I never said the road was safe.
dialogue.murim.guest_bae_do.known_line: Your information is paid for. Han Dok, then Kwon Yeon; my debt is settled.
dialogue.murim.guest_bae_do.price_line: You pay for a lead I obtained, not a promise of success. I charge dearly for truth. A convenient lie could fetch even more.
npc.murim.tae_hyeon.title: Righteous Alliance inspector
dialogue.murim.guest_tae_hyeon.report: Report the lead about Kwon Yeon.
dialogue.murim.guest_tae_hyeon.greet: Victory begins the report. The Alliance is investigating missing couriers. Who will pay for your decision?
dialogue.murim.guest_tae_hyeon.purpose_l: We verify leads instead of accusing a school blindly. Bring the merchant's paid tip or the agent's contract. A disciple earns three merit once.
dialogue.murim.guest_tae_hyeon.reported_: The source is recorded; it is not proof of guilt yet. Your merit for reporting is already recorded. Next we investigate the camp.
npc.murim.han_dok.title: Green Forest lieutenant
dialogue.murim.guest_han_dok.greet: This road belongs to the Green Forest. Leave while you can still walk.
npc.murim.kwon_yeon.title: Sorcerer of borrowed voices
dialogue.murim.guest_kwon_yeon.greet: Your thoughts are louder than your steps. I know why you came. The courier has escaped; now we test you.
dialogue.murim.guest_kwon_yeon.voices_li: Whose voices? I will not tell you. Watch whom you strike instead: false figures leave no wounds. Step clear of a real sword; keep away from the pulse.
dialogue.murim.progression.menu: Sect affairs: training, duties and relationships. What shall we discuss?
dialogue.murim.progression.training: Tae Seong accepts graduates after bouts with different partners and service to the elders. Tae Rok keeps the Six Elements and Seven Plum records. Rainfall can be pieced together from fragments. Seek the full Twenty-Four Movements manual in the Hua vault.
dialogue.murim.progression.direct: You remain in the Yul generation. Nine bows express your promise to learn; you may pause the ceremony and finish later. After a new spar I can review your foundation, at most once a day.
dialogue.murim.progression.ceremony: The bows are made and your promise given. Wait five seconds, then confirm that you accept discipleship. If you leave the conversation, return and finish the rite.
dialogue.murim.progression.archive: Bring an art you know to the Hall of Scriptures. A careful reading will deepen your understanding a little. Let it settle before returning on another day. The head’s vault remains his alone.
dialogue.murim.progression.duties:
Supplies require 16 oak planks and 8 bread. You earn 4 merit, and the sect provides a 5% mastery bonus for one day.
A patrol earns 5 merit: the gate, training ground, Main Hall court, dining hall, then back.
You can finish another day. You may take an assignment and claim a reward at most once per day. Cancelling carries no penalty, but you cannot take another assignment today.
dialogue.murim.progression.report: I will check the supplies, or the route and your return to where you took the duty. Come back even after several days: the deed is remembered and rewarded once.
dialogue.murim.progression.opt.rival: Discuss a rematch with Seo Ho
dialogue.murim.progression.relations: Seo Ho offers a rematch every two days. The head announces news once a week. After an offence, apologise to the victim, then bring Tae Seong 8 bread to reopen special lessons and duties. Restitution grants no merit.
dialogue.murim.progression.discipline: Assaulting a brother or entering a restricted hall costs up to three available merit; standing is preserved. The reason was explained when it happened. After penance, apologise to the last victim and complete one restitution duty.
dialogue.murim.progression.direct_done: You are now my personal disciple. Your generation and office remain the same.
dialogue.murim.progression.lesson_done: The review added 10% to the experience of your current basic-art star. Now fight another sparring bout. I will give the next lesson no earlier than tomorrow.
dialogue.murim.progression.read_done: Record reviewed. Return another day for the next reading.
dialogue.murim.progression.duty_active: Duty accepted. This is no board contract: there is no deadline. Return here when you finish. The patrol route is in your tablet.
dialogue.murim.progression.duty_done: Duty verified, merit awarded. The next duty is available another day.
dialogue.murim.progression.abandoned: Duty abandoned without penalty. A new assignment is available another day.
dialogue.murim.progression.apology_done: Apology heard. Once any sentence is served, Tae Seong will accept 8 bread as restitution.
dialogue.murim.progression.repair_done: Trust restored. Special lessons and assignments are available again.
dialogue.murim.progression.council_done: This week’s council announcement is recorded. Read it again if you wish; there is no further merit.
dialogue.murim.progression.council.dange: Council: bandits have been seen near the sect. Watch the road and protect juniors.
dialogue.murim.progression.council.rain: Council: rain continues. Training takes place under shelter.
dialogue.murim.progression.council.suppl: Council: supplies have arrived; the hall is provided for today.
dialogue.murim.progression.council.peace: Council: the nearby road is quiet. Continue your training and duties.
dialogue.murim.progression.rival.stage.0: Seo Ho: let us start with single cuts. I will remember our bout.
dialogue.murim.progression.rival.stage.1: Seo Ho: now try holding your ground through two cuts.
dialogue.murim.progression.rival.stage.2: Seo Ho: three cuts in succession. Watch the windup as well as the blade.
dialogue.murim.progression.rival.won: You won last time. Let us see how the rematch goes.
dialogue.murim.progression.rival.lost: Your last defeat is a chance to learn, never an offence.
dialogue.murim.progression.rival.new: Allow two days between our meetings.
murim.sect.progression.board.reader: A free sect member must be near the board.
murim.sect.progression.return: Route checked. Return to the assignment point.
murim.sect.progression.offence.assault: Assaulting a brother: up to 3 available merit lost; special activities suspended until apology and restitution.
murim.sect.progression.offence.trespass: Entering a restricted hall: up to 3 available merit lost; special activities suspended until apology and restitution.
murim.bubble.progression.direct: You are now my personal disciple.
murim.bubble.progression.lesson: Watch the position of your wrist.
murim.bubble.progression.rival: Meet me on the training ground!

murim.mastery.insight_needed: Experience ready: the next star needs sparring, meditation or a mentor’s review
book.murim.mastery: Stars measure execution of an art, shared by all its learned forms. At zero, the form is known but has no qi manifestations. Mastery improves power and precision, reduces qi use and enriches effects. The final stars require experience and insight through sparring, meditation or a mentor’s review. All arts, including footwork, and cultivation methods are complete at twelve stars; a torn manuscript reveals only part of the path.

murim.sect.journey.scroll_given: Gyeong Pil gave you a %s scroll. Read it with right-click, then meditate (default: G). Use your technique manual after the seed forms.

dialogue.murim.cook.opt.help: Can I help in the kitchen?
murim.sect.journey.goal.method: ask for help with the method
murim.sect.journey.goal.seed_feel: sit in meditation to form your dantian: step 1 of 3, feel qi
murim.sect.journey.goal.seed_hold: sit again: step 2 of 3, hold the qi ring steady
murim.sect.journey.goal.seed_compress: sit again: step 3 of 3, squeeze the ring into a seed
murim.sect.journey.goal.practice_six: practise the Six Elements to star 2
murim.sect.journey.goal.clean_hits: land three clean hits in one practice bout
murim.sect.journey.goal.deliver_pills: deliver three pills to the healer
murim.sect.journey.goal.partners: finish spars with three different disciples
murim.sect.journey.goal.direct: ask to become a personal disciple
murim.sect.journey.goal.personal_lesson: review your practice with your teacher
murim.sect.journey.goal.apology: apologise to the person you harmed
murim.sect.journey.blocker.join: Introduce yourself to the gate guard, then talk to the mentor.
murim.sect.journey.blocker.method: a lost scroll can be learned from the mentor’s copy
murim.sect.journey.blocker.seed: meditate with %s; follow the ring prompts; the first feeling is meant to scatter
murim.sect.journey.blocker.centre: your centre is unformed; ask the mentor for guidance
murim.sect.journey.blocker.book: right-click your manual, then choose Learn
murim.sect.journey.blocker.practice: practise forms, then sit with the manual in hand: the Echo settles what you lived through; formation is optional
murim.sect.journey.blocker.ready.take_si: you have learned the manual: ask for the first lesson
murim.sect.journey.blocker.ready.submit_: the stars and the breakthrough are done: report the first lesson
the clean hits are done: report the second lesson
murim.sect.journey.blocker.ready.direct: you have earned a personal teacher: ask to become his disciple
murim.sect.journey.blocker.ready.approva: your days and your trust are enough: ask for the leader's approval
murim.sect.journey.blocker.ready.first: the leader has an invitation for you: go and hear it
murim.sect.journey.blocker.ready.elder: the leader has an invitation for you: go and hear it
murim.sect.journey.blocker.ready.persona: a lesson is ready: ask your teacher for it
murim.sect.journey.blocker.wall: meditate until your reserve bar is full; its end is the wall of your rank
murim.sect.journey.blocker.breakthrough: the wall and requirements are ready; continue meditating
murim.sect.journey.blocker.boss: For Second Rate: Six Elements Sword ★6, Falling Petal Sword ★3, wins against three different disciples, and the mentor test—last 30 seconds or land three clean hits. The fortress is optional.
murim.sect.journey.blocker.boss_trial: optional: the fortress master in the bandit fortress (he comes out in a world at peace too)
murim.sect.journey.blocker.technique: master a combat technique to the breakthrough requirement
murim.sect.journey.blocker.body: your qi is full but your body is not ready: it hardens from long roads, mining, felling trees and fights
murim.sect.journey.blocker.max: you have reached the playable rank limit
murim.sect.journey.blocker.clean_hits: spar with Seo Rang or the second generation; you can practise Falling Petal here
murim.sect.journey.blocker.request: a local pill delivery is enough; no bandit trip required
murim.sect.journey.blocker.pills: bring the three Snow Plum pills from your delivery
murim.sect.journey.blocker.partners: another bout with the same disciple does not add a new partner
murim.sect.journey.blocker.ceremony: stand still next to the mentor for a few breaths, or come back later
murim.sect.journey.blocker.standing: %s more earned in all (the number on the tablet's Standing tab); contracts at the board, bouts, favours and practice days all count
murim.sect.journey.blocker.new_spar: finish a new practice bout since your last lesson
murim.sect.journey.blocker.rest: today’s lesson is complete; another is available on a later day if you wish
murim.sect.journey.blocker.sentence: You are under disciplinary punishment. Fulfil the terms given in your sentencing message.
murim.sect.journey.blocker.apology: apologise to the actual victim; missing practice is not an offence
murim.sect.journey.blocker.repair: after apologising, bring eight bread to Tae Seong
murim.sect.journey.blocker.read_method: learn the method from its scroll; use the technique manual after the seed
murim.sect.journey.welcome: Welcome back! All you have learned is kept.
murim.sect.journey.blocker.cap: your current foundation is at its cap; choose another known foundation or enjoy your own projects

murim.sect.room.bedroll: There is no free bed yet. Your bedroll spot: %s, %s, %s.
murim.sect.arrival.mentor: Mentor Gyeong Pil will see you. A disciple will walk you there.
murim.sect.arrival.guide_busy: The guides are busy. Wait at the gate or visit the mentor yourself.
murim.sect.arrival.ceremony_hint: You will be introduced at the next morning formation. You can begin learning now.
dialogue.murim.arrival.question: Have you come to study or on business? The mentor receives students; I watch the gate.
dialogue.murim.arrival.opt.learn: I want to become a disciple.
dialogue.murim.arrival.invited: Speak to Gyeong Pil, the mentor: %s. I can send a disciple to guide you if you ask.
dialogue.murim.arrival.opt.follow: Ask a disciple to guide me.
dialogue.murim.arrival.waiting: The mentor has been told about you. Do you need a guide?
dialogue.murim.arrival.head_hall: Gyeong Pil admits students at the dais by the square. By day the head comes out to the steps of the Main Hall; juniors are not let inside.
dialogue.murim.arrival.mentor_reception: Word has come from the gate. Join us and receive the Six Elements, a cultivation method and a dorm place. The head will introduce you in the morning; your lessons can begin now.
dialogue.murim.arrival.mentor_gate: Do you wish to study with us? Introduce yourself, and we can discuss your training.
command.murim.hua.regrade.no_site: No Mount Hua site found. Run this in the overworld.
command.murim.hua.regrade.zones: Select surface zones: [dry-run|apply] training arch main_hall camp alchemy elders dining treasury bell scriptures ancestors or sect_core.
command.murim.hua.regrade.preview: Regrade: %s block changes, %s protected blocks, %s columns pinned by buildings. PNGs and report: %s

murim.sect.journey.goal.peak: prepare the breakthrough to the Peak
murim.sect.journey.goal.peak_stage: settle the next stage of the Peak

murim.sect.meal.closed: The cook is not serving now.
murim.sect.meal.already: You have already had your portion for this meal.
murim.sect.meal.full: Make room in your inventory for the food.
murim.sect.meal.sat: You sat with the others. Next time take your portion from the cook.
murim.approach.help.vault: Elder Tae Rok has a task for you: win a fresh bout at the review, and the scripture hall will open to you.
murim.approach.help.training: The juniors need a sparring partner. Beat three of them in practice and the sect will remember it.
murim.approach.help.pills: Elder Tae Gyun asked me to hand you three pills. Carry them to the healer Gyeong Cho.
murim.approach.help.bandits: Bandits are bothering the road. Deal with three of them and report back.
murim.sect.meal.served_cold: The cook leaves you the cold leftovers: %s. They stay in your inventory.
murim.sect.meal.cooled: Your uneaten food has cooled. It stays in your inventory.
murim.approach.declined: %s will not trouble you again today.
murim.bubble.bout.accept_challenge: Come then. Do not hold back.
murim.bubble.bout.trial_won: Test passed. I won, but you have shown your skill.
murim.bubble.bout.trial_lost: Not yet. Nothing lost — try again.
murim.bubble.bout.accept_train: A friendly bout? Good, take your stance.
murim.bubble.bout.respect.1: Well fought, junior. I will remember it.
murim.bubble.bout.respect.2: You earned that one. Keep your feet like that.
murim.bubble.bout.respect.3: Strong. Next time I will not go easy.
murim.bubble.bout.respect.5: Note your mistakes, there were three.
murim.bubble.bout.rumour.1: Did you hear? %s beat %s on the square!
murim.bubble.bout.rumour.2: %s stood up to %s, and won. Even the seniors talk about it.
murim.bubble.bout.rumour.5: Saw %s and %s? The whole yard did.
murim.bubble.bout.promoted: You have been promoted. The juniors will look to you for an example.
dialogue.murim.bout.rumour.1: Everyone speaks of how %s defeated %s on the square.
dialogue.murim.bout.rumour.2: %s beat %s. I saw the faces of the seniors afterwards.
dialogue.murim.bout.rumour.4: The whole kitchen talks of %s and %s. What a bout.
dialogue.murim.bout.rumour.5: %s outplayed %s. The square was crowded, breathtaking.
dialogue.murim.bout.rumour.6: %s against %s? Now we have an answer to who is stronger.
dialogue.murim.bout.menu.busy: Not now. We are not free for a bout.
dialogue.murim.bout.menu.no_ring: Bouts are held on the square. Step onto the training square and ask again.
dialogue.murim.bout.menu.counted_today: You already beat me today; a win over me counts once a day. A training bout is still possible.
dialogue.murim.bout.menu.senior: A senior. A training bout carries no stakes; a challenge counts towards your promotion (five wins over seniors). A loss costs you nothing.
dialogue.murim.bout.menu.free: A friendly bout on the square: safe, nobody is truly hurt.
dialogue.murim.bout.opt.trial: Test my skill: 30 seconds or 3 clean hits. You win; no penalty.
dialogue.murim.bout.opt.promo: Claim the step won on the square
dialogue.murim.bout.opt.promo_begin: Kneel and ask the sect to accept the step
dialogue.murim.bout.promo: Five seniors yielded to you on the square. The sect does not ignore that. Kneel, and the step is yours.
dialogue.murim.bout.promo_ceremony: The elders are waiting. Let a few breaths pass, then accept your new standing. If you leave the conversation, return to finish the rite.
dialogue.murim.bout.promo_done: You stand one step higher in the sect. Your wins are written down; the next step is won the same way.
murim.sect.bout.won: You beat %s! Respect grows. Wins over seniors: %s/%s.
murim.sect.bout.won_ceremony: You beat %s! That is five wins over seniors: speak to the head for the ceremony.
murim.sect.bout.won_plain: You beat %s! The sect talks of it.
murim.sect.bout.promoted_news: %s has risen to a new step in the sect: %s.
murim.sect.bout.progress_ceremony: Challenges to seniors: %s/%s, the ceremony with the head waits.
murim.sect.defeat.reason.qi: Your qi ran dry (down to %4$s%% in the bout). Gather it before the next one; do not spend it all in the first exchange.
murim.sect.defeat.reason.hits: You took %1$s hits and landed %2$s. You stood where the blow could reach you. Move off the line before the strike lands.
murim.sect.defeat.reason.far: You kept %3$s blocks away and landed only %2$s hits. You never closed in. Step into the exchange.
murim.sect.defeat.reason.close: You stood %3$s blocks from him and took %1$s hits. Too close: there was no room to evade or to swing. Keep your distance.
murim.sect.defeat.reason.passive: You landed only %2$s hits. You waited for him. Strike first, and keep striking.
murim.sect.defeat.drill.meditate: meditate for half a minute to steady your qi.
murim.sect.defeat.drill.strikes: land %s blows on any target: a post, a beast, a sparring partner.
murim.sect.defeat.drill.footwork: walk %s blocks on foot, light and fast, to train your steps.
murim.sect.defeat.drill_done: Exercise done. Your mentor's lesson sinks in: mastery grows.
murim.correction.learned: Lesson learned: practice x1.5 for 10 minutes.
murim.correction.say.windup_hit: Struck while winding up. Wait for his gap.
murim.correction.say.punished: You swung as he struck. Let his blow pass.
murim.correction.say.whiff: You drop the form before it lands. Finish it.
murim.correction.say.one_form: One form again and again. Change it, or it dulls.
murim.correction.say.edge: You back out of the square. Hold your ground.
murim.correction.say.qi: Your qi ran dry. Spend it form by form.
murim.correction.say.close: Too close: no room to cut or step. Open the gap.
murim.correction.say.hits: Too many blows taken. Step aside, then strike.
murim.correction.say.far: You stay far and never close in. Step in.
murim.correction.say.passive: You barely attacked. Strike first next time.
murim.correction.peer.windup_hit: He caught you in the wind-up. Mind his gap.
murim.correction.peer.punished: You swing into his strike. Watch his window.
murim.correction.peer.whiff: Your forms stop short of the cut, brother.
murim.correction.peer.one_form: One form over and over. Vary them, brother.
murim.correction.peer.edge: You keep to the square's edge. Take the middle.
murim.correction.peer.qi: Your qi goes too fast, brother. Pace it.
murim.correction.peer.close: You crowd him. Give yourself room.
murim.correction.peer.hits: You take too many blows. Footwork first.
murim.correction.peer.far: You are too far away, brother. Move closer.
murim.correction.peer.passive: You wait too long, brother. Strike first.
murim.bubble.lesson.1: That's it. Hold on to it.
murim.bubble.lesson.2: Better. Now it is in your hands.
murim.bubble.lesson.4: Good. Keep that, and the rest follows.
murim.bubble.escort.start.1: Lead on, young master. I follow.
murim.bubble.escort.start.2: Silver is heavy. Walk slowly, please.
murim.bubble.escort.start.3: The road is long. Stay close.
murim.bubble.escort.start.4: Bandits love a lone merchant. Not me.
murim.bubble.escort.start.5: My goods and I are in your hands.
murim.bubble.escort.start.6: Ready when you are, young master.
murim.bubble.escort.way.1: Mind the stones. My jars are fragile.
murim.bubble.escort.way.2: The pass is quiet today. Too quiet.
murim.bubble.escort.way.3: Slower! My legs are no disciple's.
murim.bubble.escort.way.4: I have walked this road thirty years.
murim.bubble.escort.way.5: Hear the wind? It smells of rain.
murim.bubble.escort.way.6: Every liang I earn walks this road.
murim.bubble.escort.end.1: Safe at last. The sect has my thanks.
murim.bubble.escort.end.2: A good escort. Tell the elder so.
murim.bubble.escort.end.3: My goods are whole. Well done.
murim.bubble.escort.end.6: Silver for the sect, tea for you.
murim.sect.duel.no_target: There is nobody to duel with here.
murim.sect.duel.busy: One of you is already in a duel.
murim.sect.duel.hurt: A duel needs both of you above half health.
murim.sect.duel.no_ring: Duels are held on the square: both of you must stand together on the square on the training square.
murim.sect.duel.sent: You offered %s a duel. Waiting for the answer.
murim.sect.duel.asked: %s offers you a duel on the square. Sneak and right-click to accept, or:
murim.sect.duel.none: Nobody offered you a duel (or the offer expired).
murim.sect.duel.gone: The duel cannot start now: stay together on the square.
murim.sect.duel.begin: Duel with %s begins: whoever loses half his health yields.
murim.sect.duel.result.left: Duel over: %2$s left the square, %1$s wins.
murim.sect.duel.result.time: Duel over, time is up: %s has the better of %s.
dialogue.murim.bout.menu.later.night: Practise on the square’s dummy until morning.
dialogue.murim.bout.menu.later.dinner: Not now, it is mealtime. After dinner, at the square.
dialogue.murim.bout.menu.later.morning: After the morning line, at the square. Not before.
dialogue.murim.bout.menu.later.busy: I am on my duty. When I am free, I will be at the square.
dialogue.murim.bout.menu.ring_busy: The square is busy (%s fights going). Wait by the edge.
dialogue.murim.bout.menu.junior: Challenging a junior is below your standing. A training bout, if you like: safe, nothing at stake.
murim.sect.bout.refused: You left the square: the bout is called off, no penalty.
murim.sect.bout.draw: Time is up, the points are equal: a draw.
murim.sect.bout.interrupted: Someone struck into your bout: it is stopped, with no result.
murim.bubble.bout.loser.1: Good bout. Next time I will be ready.
murim.bubble.bout.loser.2: You were quicker today. No grudge.
murim.bubble.bout.loser.4: A firm blow. I will remember.
murim.bubble.bout.loser.5: Now you owe me. A joke.
murim.bubble.bout.loser.6: A pity. But it was fair.
murim.sect.duel.result_draw.gone: Duel over: %s and %s, someone is gone, no winner.
murim.sect.duel.result_draw.refused: Duel called off: %s and %s, someone left the square during the count. No penalty.
murim.sect.duel.result_draw.interfered: Duel stopped: %s and %s, a third party struck in. No result.
murim.sect.duel.result_draw.time: Duel over, time is up: %s and %s, a draw.
murim.sect.duel.result_draw.left: Duel over: %s and %s both left the square, a draw.
murim.sect.review.replaced: You were late for your bout. %s takes your place. No penalty.
murim.sect.review.reminder: Today is the review. Be at the training square before midday.
murim.sect.review.too_early: Sign up the day before the review. Come back in %s days.

murim.contract.low_standing: The board opens when you become a disciple.
murim.contract.no_such: There is no such contract today.
murim.contract.done_today: You already finished this contract today.
murim.contract.no_merchant: No merchant could be found. Try again.
murim.contract.expired: The third sect day of your contract has ended.
murim.contract.not_taker: Only the one who took the contract can invite.
murim.contract.invited: %s invites you to a contract. Answer on your tablet.
murim.contract.left: You left the contract. Nothing is lost.
murim.contract.token_found: Camp tally found: take it to the one who gave the contract.
dialogue.murim.bout.menu.mentor: A first-class instructor. Practice bouts are safe; promotion challenges count separately. He is stronger than the second-class disciples.
dialogue.murim.bout.menu.not_peak: You are not at the Peak yet. A mentor of the first generation does not cross blades with those who are not.
dialogue.murim.bout.menu.elders_first: First beat all the strong seniors of the second generation: %s left.
murim.sect.bout.won_weaker: You beat %s! He is no stronger than you: respect only.
murim.contract.token_searched: The camp is already routed. You find the tally in the ruins.
murim.contract.token_searched_other: %s found the tally in the ruins: the whole group can hand it in.

murim.contract.kind.escort.foot: Escort the merchant from the gate to the foot of the mountain
murim.contract.footer: A contract lasts through the acceptance day and the next two sect days. Failure carries no penalty. The old duties are on the back of the board.

murim.contract.status.camp: clear the camp; patrols travel by day and a torch sentry watches at night
murim.contract.board_lost: The merchant was lost on the road. Nobody is blamed; take the escort again if you wish.
murim.contract.completed_items: Contract done: %s. Merit +%s, reward in your bag
murim.contract.not_ready: The contract is not ready yet.

murim.tablet.not_member: The tablet stays blank until you join the sect.

murim.tablet.replaced_part: Your mentor hands you a new tablet and, seeing your purse, takes only %s merit.
dialogue.murim.mentor.tablet_lost: Lost it?! The tablet is a disciple's face. Take a new one; the price comes off your merit. And keep it on you this time.
murim.tablet.streak_hint: At %s practice days the leader gives his nod
murim.tablet.standing.not_open: Sign-up opens the day before the review
dialogue.murim.arrival.tour.hall: That is the Main Hall. Tae Hwi hears sect affairs there. Entry is by office or invitation. When he needs to speak with juniors, the head comes out to the steps.
dialogue.murim.arrival.tour.dining: The dining hall. A disciple gets two bowls a day: during “%s” and “%s.” Your tablet gives the start of each. I will not hurry you. The cook will not wait.
dialogue.murim.arrival.tour.square: The training square. Morning formation stands here, and every lesson of mine begins at its edge. Take a place in the rows; the rest you will learn.
dialogue.murim.arrival.tour.board: The contract board, at the head of the hall court. Once you rank as a disciple you may take the day's contracts from it. Until then, read it and learn what the sect needs.
dialogue.murim.arrival.tour.bed: Your bed is in the %1$s, %2$s. A plate with your name hangs by the door, and the jade tablet marks the bed on its map.
dialogue.murim.arrival.tour.end: That is the sect. Now follow me: I will introduce you to the sect head.
dialogue.murim.tour.opt.skip: I will find my own way.
murim.sect.absence.1.1: Where have you been, disciple? Your place in the rows stood empty.
murim.sect.absence.1.2: Where have you been, disciple? A day gone, and no word to me.
murim.sect.absence.1.3: Where have you been, disciple? A whole day without a sight of you. Do not leave without a word.
murim.sect.absence.1.4: Where have you been, disciple? A sword left idle rusts. Make it up today.
murim.sect.absence.3.1: Where have you been, disciple? Three days and more without a sign of you. A sect is not a roadside inn.
murim.sect.absence.3.2: Where have you been, disciple? Days gone and your bed cold. Tell me before you wander next time.
murim.sect.absence.3.3: Where have you been, disciple? Three days without formation, three steps back. Return to the basics.
murim.sect.absence.3.4: Where have you been, disciple? The mountain does not punish departures, but it does not wait forever.
murim.sect.absence.7.1: Where have you been, disciple? A whole week! I had begun to think the mountain had kept you. Send word next time.
murim.sect.absence.7.2: Where have you been, disciple? More than a week away. The sect remembers its own, but do not make it wait so long.
murim.sect.absence.7.3: Where have you been, disciple? A week! The road is far, but a message could have been sent.
murim.sect.absence.7.4: Where have you been, disciple? More than a week. The main thing is you are whole. The rest later.

command.murim.dev.help.unknown: No dev group %s. Try /murim dev help.

command.murim.dev.group.art: art - techniques: list, preview, learn, stars, cooldown
command.murim.dev.group.fight: fight - aura of an enemy, a test enemy, a training dummy
command.murim.dev.group.body: body - body stage, qi and rank wall

command.murim.dev.group.yard: yard - training yard dummies, strikes, the mentor's correction

command.murim.dev.group.hua: hua - Mount Hua: info, teleports, probe, pregeneration, regrade
command.murim.dev.group.camp: camp - bandit camp: info, teleport, reset
command.murim.dev.group.peddler: peddler - the village peddler: info and spawn
command.murim.dev.group.loc: loc - capture, info, place, forget a location template
command.murim.dev.group.vfx: vfx - client effects: shockwave, rainfall, preset, bench, reload
command.murim.dev.group.face: face - client faces of sect students: on, off, cycle, set, mood, info, reset

command.murim.dev.help.rank:
/murim dev rank <0..10> [stage] - set the rank without a breakthrough (4 = Peak, stage 0-2 only on the Peak).
/murim dev rank awaken - create a normal dantian using the current method (Six Elements Breathing Technique by default); alias: /murim awaken.
/murim dev rank seed <method> - instant dantian seed of a method, full qi.
/murim dev rank reset - reset profile, path, meditation and mastery.
/murim dev rank profile - the dantian numbers.
command.murim.dev.help.art:
/murim dev art list - loaded techniques.
/murim dev art preview <technique> - play a technique.
/murim dev art learn <technique> [star] - learn at a star without a manuscript.
/murim dev art all - every technique at its last star.
/murim dev art stars - mastery and wisdom in numbers.
/murim dev art stars set <form|art|method/id> <0..12> - set the stars.
/murim dev art cooldown - clear the technique cooldown.
command.murim.dev.help.fight:
/murim dev fight aura <rank> [demonic] - set the aura of the creature you look at (0 clears).
/murim dev fight enemy <rank> [demonic] - a mindless zombie with an aura four blocks ahead.
/murim dev fight dummy - a training dummy three blocks ahead.
command.murim.dev.help.body:
/murim dev body - body stage, points, today's work by kind, best times.
/murim dev body points <n> - set the body points.
/murim dev body scan - look at the vanilla statistics now.
/murim dev body reset - forget the body (the statistics as they stand become the baseline).
/murim dev body qi - fill the qi pool.
/murim dev body wall - fill the pool up to the rank wall.
command.murim.dev.help.sect:
/murim dev sect log [hud] - sect journal and goal reminder.
Every command takes an optional [player]; without it the sender is meant.
/murim dev sect join|leave [player] - join without the mentor walk (bed, tablet, scroll) / leave and clear the state.
/murim dev sect standing <outsider|newcomer|disciple|graduate|trusted> [player]
/murim dev sect position <none|first|elder> [player]
/murim dev sect merit <n> [player] - set spendable merit.
/murim dev sect status [player] - membership, standing, position, rank, merit, challenges, goal.
/murim dev sect state - raw state and flags.
/murim dev sect flag <flag> - set a flag; buy <offer> - exchange merit; release - leave the penance cave.
/murim dev sect tablet [player] - open the jade tablet; knock [player] - knock on the nearest gate.
command.murim.dev.help.sched:
/murim dev sched time <period> - wind the clock to the start of a part of the day.
/murim dev sched settle - put every sect person at his place of now.
/murim dev sched life - who is where and doing what.
/murim dev sched audit - every hop of the waypoint graph asked of the pathfinder.
/murim dev sched review - wind to the next review of disciples.
/murim dev sched spawn - the first sect NPCs in a half circle.
command.murim.dev.help.map:
/murim dev map - the sect map's state.
/murim dev map rebuild - sample its area again.
/murim dev map boxes [clear] - place or remove the layout sketch of Mount Hua.
command.murim.dev.help.repairs: /murim dev repairs [age <ticks>|treasury <liang>|forget] - state of the sect repairs; make records older; set the treasury; drop the records.
command.murim.dev.help.yard:
/murim dev yard [ensure|strike <form 0-5>] - the training yard: dummies standing, put them in now, strike the nearest dummy with a form.
/murim dev yard correct <mistake> - the mentor names that mistake to you as a round would have (windup_hit, punished, whiff, one_form, edge, qi, close, hits, far, passive).
command.murim.dev.help.boss:
/murim dev boss - the nearest fortress and the boss.
/murim dev boss tp|reset|place - teleport, reset, build one here.
/murim dev boss flag on|off - the boss-defeated flag.
command.murim.dev.help.hua:
/murim dev hua - where the mountain is (clickable teleports).
/murim dev hua tp <place> - teleport; probe <place> - what stands there.
/murim dev hua pregen [cells|margin] - generate the chunks of the mountain.
/murim dev hua regrade <zones> - regrade zones (permission 4, dev runs only).
/murim dev hua lingzhi [far|path] - look at the hidden niche.
command.murim.dev.help.camp:
/murim dev camp - the nearest bandit camp and its state.
/murim dev camp tp|reset - teleport; the band returns when you come near.
command.murim.dev.help.peddler:
/murim dev peddler - is there a village point here and when the peddler comes next.
/murim dev peddler spawn - put the village peddler here.
command.murim.dev.help.tree:
/murim dev tree <courtyard|cliff|young> [pink|pale|red] [seed] - grow a plum tree on the block you look at.
/murim dev tree <variant> at <pos> [palette] [seed] - at a position.
command.murim.dev.help.loc:
/murim dev loc capture <location> [from to] - take the edited location back into a template.
/murim dev loc info|forget <location> - what is captured / drop this world's copy.
/murim dev loc place <location> [0|90|180|270] - stamp it here.
command.murim.dev.help.vfx:
Client commands: /murim dev vfx shockwave | rainfall - play ahead.
/murim dev vfx preset <name> [seconds] - play on yourself; seconds stretches the whole timeline.
/murim dev vfx reload - reread assets/murim/vfx_presets/*.json from active resource packs.
/murim dev vfx bench <element> [from_s] [to_s] [loop] - one local element: line, line_thin, fire1, preset:<name>; lab seconds.
command.murim.dev.help.face: Client commands on the sect person you look at (else the nearest within eight blocks): /murim dev face on|off|auto - the constructor; cycle [all] - re-roll the parts; set <eyes> <brows> <nose> <mouth> - force parts (1-based); mood <neutral|talk|pain|angry|happy|asleep|auto>; info; reset.
command.murim.dev.help.build:
Permission 4, dev runs only (build scripts use these paths):
/murim dev setraw <pos> <block> - set a block without neighbour updates.
/murim dev resink <from> <to> - re-seat tabletop props.
/murim dev fillstands <from> <to> - default swords on stands.
/murim dev useon <pos> <face> - right click with the held item.
/murim dev region save <name> <from> <to> | load <name> <pos> [rotation] [exact] - move a piece between worlds.
command.murim.dev.group.useblock: useblock - interact with a block for filming
command.murim.dev.help.useblock: /murim dev useblock <x> <y> <z> - face the block and interact with it using the main hand (permission 2, player only).
command.murim.dev.group.useitem: useitem - use the held item for filming
command.murim.dev.help.useitem: /murim dev useitem - use the main-hand item (permission 2, player only).
command.murim.dev.group.closescreen: closescreen - close the current screen for filming
command.murim.dev.help.closescreen: /murim dev closescreen - close the open container and client screen (permission 2, player only).
command.murim.sect.status: Sect status of %s: member=%s, standing=%s, position=%s, rank=%s (%s), merit=%s (lifetime %s), challenges %s/%s, goal: %s
murim.sect.name_plate.title: Disciple's Room
murim.tablet.step.partners: Complete practice bouts with three different disciples
murim.tablet.streak.approved: The leader has given his nod
dialogue.murim.social.junior.office_elde: Elder! Please, pass. The yard is yours.
Honoured Elder, if you need anything, only say so.
Elder, we never dared hope you would walk among us. Welcome.
Elder, would you watch our form today? One word from you is worth a week of drill.
Elder, would you like water? Spring water, cold.
Elder, we try not to make noise while you are here.
dialogue.murim.social.junior.office_firs: First Disciple! The third generation is glad to see you.
Senior, the juniors speak of you with respect. Please, pass.
First Disciple, if the line needs anything from me, say it.
First Disciple, will you show us a form? We watch you and learn.
First Disciple, we will line up at your word.
First Disciple, will you tell us about the form? We will listen.
dialogue.murim.social.second.office_elde: Elder. The second generation greets you.
Elder, the square and the yard are at your disposal.
Elder, if you find fault in how we hold the posts, tell me and I will mend it.
Elder, the juniors are in the yard. Whom shall I call?
Elder, the posts are checked. The night was quiet.
Elder, I am here for now. Is there an errand?
dialogue.murim.social.second.office_firs: First Disciple of Yul. The second generation greets you.
Senior, the row has assembled. We are waiting for you.
First Disciple, if the juniors give you trouble, send them to me.
First Disciple, well met. The square is free whenever you want it.
Senior, shall I return to practice or wait?
First Disciple, may I ask advice on the line?
dialogue.murim.social.first.office_elder: Elder. The yard is quiet; you chose a good hour.
Elder, no ceremony between us. The second generation is watching, that is all.
Elder. When the council asks about the first generation, tell them we are holding.
Elder, you earned the seat. The juniors will not say it aloud, so I will.
Elder. Between us: the second generation has pulled itself up.
Elder, if you need an eye on the yard, I am near.
dialogue.murim.social.first.office_first: Here for the disciples? They are in the yard.
Business? I can listen while the row rests.
First Disciple. If a junior gives you trouble you cannot settle, send him to us.
Well met, First Disciple. A senior's seat is lighter when it is shared.
The watch has been assigned. Shall I call someone?
You are in time. There is a moment to talk.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.office_elder: Elder, do you have a moment to discuss the lessons?
Elder, the juniors are practising in pairs. I am checking their stances.
Elder, take a look at the second row. A few disciples need help.
Elder, come and watch a lesson when you can.
