Elder, I would like to discuss an exercise at the next council.
Elder, I will check their footwork if you watch their hands.
dialogue.murim.social.coach.office_first: First Disciple, show me if you are having trouble explaining a form to the juniors.
First Disciple, split the formation into pairs. It is easier to spot mistakes that way.
First Disciple, check the spacing between the rows.
First Disciple, send a junior to me if they cannot manage the step.
First Disciple, ask the disciples to repeat your demonstration. You will see who understood.
First Disciple, demonstrate slowly to begin with. You can speed up later.
dialogue.murim.social.elder.office_elder: Fellow elder. The council is glad to have you at the table.
Elder, we should speak of the treasury before the next council. Your counsel is wanted.
Brother of the council, sit down. An elder’s work takes patience. What brings you?
Brother, the council is busy today. What shall we discuss here?
Fellow elder. The council awaits your word on the treasury.
Well met, brother. There is tea. Will you sit?
dialogue.murim.social.elder.office_first: First Disciple. The council hears good things of you.
First Disciple, the third generation is the mountain's future. Lead it kindly.
Well met, First Disciple. Come to the council hall if the juniors need a word from above.
First Disciple, you have the sect's trust. Wear it lightly and carry it well.
First Disciple, the council values those who can be silent and do.
First Disciple, the mountain's future is in your generation's hands.
Elder, good to see you. What news of the disciples?
Elder, do you need help from the Main Hall? Tell me what to arrange.
Elder, let us compare our notes before the next council.
Elder, walk with me. I would like to hear how our people are doing.
Elder, I am glad you came. Do you have time to talk?
Elder, which disciples need help at present?
First Disciple. How is practice going for the third-class disciples?
First Disciple, bring the juniors to me if they need to talk.
First Disciple, leave some work for the juniors. They need to learn too.
First Disciple, tell me what the juniors have been asking you about.
First Disciple. If someone needs an instructor, help them find one.
First Disciple, remember to make time for your own practice.
murim.bubble.social.elder_peer.6: A good hour for a meeting, Elder.
murim.bubble.social.first_up.4: First Disciple, show us a form?
murim.bubble.social.first_up.5: First Disciple, we are behind you.
murim.bubble.social.first_peer.2: First Disciple, a moment to talk?
murim.bubble.social.art_peer.2: Fine work. The council will hear.
murim.bubble.social.art_peer.4: A strong art in strong hands.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.greet.1: Good day, Elder. The mountain is quiet; may your day be too.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.greet.2: Elder! If you need anything at all, only say so.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.greet.3: Respects, Elder. The yard has been swept for you.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.greet.4: Respects, Elder. The mountain listens to your steps.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.greet.5: Elder! The yard is in order and the steps are dry. Walk at ease.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.greet.6: Allow me to bow, Elder. If you need anything, I am near.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.spar.1: Elder, would you honour me with a bout? One exchange would teach me more than a month of drill.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.spar.2: Elder, there is a form I cannot finish. Would you watch me on the square, if you have the time?
murim.approach.office.elder.up.spar.3: Elder, allow me one exchange. I fear my stance is crooked, and no one but you will say so.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.spar.4: Elder, do me the kindness of one bout. I will remember it long.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.spar.5: Elder, I need to know what I am worth. A bout with you answers better than any book.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.spar.6: Elder, if you have an hour, shall we go to the square? Do not spare me.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.table.1: Elder, the porridge is out. A place at the head of the table is kept for you.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.table.2: Elder, the meal has begun. The best place is kept for you.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.table.3: To the table, Elder, please. The bowl waits until you wish.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.table.4: Elder, the porridge is hot. We will wait for you.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.table.5: Elder, please join the common table, the juniors will be glad.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.table.6: The meal is served, Elder. Do us the honour.
Elder, we heard of your bout. The whole yard speaks of it.
Elder, a victory worthy of your seat. We are proud.
Elder, we heard of your win. The juniors argue over whose turn it is to learn from you.
Elder, could I watch you practise that lunge?
Elder, you never lost your balance. How can I learn to do that?
Elder, allow me to congratulate you. The sect is proud of your seat.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.console.1: Elder, shall I bring a towel? You have not had time to rest after the bout.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.console.2: Elder, forgive my boldness: the juniors still speak only of your strength.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.console.3: Elder, shall I bring water? You should catch your breath after that bout.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.console.4: Forgive me, Elder, but we have seen your wins, and there were more.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.console.5: Elder, rest. A blade is whetted, not broken.
murim.approach.office.elder.up.console.6: Elder, do not grieve: the juniors learn from your falls too.
murim.approach.office.elder.peer.greet.1: Good day, Elder. A quiet mountain suits the council's work.
murim.approach.office.elder.peer.greet.2: Elder. A word later about the juniors, if you have the time?
murim.approach.office.elder.peer.greet.3: Well met, Elder. The council is the better for your seat.
murim.approach.office.elder.peer.greet.4: Elder. The council is in place, the mountain is in place, the day takes shape.
murim.approach.office.elder.peer.greet.5: Hello, Elder. News from the gate is thin, and that is good.
murim.approach.office.elder.peer.greet.6: Elder. A timely meeting: questions have piled up for the council.
murim.approach.office.elder.peer.table.1: Elder, the meal is served. Shall we eat together?
murim.approach.office.elder.peer.table.2: Elder, the meal. Talk of business goes easier at the table.
murim.approach.office.elder.peer.table.3: Elder, will you join the meal? The council can wait.
murim.approach.office.elder.peer.table.4: The porridge is hot, Elder. Let us eat together before it cools.
murim.approach.office.elder.peer.table.5: Elder, a bowl and a bench are all our luxury. Share it with us.
murim.approach.office.elder.peer.table.6: To the table, Elder. Business talk can wait until the last spoonful.
murim.approach.office.elder.peer.congrat: A fine bout, Elder. The council heard of it before you finished bowing.
News of your bout reached me, Elder. The mountain has a reason to hold its head high.
The whole council knows of your bout, Elder. Congratulations.
A good bout, Elder. The council nods.
A win worthy of your seat. No more words needed, Elder.
murim.approach.office.elder.peer.console: A lost bout, Elder? Every blade has met one. Yours is no lesser for it.
Do not dwell on it, Elder. The council has watched you win far longer than you lost.
Elder, a bout does not change one's place at the council table.
One bout is not yet fate. You know that better than I, Elder.
Elder, they say a blade is tested by defeat. Yours held.
Rest, Elder. The council can wait.
murim.approach.office.first.up.greet.1: Good day, First Disciple. The third generation looks to you.
murim.approach.office.first.up.greet.2: First Disciple! Anything you need, I am here.
murim.approach.office.first.up.greet.3: Respects, First Disciple. The juniors speak well of you.
murim.approach.office.first.up.greet.4: First Disciple, good day! The third generation looks up to you.
murim.approach.office.first.up.greet.5: First Disciple, I only came to bow. Go about your business.
murim.approach.office.first.up.greet.6: Respects, First Disciple. The yard is even today, the way you like it.
murim.approach.office.first.up.spar.1: First Disciple, will you spar with me? I want to see how you hold the line.
murim.approach.office.first.up.spar.2: First Disciple, a bout, with your leave? A loss will not offend me.
murim.approach.office.first.up.spar.3: First Disciple, one bout? I want to check my stance against yours.
murim.approach.office.first.up.spar.4: First Disciple, I need a good opponent. You are the best.
murim.approach.office.first.up.spar.5: First Disciple, allow me to trade blows. I have much to learn from you.
murim.approach.office.first.up.spar.6: First Disciple, on the square I will grow better. A bout, please.
murim.approach.office.first.up.table.1: First Disciple, the porridge is out. Come and sit with us.
murim.approach.office.first.up.table.2: First Disciple, the meal. We will not begin without you.
murim.approach.office.first.up.table.3: To the common table, First Disciple. The juniors will be pleased.
murim.approach.office.first.up.table.4: First Disciple, the bowl is hot, the seat is free.
murim.approach.office.first.up.table.5: Let us eat, First Disciple. The porridge is thicker than usual.
murim.approach.office.first.up.table.6: First Disciple, we saved you a seat beside us. Will you join us?
murim.approach.office.first.up.formation: First Disciple, the bell has rung. The line waits for you to lead it.
First Disciple, the line is gathering. The juniors await your sign.
The bell, First Disciple. The rows will not stand even without you.
First Disciple, the dawn line is yours. We are ready.
First Disciple, the mentor is on the dais. The rows stand.
First Disciple, to the line, please. Set the beat and we will follow.
First Disciple, we heard of your win. The third generation is proud.
First Disciple, what a bout! The juniors already copy your stance.
First Disciple, the whole yard is talking of your bout!
What a bout, First Disciple! If only I could someday.
First Disciple, accept the congratulations of the third generation.
First Disciple, we are proud of you. No less than you are of us.
murim.approach.office.first.up.console.1: First Disciple, one bout is only one bout. We still follow you.
murim.approach.office.first.up.console.2: First Disciple, chin up. The third generation saw how bravely you fought.
murim.approach.office.first.up.console.3: First Disciple, do not be downcast. We saw how you held yourself.
murim.approach.office.first.up.console.4: First Disciple, a lost bout does not take away an office.
murim.approach.office.first.up.console.5: Head up, First Disciple. The third generation will not abandon you.
murim.approach.office.first.up.console.6: First Disciple, rest. We will bring water.
murim.approach.office.first.peer.greet.1: Good day, First Disciple. You carry the juniors well.
murim.approach.office.first.peer.greet.2: First Disciple. When you have a moment, tell me how the juniors fare.
murim.approach.office.first.peer.greet.3: Well met. The sect trusts you with its youngest, and so do I.
murim.approach.office.first.peer.greet.4: First Disciple. You hold the office, you hold the generation. Good.
murim.approach.office.first.peer.greet.5: Hello. The juniors have visibly pulled themselves up. I know whose credit it is.
murim.approach.office.first.peer.greet.6: First Disciple. No extras: keep it up.
murim.approach.office.first.peer.table.1: First Disciple, the meal is served. Will you sit with me?
murim.approach.office.first.peer.table.2: First Disciple, the meal. Sit, we will talk of the juniors over porridge.
murim.approach.office.first.peer.table.3: Let us eat. You lead a generation, save your strength.
murim.approach.office.first.peer.table.4: First Disciple, the bowl is hot. Do not leave it for the juniors.
murim.approach.office.first.peer.table.5: Sit at the table. An office is an office, but one must eat.
murim.approach.office.first.peer.table.6: First Disciple, the table is set. There is always a bench for you.
murim.approach.office.first.peer.formati: First Disciple, the line is forming. The juniors keep their eyes on you.
First Disciple, formation. Set the rhythm, the rest will follow.
The bell. Your row is waiting, First Disciple.
First Disciple, to formation. Show them how to hold a form.
Without you the line will not stand even. Hurry, First Disciple.
Time for the line. Let the juniors see how an office stands.
murim.approach.office.first.peer.congrat: Word of your bout reached me. A win like that does credit to the juniors you lead.
Well fought, First Disciple. The sect noticed.
A good bout, First Disciple. The juniors will retell it for a week.
First Disciple, your bout is a good example. May it stay so.
A win. Calm and deserved. As it should be.
First Disciple, the sect is proud. So am I, though I say nothing.
murim.approach.office.first.peer.console: A lost bout, First Disciple. It teaches those who lead as well as those who follow.
Do not let it weigh on you, First Disciple. Rest, then try again.
First Disciple, a defeat teaches the one who leads. Learn.
It happens. What matters is how you step into the next.
Do not take it to heart, First Disciple. The yard will forget in a day.
Rest. An office does not break over one bout.
murim.sect.absence.elder.1.1: Elder, welcome back. Your seat in the council hall stood empty for a day.
murim.sect.absence.elder.1.2: Elder! A day without word from you. I trust all is well?
murim.sect.absence.elder.1.3: Elder, glad to see you again. The day was quiet without you.
murim.sect.absence.elder.1.4: Elder, welcome back. The council kept your seat and your tea.
murim.sect.absence.elder.3.1: Elder, three days and more. The council asked after you more than once.
murim.sect.absence.elder.3.2: Welcome back, Elder. The mountain felt your absence, and the council kept your place.
murim.sect.absence.elder.3.3: Elder, three days away and the mountain noticed. Welcome.
murim.sect.absence.elder.3.4: Welcome back, Elder. The council's business awaited you with impatience.
murim.sect.absence.elder.7.1: Elder, a whole week! We feared the road had kept you. Thank heaven you are back.
murim.sect.absence.elder.7.2: Elder, more than a week away. The sect kept your seat warm, and we are glad to see you.
murim.sect.absence.elder.7.3: Elder, a week away, and we were already discussing how to search for you. Thank heaven we did not need to.
murim.sect.absence.elder.7.4: Welcome back, Elder. The mountain grew quieter without you than it should.
murim.sect.absence.first.1.1: First Disciple, welcome back. The juniors looked for you at the line.
murim.sect.absence.first.1.2: First Disciple, a day without you. The third generation felt it.
murim.sect.absence.first.1.3: First Disciple, welcome back. The line was even, but not yours.
murim.sect.absence.first.1.4: First Disciple, a day without you. The juniors held the row as you taught.
murim.sect.absence.first.3.1: First Disciple, three days and more. The juniors kept asking where you had gone.
murim.sect.absence.first.3.2: Welcome back, First Disciple. The line was thin without its leader.
murim.sect.absence.first.3.3: First Disciple, three days. The third generation held, but waited for you.
murim.sect.absence.first.3.4: Welcome back, First Disciple. Your place in the line was kept.
murim.sect.absence.first.7.1: First Disciple, a whole week! The third generation was beginning to worry.
murim.sect.absence.first.7.2: First Disciple, more than a week away. Good to have you back where you belong.
murim.sect.absence.first.7.3: First Disciple, a week! The juniors began to wonder where you went.
murim.sect.absence.first.7.4: Welcome back, First Disciple. The mountain remembers its own, and you it.
dialogue.murim.bout.menu.mentor_office: One of the first generation. A bout is safe; he will not hold back, and a loss costs you nothing.
dialogue.murim.bout.menu.senior_office: A senior of the second generation. A bout on the square is safe and counts for nothing but the sect's respect.
dialogue.murim.bout.menu.junior_office: A junior, below your seat. A training bout, if you like: safe, and a chance to show him a form.
murim.bubble.bout.respect_office.1: Well fought. I yield with honour.
murim.bubble.bout.respect_office.2: You earned that one. The seat suits you.
murim.bubble.bout.respect_office.3: Strong. I will train harder next time.
murim.bubble.bout.respect_office.4: A worthy bout, no yielding next time.
murim.bubble.bout.respect_office.5: Your office is not for nothing.
murim.bubble.bout.respect_office.6: I have much to learn from you.
murim.sect.defeat.reason.peer.qi: Your qi ran dry (down to %4$s%% in the bout). Pace it: a long exchange is won on reserve.
murim.sect.defeat.reason.peer.hits: You took %1$s hits and landed %2$s. You stood on the line of the blow. A half step aside turns the count.
murim.sect.defeat.reason.peer.far: You kept %3$s blocks away and landed %2$s hits. You never closed in. The exchange begins inside the reach.
murim.sect.defeat.reason.peer.close: You stood %3$s blocks from him and took %1$s hits. Too close to swing or to evade. A little more distance.
murim.sect.defeat.reason.peer.passive: You landed only %2$s hits. You waited for him. A first strike would have changed the bout.
murim.sect.defeat.drill_say_peer: If you wish to work on it today: %s
dialogue.murim.office.spar.1: The honour is mine, %s. To half strength, with your leave.
dialogue.murim.office.spar.2: %s, thank you for the invitation. I will bow first. I will be glad to learn from you.
dialogue.murim.disciple.busy_office.1: Forgive me, %s, a bout is under way!
dialogue.murim.disciple.busy_office.2: %s, one moment! We are in the middle of a bout.
dialogue.murim.disciple.opt.guide: Would you show me the way?
dialogue.murim.hwang_sol.personal.1: Bound for a sect, traveller? We share a road: Mount Hua.
dialogue.murim.hwang_sol.personal.2: Your stride could use a teacher. There is room on Mount Hua.
dialogue.murim.hwang_sol.personal.3: Wait, traveller. The mountain is taking disciples. Interested?
dialogue.murim.hwang_sol.personal.4: You carry a sword. Have a teacher? Mount Hua has them.
dialogue.murim.hwang_sol.personal.5: I come from Mount Hua. We are short of hands. Glad we met.
dialogue.murim.hwang_sol.personal.6: Looking for a sect? Ours is near. I can point it out.
dialogue.murim.jang_cheol.personal.1: To a sect? Mount Hua, then. I am headed there too.
dialogue.murim.jang_cheol.personal.2: Your walk says you need a teacher. Mount Hua is still taking pupils.
dialogue.murim.jang_cheol.personal.3: Hey! The mountain is taking disciples. Want in?
dialogue.murim.jang_cheol.personal.4: A sword, but no teacher? Go to Mount Hua.
dialogue.murim.jang_cheol.personal.5: A good meeting. I am from Mount Hua. We need working hands.
dialogue.murim.jang_cheol.personal.6: Looking for a sect? Mount Hua is close.
dialogue.murim.mok_rin.personal.1: Going to the sect? I am headed for Mount Hua too.
dialogue.murim.mok_rin.personal.2: Watching your step, I would say you need a teacher. Mount Hua has room.
dialogue.murim.mok_rin.personal.3: Traveller. Mount Hua is accepting disciples. Does that interest you?
dialogue.murim.mok_rin.personal.4: I see a sword. Who teaches you? If no one does, come to Mount Hua.
dialogue.murim.mok_rin.personal.5: Glad we met. I am from Mount Hua; the mountain is still short of hands.
dialogue.murim.mok_rin.personal.6: Looking for a sect? Ours is not far from here.
dialogue.murim.disciple_a.personal.1: Whatever the teacher says: half-strength bouts, posts, forms behind the ranks. Sand for me today.
dialogue.murim.disciple_a.personal.2: Fall from the posts, start over. Forty times now. My legs remember each.
dialogue.murim.disciple_a.personal.3: Posts all morning, sand after lunch. By evening, nothing but blisters.
dialogue.murim.disciple_a.personal.4: Both hands on the sword. It keeps getting heavier. How?
dialogue.murim.disciple_a.personal.5: Forms behind the ranks today. Everyone watches. The seniors see every mistake too.
dialogue.murim.disciple_a.personal.6: Off the post, back up. Down again. That is my practice.
dialogue.murim.disciple_b.personal.1: Half-strength bouts, posts or forms behind the ranks: the teacher decides. He gave me sand.
dialogue.murim.disciple_b.personal.2: After a fall from the posts, start again. I have started forty times. No joke.
dialogue.murim.disciple_b.personal.3: Posts in the morning. Sand after lunch. My hands are all blisters by evening.
dialogue.murim.disciple_b.personal.4: Two hands on the sword, and it is no lighter. Heavier even. Do you understand?
dialogue.murim.disciple_b.personal.5: Forms behind the ranks for me today. Everyone looks; the seniors spot the mistakes.
dialogue.murim.disciple_b.personal.6: Fall, stand up. Off the post again, up again. Nothing else to tell about practice.
dialogue.murim.second.busy_office.1: A bout is under way, %s. Forgive me; I will be with you after.
dialogue.murim.second.busy_office.2: Not now, %s, with your leave: a bout.
dialogue.murim.second.opt.guide: Senior, would you show me the way?
dialogue.murim.first.busy_office.1: In the middle of a form, %s. A moment.
dialogue.murim.first.busy_office.2: One moment, %s. I will finish the form and come to you.
dialogue.murim.first.opt.guide: Senior, would you show me the way?
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.office.1: %s! Please, come through. I will tell the others to tidy up. Yes, we are a disorderly lot. But all of us are loyal to you.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.office.2: Everything's in order here, %s. Almost. Bok Manseok is loud, but in order.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.office.3: Oh, %s! I won't ask you for paper. …Well, not today.
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.office.1: %s! Ahem. Greetings! I'm very proper today, I swear.
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.office.2: Make way, make way, it's %s! I'll just hide the bread.
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.office.3: %s! Nearly called out to you the old way. Will you be at supper? I will save you a seat.
dialogue.murim.mok_hayeon.office.3: …Come through, %s. There is room for both of us.
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.office.1: %s, welcome. The accounts are in order, and I would be glad to show them.
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.office.2: Honored %s, I ask no gift of you. It is welcome enough that you came in person.
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.office.3: %s! I will close the ledger. I always put the reckoning aside for you.
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.office.1: %s. If you need anything carried or chopped, I'm the man.
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.office.2: Morning, %s. The firewood is stacked. Nobody got hurt. Mostly.
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.office.3: %s. I will let you through. I can at least help you that much.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.office.1: %s. I am checking how the second generation trains. Here is my notebook, open. We can go over the mistakes if you wish.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.office.2: Greetings, %s. The disciples are on the training ground; I have my notebook. The mistakes are recorded, but they still need correcting.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.office.3: %s. The training ground is free. Put the weapons away after practice.
dialogue.murim.steward.office.1: %s! Everything is counted, everything is in its place. Almost everything.
dialogue.murim.steward.office.2: Please, %s. If the sect's stores can serve you, only say so.
dialogue.murim.steward.office.3: %s, welcome. I will send the ledger to the council whenever you ask.
dialogue.murim.steward.office.4: %s, your page in the book has not a blot. I wish I could say it of all.
dialogue.murim.steward.office.5: Good day, %s. If you need stores, say so: we'll find them, record them, and not quarrel.
dialogue.murim.steward.office.6: %s! I won't make you sign a receipt. Almost.
dialogue.murim.cook.office.1: %s! Sit, sit. I'll bring the bowl myself. Don't tell the juniors.
dialogue.murim.cook.office.2: %s, the porridge is hot and the nuts are in. Will you eat?
dialogue.murim.cook.office.3: Good to see you, %s. There is always a clean bowl for you.
dialogue.murim.cook.office.4: %s, I kept a pot on the coals for you. Don't tell the others.
dialogue.murim.cook.office.5: Sit down, %s. I haven't seen you eat standing still in a while.
dialogue.murim.cook.office.6: %s, here is fresh porridge. With your standing, I will not serve it cold.
dialogue.murim.porter.office.1: Make way for %s! I'll put the sack down.
dialogue.murim.porter.office.2: %s, it's a hundred steps to the storeroom. Whatever you need, I'll carry it.
dialogue.murim.porter.office.3: Honored %s, I will not keep you waiting. The load can wait.
dialogue.murim.porter.office.4: %s, the sack can wait. Say where and what, and I'll carry it.
dialogue.murim.porter.office.5: I give you the steps, %s. Though they are crowded.
dialogue.murim.porter.office.6: Honoured %s. No need for ceremony with me: I have hands for anything.
dialogue.murim.porter.office.7: %s, the storehouse is clear. If you need a load moved, tell me where.
dialogue.murim.porter_jang.personal.1: A hundred steps with the sack, a hundred more from gate to stores. Make room.
dialogue.murim.porter_jang.personal.2: The guild carries to the foot. On the steps, the load is ours.
dialogue.murim.porter_jang.personal.3: However many sacks, only one back. It has not cracked yet; I carry on.
dialogue.murim.porter_jang.personal.4: In a hurry? Pass higher up. These steps are narrow.
dialogue.murim.porter_jang.personal.5: The guild shouts: faster. Shouting will not shorten the steps.
dialogue.murim.porter_jang.personal.6: That is no complaint. I count the steps aloud.
dialogue.murim.porter_oh.personal.1: Step aside. A hundred steps with a sack, as many again from gate to stores.
dialogue.murim.porter_oh.personal.2: The guild brings it below. We carry it up ourselves.
dialogue.murim.porter_oh.personal.3: The sacks change; the back stays. When it cracks, I will stop.
dialogue.murim.porter_oh.personal.4: No room to pass here. In a hurry? Overtake me higher up.
dialogue.murim.porter_oh.personal.5: Let the guild shout faster. What do the steps care?
dialogue.murim.porter_oh.personal.6: You listen as if I were complaining. That is my count of the steps.
dialogue.murim.gardener.office.1: Come through, %s. The ginseng is here: come and look whenever you wish.
dialogue.murim.gardener.office.2: %s, if the council wants herbs, say which, and I'll cut them fresh.
dialogue.murim.gardener.office.3: %s, keep to the path. Those shoots only came up yesterday.
dialogue.murim.gardener.office.4: %s, a handful of fresh mint for your supper. Don't ask where from.
dialogue.murim.gardener.office.5: Good day, %s. Please keep to the path; these shoots are still young.
dialogue.murim.gardener.office.6: %s, if the council needs a tincture, here it is, I do not begrudge it.
dialogue.murim.sweeper.office.1: %s. The path is clean for you. Forty years have taught me how to sweep.
dialogue.murim.sweeper.office.2: Good day, %s. The plum petals will wait for your step.
dialogue.murim.sweeper.office.3: %s. People judge the sect by its courtyard. They judge it by you now too.
dialogue.murim.sweeper.office.4: %s, I rubbed the step bright for you. I did it for you; rank had nothing to do with it.
dialogue.murim.sweeper.office.5: Good day, %s. The yard is swept the way you like it: without fuss.
dialogue.murim.sweeper.office.6: %s. Forty years of sweeping. In all that time I have met few to match you.
dialogue.murim.sweeper.office.7: %s, I have swept this side. The steps by the gate are next.
dialogue.murim.water_carrier.office.1: %s! The first bucket is yours, if you are thirsty.
dialogue.murim.water_carrier.office.2: %s, the well is deep and cold. Drink, and I'll draw again.
dialogue.murim.water_carrier.office.3: Good day, %s. Not a drop spilled on your path today.
dialogue.murim.water_carrier.office.4: %s, here is a clean ladle. Drink. And I offer you my bow willingly.
dialogue.murim.water_carrier.office.5: Good day, %s. For you, water from the very bottom, where it's coldest.
dialogue.murim.water_carrier.office.6: %s, I am here at the well. How may I serve you?
dialogue.murim.water_carrier.office.7: %s, the dipper is on the well rim. I will draw fresh water.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.topics_office.1: Of course, %s. What would you like to know? I keep an honest record of everything.
dialogue.murim.ham_doyun.topics_office.2: %s, ask anything. I only worry out loud; I never mind questions.
dialogue.murim.bok_manseok.topics_office: %s, ask away! I know everything. Well, almost. For you I'll learn the rest by evening.
Oh, %s is asking me in person! Go on! I will answer loudly enough for the seniors to hear too.
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.topics_office.1: %s, ask. For you, even time is free.
dialogue.murim.seo_gyu.topics_office.2: Of course, %s. The ledgers will wait; they always do.
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.topics_office.1: Ask, %s. I'll answer if I know.
dialogue.murim.seo_ho.topics_office.2: %s, ask what you like. I am a plain man; I will answer plainly.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.topics_office.1: Go ahead, %s. One question at a time; I have not finished my notes.
dialogue.murim.seo_rang.topics_office.2: %s, I am listening. Ask what you want to know.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_on.office_elder.1: Elder. The yard is quiet. Good.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_on.office_elder.2: Elder. No ceremony. Say what you need, and I will do it.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_on.office_first.1: First Disciple. You hold the line. Good.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_on.office_first.2: First Disciple. The juniors watch you. They see a straight back.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_on.personal.1: Your weight is on your heels. Middle of the foot. Repeat the step.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_on.personal.2: You are on your heels. Move your weight to midfoot; step again.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_on.personal.3: The heels carry all your weight. Shift to midfoot. Repeat.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_on.personal.4: You withdrew the sword early. Finish the line. The next strike can wait.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_on.personal.5: The line is unfinished, but the sword is leaving. Finish it. Then the next.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_on.personal.6: Do not hurry the sword back. The whole line first, then another strike.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_dan.office_elder.1: Elder. The juniors call me harsh. To you they will say nothing at all.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_dan.office_elder.2: Elder. If a junior of mine gives you cause for complaint, tell me. I will see to it.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_dan.office_first.1: First Disciple. You are gentler with the juniors than I am. Good: they need both.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_dan.office_first.2: First Disciple. When a junior will not listen to you, send him to me. I do not hear excuses.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_dan.personal.1: On your heels again. Shift to midfoot. Start the step over!
dialogue.murim.gyeong_dan.personal.2: Rooted by the heels? Weight to midfoot. Repeat that step.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_dan.personal.3: You are on your heels! Weight to midfoot and repeat.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_dan.personal.4: Too soon with the sword! Finish the line before the next strike.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_dan.personal.5: Again. Keep the sword out until the line is done. Then the next.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_dan.personal.6: Finish the line! Bring the sword back after it, before the next strike.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ha.office_elder.1: Elder. The ledge by the east stair is crumbling again. I will have it marked.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ha.office_elder.2: Elder. If the council's table needs herbs, I know where they grow.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ha.office_first.1: First Disciple. The path to the east cliff crumbles; keep the juniors off it.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ha.office_first.2: First Disciple. These cliffs I knew before the sword. Ask me if the juniors need a safe path.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ha.personal.1: Look at your feet: weight on the heels. Shift to midfoot and repeat.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ha.personal.2: You lingered on your heels. Find midfoot. Now the same step.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ha.personal.3: I see the weight on your heels. Move it to midfoot and step again.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ha.personal.4: See where the line broke? The sword came back early. Finish, then strike again.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ha.personal.5: The sword is coming back, but the line is unfinished. Finish it first.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ha.personal.6: The next strike can wait. You withdrew before the line ended; finish it.
Elder. I was on this mountain before the new bell. You wear the seat well.
Elder. Sit if you like. The old bench by the pines is still the best seat on the mountain.
First Disciple. I saw the third generation arrive, one by one. You are the first to lead them; it suits you.
First Disciple. The old bench by the pines is free. A leader should sit sometimes.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ryun.personal.1: Ha, the heels again. I stood like that too. Weight to midfoot; repeat.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ryun.personal.2: Heels will not take you far. Weight to midfoot. Once more.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ryun.personal.3: A familiar stance: all weight on the heels. Shift to midfoot and repeat.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ryun.personal.4: Heh, sword going home already? Finish the line, then strike again.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ryun.personal.5: I used to hurry the sword back too. The whole line, then the next strike.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_ryun.personal.6: The sword came back early. Finish the line; the next strike will wait.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_pil.office_elder.1: Elder. A brush is held lightly, and so is an office. I see you have learned both.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_pil.office_elder.2: Elder, welcome. If the juniors' basics trouble you, tell me; the White Plum Hall is open to your inspection.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_pil.office_first.1: First Disciple. I taught you the brush; now you teach it. Teach it gently.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_pil.office_first.2: First Disciple, the formation is better when you stand in the front row. The juniors copy what they see.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_tak.office_elder.1: Elder. The gate holds. Nobody passes who should not.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_tak.office_elder.2: Elder, for you the gate is open. Day or night.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_tak.office_first.1: First Disciple. The Leader speaks of you. He says the gate need not worry about your generation now.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_tak.office_first.2: First Disciple, the gate knows you. Come and go as your office needs.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_cho.office_elder.1: Elder. Your hands are steady, but do eat. An empty dantian holds no qi, elder or not.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_cho.office_elder.2: Elder, the pavilion is open to your inspection. The pills are for those who earn them, and for those who run the sect.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_cho.office_first.1: First Disciple. Your juniors fill my clinic after every spar. Send them to me before they limp.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_cho.office_first.2: First Disciple, you look rested. Good. A leader who collapses helps nobody.
dialogue.murim.tae_gyun.office_elder.1: Fellow elder. The ledger balances today. Do not tell the others; they will want to spend it.
dialogue.murim.tae_gyun.office_elder.2: Elder, welcome to the council. Your seat comes with a small stipend and a large pile of paper.
dialogue.murim.tae_gyun.office_first.1: First Disciple. Your merit entries are tidy. That is the highest praise I know.
dialogue.murim.tae_gyun.office_first.2: First Disciple, the paper is counted. If the juniors need a sheet, say so. One sheet.
dialogue.murim.tae_rok.office_elder.1: Elder. The scriptures are open to you; between us no pass is needed.
dialogue.murim.tae_rok.office_elder.2: Elder, I have watched the second row all morning. If you have an eye to spare, tell me what you see.
dialogue.murim.tae_rok.office_first.1: First Disciple. The Hall of Scriptures is open to you by day. Read, and teach the juniors to read.
dialogue.murim.tae_rok.office_first.2: First Disciple, the second row is half a beat behind. You lead this generation—give it the right rhythm.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.office_elder.1: Brother of the council, sit down. I still find myself about to call you child. Forgive an old man that habit.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.office_elder.2: Elder. A candle for the annals stands in your name now, as a joke. But sit, and tell me what you saw on your rounds.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.office_first.1: First Disciple. The juniors will bring you their questions now. If you do not know an answer, ask your instructor.
dialogue.murim.tae_seong.office_first.2: First Disciple, the annals will record your office. Come and tell me what to write.
dialogue.murim.plum_witness.recognized_o: The Twenty-Four Plum movements, in the hands of the %s. Well done. The council has seen them rarely; guard the art well.
%s, the Twenty-Four Plum Movements. We will discuss them among ourselves in council.
murim.bubble.thunder.7: The old ones say a storm brings luck.
murim.bubble.contract.done.gyeong_cho.1: The herbs are fresh. Good work.
murim.bubble.contract.done.gyeong_cho.2: The root is whole. Rarely brought whole.
murim.bubble.contract.done.gyeong_cho.4: Careful hands. A healer needs that.
murim.bubble.contract.done.gyeong_cho.5: Put them on the table. I check all.
murim.bubble.contract.done.gyeong_cho.6: Now the brews will be on time.
murim.bubble.contract.done.gyeong_tak.1: The road is clear. As it should be.
murim.bubble.contract.done.gyeong_tak.3: Token accepted. The job is done.
murim.bubble.contract.done.gyeong_tak.5: Back alive. That is half the task.
murim.bubble.contract.done.gyeong_tak.6: The leader will hear of you.
murim.bubble.contract.done.tae_gyun.2: I will record it. Merit is not free.
murim.bubble.contract.done.tae_gyun.3: Merchant content? So is the treasury.
murim.bubble.contract.done.tae_gyun.4: The trip paid off. Not often.
murim.bubble.contract.done.tae_gyun.5: Well done. You get a candle... joking.
murim.bubble.contract.done.any.1: Good work. The sect remembers it.
murim.bubble.contract.done.any.2: You came back. That is half the task.
murim.bubble.contract.done.any.3: Well done. Rest, then the board.
murim.bubble.contract.done.any.4: The task is done. Thank you.
murim.bubble.contract.done.any.5: The sect will remember you for this.
murim.react.bout_won.lay.3: The kitchen is proud of you.
murim.react.bout_won.lay.4: A hot bowl is on me.
murim.react.bout_won.peer.3: The whole yard talks of you.
murim.react.bout_won.peer.4: I wish I could do that.
murim.react.bout_won.senior.1: Not bad. Do not get proud.
murim.react.bout_won.senior.6: A win is not the end of the road.
murim.react.bout_won.up.5: The juniors hope to watch you practise.
murim.react.bout_won.up.6: A win worthy of your seat.
murim.react.bout_lost.colleague.5: You will go over it later.
murim.react.realm_up.lay.1: We heard you have risen higher!
murim.react.realm_up.lay.2: Everyone here is talking about you.
murim.react.realm_up.peer.2: A new realm! What is it like?
murim.react.realm_up.senior.3: Do not stop at what you have.
murim.react.realm_up.up.2: All the mountain felt your breakthrough.
murim.react.star_up.lay.1: We heard you grew more skilled.
murim.react.star_up.peer.5: I wish I had an insight like that.
murim.react.star_up.senior.2: Fix it. Do not rush onward.
murim.react.star_up.up.4: Allow me to bow to the skill.
murim.react.contract.lay.1: We heard you are back from the task!
murim.react.contract.lay.2: Task off the board, well done.
murim.react.contract.lay.4: The board is shorter, thank you.
murim.react.contract.lay.5: Merit to you, thanks from us.
murim.react.contract.peer.2: What did you bring? Tell me!
murim.react.contract.peer.4: Do not forget to spend the merit.
murim.react.contract.peer.6: Reliable. That is what they say of you.
murim.react.contract.senior.3: The job is done, do not stop.
murim.react.contract.up.1: Thank you for handling the assignment.
murim.react.contract.up.4: Thank you for completing the assignment.
murim.react.contract.up.5: Mountain affairs are in safe hands.
murim.react.contract.colleague.2: The sect is in your debt.
murim.react.contract.colleague.5: That is how an office should work.
murim.react.returned.peer.1: Oh, you are back! Where were you?
murim.react.returned.senior.2: You are back. Good. How was the journey?
murim.react.returned.up.2: The mountain stood still without you.
murim.react.night_pass.lay.1: The night is dark, mind your feet.
murim.react.night_pass.lay.4: Good night, do not lose your way.
murim.react.night_pass.lay.6: The brew in the kitchen is still warm.
murim.react.night_pass.peer.6: Where are you off to this late?
murim.react.night_pass.senior.1: It is late. Go to sleep.
murim.react.night_pass.senior.2: One does not walk the yard at night.
murim.react.night_pass.senior.3: What do you seek in the dark?
murim.react.night_pass.senior.5: Sleep is worth more than night walks.
murim.react.night_pass.up.2: The post stands, do not worry.
murim.react.night_pass.up.3: A quiet night, the way you like.
murim.react.night_pass.up.4: Allow me to light your way.
murim.react.night_pass.up.5: The night is quiet, walk at ease.
murim.react.night_pass.up.6: If you need me, I am at my post.
murim.react.night_pass.colleague.5: Quiet at the gate. All calm.
murim.approach.greet.lay.1: Good day, %1$s. The paths are swept and the steps are dry. Walk easy.
murim.approach.greet.lay.2: Greetings, %1$s. I will not keep you, I only came to bow.
murim.approach.greet.lay.3: Good health to you, %1$s. The water is fresh, say so if you are thirsty.
murim.approach.greet.lay.4: Good day, %1$s. The peaks are clear today, which means good news, they say.
murim.approach.greet.lay.5: Peace to you, %1$s. If you need wood or water, call, do not be shy.
murim.approach.greet.lay.6: Greetings, %1$s. The kitchen is busy and the yard is tidy. We give what we have.
murim.approach.greet.third.1: Hey, %1$s! My legs feel borrowed after drill. Yours too?
murim.approach.greet.third.2: Hey, %1$s! The mountain is quiet today. A rare day, make use of it.
murim.approach.greet.third.3: Hey, %1$s. Hear the pines? Wind off the peak, it will turn cool by evening.
murim.approach.greet.third.4: Oh, %1$s! I have wanted to say this for a while: hang on, none of us has it easy here.
murim.approach.greet.third.5: Hi, %1$s. If you get hungry, the kitchen smells of more than porridge today.
murim.approach.greet.third.6: Hello, %1$s. I bow on the move, the mentor is watching, you understand.
murim.approach.greet.second.1: %1$s. I see your back is straight. Do not relax, the day is long.
murim.approach.greet.second.2: Good day, %1$s. If you need advice on your stance, ask, but keep it short.
murim.approach.greet.second.3: The whole yard can see you, %1$s. Carry yourself accordingly.
murim.approach.greet.second.4: Good day, %1$s. They say the third generation has new schemes. Do not get tangled in them without need.
murim.approach.greet.second.5: Hello, %1$s. As you pass, do not hurry. A hurried sword breaks first.
murim.approach.greet.second.6: %1$s. A quiet day is good for hunting your mistakes: against the silence they ring.
murim.approach.greet.first.1: %1$s. Hands in place, step even. That is enough for now.
murim.approach.greet.first.2: Hello, %1$s. No wasted words: guard your breath and do not forget the line.
murim.approach.greet.first.3: %1$s. You walk the mountain. Good. Now learn to walk it quietly.
murim.approach.greet.first.4: Good day, %1$s. A short talk: eat on time, sleep on time, keep your sword close.
murim.approach.greet.first.5: %1$s. I see you are still on your feet. By the standards here, that is something.
murim.approach.greet.first.6: Hello, %1$s. The mountain does not need the loud. It needs those who come back to the line.
murim.approach.greet.elder.1: Good day, %1$s. The mountain favours those who do not hurry the days.
murim.approach.greet.elder.2: Hello, %1$s. Allow an old man to walk beside you and ask: is all well?
murim.approach.greet.elder.3: My greetings, %1$s. The council has noted your effort. Carry on without haste.
murim.approach.greet.elder.4: A good day. The plum trees remember those who rose before dawn. Remember it too.
murim.approach.greet.elder.5: %1$s, hello. The sect needs patience as well as swords. Keep both.
murim.approach.greet.elder.6: Peace be with you, %1$s. Do not rush your questions to elders. Sometimes it is enough to be near.
murim.approach.greet.person.tae_gyun.1: %1$s. Paper costs money, a candle costs money, a disciple's time costs money too. Do not waste it.
murim.approach.greet.person.tae_gyun.2: Good day, %1$s. If you find a copper on the road, it is the sect's. I mention it only in passing.
murim.approach.greet.person.tae_rok.1: %1$s. Show me your stance... Knee lower. There. Go on with that.
murim.approach.greet.person.tae_rok.2: Hello, %1$s. A good stance can be seen from afar. Show me yours later.
murim.approach.greet.person.tae_seong.1: Child, you walked so thoughtfully that I thought to keep you company. Old men are seldom answered.
murim.approach.greet.person.tae_seong.2: Hello, %1$s. The wind is from the west today, and the chronicle likes such days.
murim.approach.greet.person.gyeong_pil.1: %1$s. The basics tolerate no gaps. If you want to grow, come to formation.
murim.approach.greet.person.gyeong_pil.2: Hello, %1$s. The sword extends the arm, but the arm must be strong first.
murim.approach.greet.person.gyeong_cho.1: %1$s. How are your hands, knees, back? Nothing aches? Then you are not training.
murim.approach.greet.person.gyeong_cho.2: Hello. I always have ointment for bruises. Drop in before you collapse.
murim.approach.greet.person.gyeong_tak.1: %1$s. The gate is watched, the mountain is calm. Go about your business.
murim.approach.greet.person.gyeong_tak.2: Hello. The leader values those who come back alive. Come back.
murim.approach.trait.greet.lazy.1: Hi, %1$s. Know where the shade is deepest around here? For work purposes, of course.
murim.approach.trait.greet.lazy.2: Oh, %1$s. If the mentor asks, I was never here. Not at all.
murim.approach.trait.greet.eager.1: %1$s! Off to the path for a hundred rounds before sunset. Come with me?
murim.approach.trait.greet.eager.2: Hi! My stance is a finger lower than yesterday. See? Do you see?!
murim.approach.trait.greet.homesick.1: Hello, %1$s. The south wind smells of the river, just like home.
murim.approach.trait.greet.homesick.2: Hi, %1$s. The letter home is in its fourth day. I have the words, not the courage.
murim.approach.trait.greet.gossip.1: %1$s! Have you heard? No, I will not say yet. But if you had, you would be amazed!
murim.approach.trait.greet.gossip.2: Hi, %1$s. They say the council argued until dark. About what, I will not say. Yet.
murim.approach.trait.greet.rival.1: %1$s. Yesterday my forms came faster than yours. Just so you know.
murim.approach.trait.greet.rival.2: Hello, %1$s. I will not yield at the next review. Pass it on.
murim.approach.trait.greet.admirer.1: %1$s, hello! The seniors fought so beautifully yesterday, I still see it.
murim.approach.trait.greet.admirer.2: Hi. I want to learn to stand like Seo Rang. Someday.
murim.approach.trait.greet.timid.1: Oh, %1$s... it is you. Phew. I thought someone was calling me out.
murim.approach.trait.greet.timid.2: Hello, %1$s. I am just passing. Just passing. Doing nothing.
murim.approach.trait.greet.glutton.1: %1$s! Is it mealtime soon? No? Then at least tell me what they serve.
murim.approach.trait.greet.glutton.2: Hi, %1$s. By any chance a spare flatbread? No? An honest question, anyway.
murim.approach.greet_evening.lay.1: Good evening, %1$s. The night will be cool, wrap up warm.
murim.approach.greet_evening.lay.2: A good evening. The yard is tidy and the lamps are lit. A quiet night to you.
murim.approach.greet_evening.lay.3: Greetings, %1$s. If you want hot water before sleep, say so.
murim.approach.greet_evening.lay.4: A fine evening, %1$s. The stars are clear tonight, as if washed.
murim.approach.greet_evening.lay.5: I will not disturb your rest, %1$s. Only to wish you a good night.
murim.approach.greet_evening.lay.6: Good evening, %1$s. Our chores are done, and it is time for you to rest.
murim.approach.greet_evening.third.1: Evening! My legs hum and my heart is light. Right, %1$s?
murim.approach.greet_evening.third.2: Hi, %1$s. Is someone singing? Or is that my tired head ringing.
murim.approach.greet_evening.third.3: Good evening, %1$s. Formation again tomorrow, so at least the evening is for breathing out.
murim.approach.greet_evening.third.4: Evening quiet is my favourite. Shall we sit, %1$s?
murim.approach.greet_evening.third.5: The stars are out. Like at home. Almost.
murim.approach.greet_evening.third.6: Supper behind, formation ahead. That is all of life, %1$s.
murim.approach.greet_evening.second.1: Good evening, %1$s. It was a long day. Sum it up: what worked, what did not.
murim.approach.greet_evening.second.2: Evening, %1$s. The best time to recall the mistakes of the day.
murim.approach.greet_evening.second.3: Qi runs smoother in the evening. Sit, breathe.
murim.approach.greet_evening.second.4: Good evening. Do not sit up late, an early rise forgives nothing.
murim.approach.greet_evening.second.5: Evening is for quiet. If there is nothing to say, let us be silent together.
murim.approach.greet_evening.second.6: Hello, %1$s. Back to the yard tomorrow. Get some sleep.
murim.approach.greet_evening.first.1: Evening. Breath even, hands loose. Rest like that.
murim.approach.greet_evening.first.2: The day is done. If you found no mistakes in it, look harder.
murim.approach.greet_evening.first.3: Good. Rest, but keep your sword near.
murim.approach.greet_evening.first.4: The night bell is soon. Do not sit up.
murim.approach.greet_evening.first.5: Evening meditation is better than talk. But a greeting is allowed.
murim.approach.greet_evening.first.6: Good evening, %1$s. The day is over. Tomorrow's dawn will not wait.
murim.approach.greet_evening.elder.1: Good evening, child. The day dragged and the evening is short, cherish it.
murim.approach.greet_evening.elder.2: The sunset over Lotus Peak is fine. Sit and watch, if you have time.
murim.approach.greet_evening.elder.3: Evening, %1$s. A time for quiet thoughts and tea.
murim.approach.greet_evening.elder.4: A good evening to you. May your breath settle and your mind clear.
murim.approach.greet_evening.elder.5: Hello, %1$s. By evening the mountains seem closer. An old man likes that.
murim.approach.greet_evening.elder.6: Peace to your evening, child. There will be work tomorrow.
murim.approach.spar.second.1: Got time? Speak to me and we will measure ourselves on the square. No stakes.
murim.approach.spar.second.2: You have not been seen on the square for a while. Speak to me if you have the nerve.
murim.approach.spar.second.3: I could use a warm-up. Speak to me and show what you have learned.
murim.approach.spar.second.4: A couple of exchanges before noon will not hurt. Speak to me and we will go to the square.
murim.approach.spar.second.5: My sword wants out. If yours does too, speak to me.
murim.approach.spar.second.6: Shall we test your stance? Speak to me. I will say what I see, no offence meant.
murim.approach.spar.third.1: Hey, a bout? Speak to me, I am in form today! Almost.
murim.approach.spar.third.2: Shall we have a friendly scrap? Speak to me and off to the square!
murim.approach.spar.third.3: My hands itch and I have no partner. Speak to me?
murim.approach.spar.third.4: A bout for glory, no stakes. Speak to me if you are not afraid.
murim.approach.spar.third.5: I need to train against someone better than me. Speak to me, will you?
murim.approach.spar.third.6: The square is free and my hands will not sit still. Speak to me and we will warm up.
murim.approach.trait.spar.lazy.1: A bout? Just a short one, I plan a nap after. Speak to me.
murim.approach.trait.spar.lazy.2: If we must fight, let it be now, before I change my mind. Speak to me.
murim.approach.trait.spar.eager.1: A bout! Please! Speak to me, I can take a hundred rounds!
murim.approach.trait.spar.eager.2: They say a bout teaches faster than a book. Speak to me, let us see!
murim.approach.trait.spar.homesick.1: A bout? At home we did this with my brothers... Speak to me.
murim.approach.trait.spar.homesick.2: A bout clears the head. Speak to me, please.
murim.approach.trait.spar.gossip.1: A bout! Everyone will come to watch and there will be something to tell. Speak to me!
murim.approach.trait.spar.gossip.2: If we meet on the square, the whole mountain will know by morning. Speak to me?
murim.approach.trait.spar.rival.1: A rematch. Speak to me, I will not yield today.
murim.approach.trait.spar.rival.2: You think you are stronger? Speak to me and prove it.
murim.approach.trait.spar.admirer.1: I want to see how you fight. Speak to me, I will try not to embarrass myself.
murim.approach.trait.spar.admirer.2: A bout? I will learn much even by losing. Speak to me.
murim.approach.trait.spar.timid.1: Um... maybe a bout? Gently, though. Speak to me...
murim.approach.trait.spar.timid.2: I was told to find a partner. Speak to me, please, I do not bite.
murim.approach.trait.spar.glutton.1: A bout before noon, while my belly is quiet! Speak to me.
murim.approach.trait.spar.glutton.2: A bout, and then to the kitchen together? Speak to me.
murim.approach.goal.lay.2: I do not dare advise, but I think this is what you need now. %1$s
murim.approach.goal.lay.3: People say you have a task waiting. %1$s
murim.approach.goal.lay.4: If you will not take it as impertinence. %1$s
murim.approach.goal.lay.5: Forgive a well-meaning soul, I will remind you. %1$s
murim.approach.goal.lay.6: It is not for me to judge, but I hear your next step is this. %1$s
murim.approach.goal.third.1: Listen, I think your next step is this. %1$s
murim.approach.goal.third.2: You have not forgotten your own business? %1$s
murim.approach.goal.third.3: A hint from one of your own. %1$s
murim.approach.goal.third.4: Let me remind you before you get swept up. %1$s
murim.approach.goal.third.5: They say it is time for you to move on. %1$s
murim.approach.goal.third.6: Take it as a friendly hint. %1$s
murim.approach.goal.second.2: Junior, here is something to work on next. %1$s
murim.approach.goal.second.3: Your next step is clear, do not delay. %1$s
murim.approach.goal.second.4: I keep an eye on the third generation. %1$s
murim.approach.goal.first.2: One goal. Do not scatter yourself. %1$s
murim.approach.goal.first.5: Cast off the extra, and this is what remains. %1$s
murim.approach.goal.elder.1: Let us look at your practice records. %1$s
murim.approach.goal.elder.4: The goal is clear, do not lose it. %1$s
murim.approach.goal.elder.6: Take it not as instruction, only as a reminder. %1$s
murim.approach.welcome.lay.1: Welcome to the mountain, %1$s. The dining hall is there, your bed is in the dormitory. If you lose your way, ask any of us.
murim.approach.welcome.lay.2: You are new here, %1$s. There is water and wood for all, take it, do not ask.
murim.approach.welcome.lay.3: We are glad of you, %1$s. The first days here are long and the nights cold, wrap up.
murim.approach.welcome.lay.4: Welcome, %1$s. The bell rings for meals, do not miss it, porridge cools fast.
murim.approach.welcome.lay.5: %1$s, are you with us for long? I would like to think so. The mountain likes those who stay.
murim.approach.welcome.lay.6: Greetings, %1$s. If something breaks or goes missing, tell us, we will find it.
murim.approach.welcome.third.1: You are new, %1$s? Hang in there, the first days are the longest. Then you get used to it. Almost.
murim.approach.welcome.third.2: Welcome, %1$s! I am usually at the end of the row, I can hint if you need it.
murim.approach.welcome.third.3: Oh, a fresh face! Hi, %1$s. If you lose your way, ask, I know almost everything here by now.
murim.approach.welcome.third.4: Hi, %1$s. The dining hall is where it smells of porridge. The dormitory is where they snore. Do not mix them up.
murim.approach.welcome.third.5: %1$s, welcome to the third generation! There are many of us, but the bench has room.
murim.approach.welcome.third.6: Hi, %1$s. The first formation is the scariest, honestly. After that it is just habit.
murim.approach.welcome.second.1: You are new here, %1$s. Remember: formation at dawn, meals by the bell. The rest as you go.
murim.approach.welcome.second.2: Welcome, %1$s. Keep your questions short and I will answer if I know.
murim.approach.welcome.second.3: %1$s. The mountain has many rules, all for a reason. Do not fear a mistake, fear not noticing it.
murim.approach.welcome.second.4: A new face in the third generation. Hello, %1$s. Try not to let the others down.
murim.approach.welcome.second.5: Greetings, %1$s. If you need help, find me after formation.
murim.approach.welcome.second.6: Welcome to Mount Hua. From here on it is your hands and your feet, %1$s.
murim.approach.welcome.first.1: %1$s. Welcome. In the first days do not rush, but do not lie about either.
murim.approach.welcome.first.2: A new disciple on the mountain. Hello, %1$s. Listen to the mentor, he knows more than he says.
murim.approach.welcome.first.3: Welcome, %1$s. The sect is poor, but honest. That is already something.
murim.approach.welcome.first.4: %1$s. The best advice for a newcomer: come to formation and eat on time. The rest follows.
murim.approach.welcome.first.5: Hello, %1$s. The mountain accepts those who stay. Stay.
murim.approach.welcome.first.6: Welcome, %1$s. Do not fear questions, fear silence when you ought to ask.
murim.approach.welcome.elder.1: Welcome to Mount Hua, %1$s. The council is glad of a new disciple.
murim.approach.welcome.elder.2: Hello, %1$s. The first days here are long, but they were for the best disciples too.
murim.approach.welcome.elder.3: Peace to you, %1$s. May the mountain become a home to you, not only a place to sleep.
murim.approach.welcome.elder.4: %1$s, welcome. Do not hurry to look around, first find your pace.
murim.approach.welcome.elder.5: I greet you, %1$s. Among the plums none is spare, there will be a place for you too.
murim.approach.welcome.elder.6: The elders are glad of every new face, %1$s. We grow old, and the mountain must grow young.
murim.approach.congrats.lay.1: We heard of your bout. Glad for you, truly.
murim.approach.congrats.lay.2: They say you fought well. The kitchen whispers of nothing else.
murim.approach.congrats.lay.3: Congratulations on the win. If the fight left you hungry, there is a bowl for you.
murim.approach.congrats.lay.4: The whole yard gossips about your bout. Enjoy it, but do not get proud.
murim.approach.congrats.lay.5: We did not see it ourselves, but people say you fought splendidly.
murim.approach.congrats.lay.6: Thank you for fighting well. It makes simple people like us feel safer.
murim.approach.congrats.third.1: They are already talking about your bout! Will you tell me how you did it?
murim.approach.congrats.third.2: Well done! Just do not make the rest of us train harder now.
murim.approach.congrats.third.3: A good bout! The third generation has something to be proud of.
murim.approach.congrats.third.4: That was strong! The rumour on the mountain is excellent.
murim.approach.congrats.third.5: A lovely bout. Will you teach me that move? A hint at least.
murim.approach.congrats.third.6: Congratulations! Just do not lose your head, it is valued here.
murim.approach.congrats.second.1: People talk of your bout. All good so far, but do not relax.
murim.approach.congrats.second.2: Not bad. For the third generation, very not bad.
murim.approach.congrats.second.3: It shows you have worked on yourself. Keep going.
murim.approach.congrats.second.4: A good bout. Now do not let success turn your head.
murim.approach.congrats.second.5: The word of your win reached the yard. Carry yourself with dignity.
murim.approach.congrats.second.6: Handsome. But there were still mistakes in it: find them yourself.
murim.approach.congrats.first.2: A win is good. The habit of winning is better. Keep working.
murim.approach.congrats.first.3: You found the right step. Do not forget which.
murim.approach.congrats.first.4: Well done. Now show it was no accident.
murim.approach.congrats.first.5: A good bout. The rest is a matter of time and breath.
murim.approach.congrats.first.6: Well done. Do not spend your qi on pride.
murim.approach.congrats.elder.1: I was told of your bout. The sect has the right to be proud of you.
murim.approach.congrats.elder.2: A worthy win. May it be a step, not a chair.
murim.approach.congrats.elder.3: The council noted your bout. Continue in the same spirit, but without haste.
murim.approach.congrats.elder.4: A fine bout. May your hand hold as much patience as strength.
murim.approach.congrats.elder.5: Winning is pleasant. Remembering what the win taught is more important.
murim.approach.congrats.elder.6: Your win is good news for the whole mountain.
murim.approach.console.lay.1: We heard the bout went badly. Do not grieve, bruises heal and you grow stronger.
murim.approach.console.lay.2: Losing is no shame. Our porridge fails now and then too, and nothing, we cook again.
murim.approach.console.lay.3: Sit down, rest. Shall I bring water?
murim.approach.console.lay.4: People gossip, but do not listen. Tomorrow there will be another bout.
murim.approach.console.lay.5: Do not hang your head. The mountain has seen worse falls, and everyone rose.
murim.approach.console.lay.6: A warm bowl cures all. Come to the kitchen, we give what we have.
murim.approach.console.third.1: Hey, do not be upset. Yesterday I got it three times worse.
murim.approach.console.third.2: It happens. To whom does it not, to me, for one, every week.
murim.approach.console.third.3: Losing is not scary. What is scary is not stepping back onto the yard.
murim.approach.console.third.4: Listen, let us go eat. On a full stomach defeats are shorter.
murim.approach.console.third.5: It is nothing. You know how to hold on, it shows even from afar.
murim.approach.console.third.6: Chin up. A defeat is a lesson too, only a dearer one.
murim.approach.console.second.1: A loss is not a sentence. Find the cause and remove it.
murim.approach.console.second.2: It happens. I have lost more than you think.
murim.approach.console.second.3: Do not blame yourself. Blame your breath and your feet, they can be mended.
murim.approach.console.second.4: Go to the mentor, he will go over the bout. It is more useful than pitying yourself.
murim.approach.console.second.5: Lift your head. The juniors watch how you lose and learn from you.
murim.approach.console.second.6: Rest today. Tomorrow start with the first form.
murim.approach.console.first.1: Recall the strike that cost you the bout. Start your next practice there.
murim.approach.console.first.2: The mentor will go over the bout. Come while the mistakes are fresh.
murim.approach.console.first.4: A loss does not measure a person. The next bout does.
murim.approach.console.first.5: Breathe more from the belly, not the shoulders. And do not mope.
murim.approach.console.first.6: Every one of us has fallen more than once. He rises who does not look back.
murim.approach.console.elder.1: Child, a defeat will not bend one who can listen. Listen to yourself.
murim.approach.console.elder.2: A lost bout is worth reviewing. Tell me how your opponent caught you out.
murim.approach.console.elder.3: A lost bout is a gift too, though an unpleasant one. Accept it.
murim.approach.console.elder.4: The council does not judge a bout by its outcome. It watches how the disciple rises.
murim.approach.console.elder.5: Rest. Plum trees do not bloom all year either.
murim.approach.console.elder.6: Let the pain cool. Then the lesson will show.
murim.approach.formation.lay.1: The bell has rung. Forgive the reminder: the formation is gathering.
murim.approach.formation.lay.2: Forgive me... the yard waits for formation. The mentor is already watching.
murim.approach.formation.lay.3: The line at the dais is gathering. Hurry, before it is noticed.
murim.approach.formation.lay.4: The bell called to formation, and you are still here. Hurry, please.
murim.approach.formation.lay.5: It is dawn and the yard is already full. A place at the end of the row is kept for you.
murim.approach.formation.lay.6: Do not be late: the yard is already full.
murim.approach.formation.third.1: Formation! The bell rang! Run, before Gyeong Pil counts the rows!
murim.approach.formation.third.2: Hey, formation! Take the place at the end, it is empty!
murim.approach.formation.third.3: Hear the bell? Come into line, there is still room.
murim.approach.formation.third.4: Quick, to formation! If the mentor notices, he will remind us for a week.
murim.approach.formation.third.5: Everyone is in the yard already. Do not lag, before it is noticed.
murim.approach.formation.third.6: Formation! The legs are still asleep, but they will wake on the yard.
murim.approach.formation.second.1: The bell has rung. Take your place in the line before the lateness is noted.
murim.approach.formation.second.2: The line is gathering. Your place is at the end. Do not make the row wait.
murim.approach.formation.second.3: To the yard. Now. The mentor is counting the rows.
murim.approach.formation.second.4: The whole yard hears the bell. Time to line up.
murim.approach.formation.second.5: Dawn. Formation. You know what to do.
murim.approach.formation.second.6: Do not be late, junior: the row is incomplete without you.
murim.approach.formation.first.2: The line waits. You still have time. A little.
murim.approach.formation.first.3: You are needed in the row. Come.
murim.approach.formation.first.4: Take your place before the mentor starts counting.
murim.approach.formation.first.5: Dawn has passed. The sword should already be in your hand.
murim.approach.formation.first.6: To the yard. Breath by count, form by count, sloth for later.
murim.approach.formation.elder.1: The bell has rung, child. The line waits, and the morning cannot be recalled.
murim.approach.formation.elder.2: Morning formation is the base of everything. Hurry, before the yard falls quiet.
murim.approach.formation.elder.3: To the yard, please. Even a small effort at dawn is worth much.
murim.approach.formation.elder.4: Formation time. The Six Elements wait for no one, but they accept anyone.
murim.approach.formation.elder.5: Go to formation. The mountain begins with the first step.
murim.approach.formation.elder.6: Dawn is calling. Do not be late, child: the row does not forget the late.
murim.approach.table.lay.1: The bowls are out, Auntie Kim is waiting. Please sit.
murim.approach.table.lay.2: The porridge is ready, hot. Do not stand, it will cool.
murim.approach.table.lay.3: Forgive the reminder: mealtime. The table awaits you.
murim.approach.table.lay.4: Spoons are laid, bowls are filled. To the table, please.
murim.approach.table.lay.5: The kitchen has done its best. Do not slight it, come to the counter.
murim.approach.table.lay.6: The bell called to the meal. A place is kept for you.
murim.approach.table.third.1: Porridge! Come, before it cools. I will save you a seat.
murim.approach.table.third.2: Mealtime! Take a bowl from Auntie Kim and sit by me.
murim.approach.table.third.3: Let us eat. If we are late we get the cold portions, and they are worse.
murim.approach.table.third.4: It smells of food, come! The table is always merrier.
murim.approach.table.third.5: I am already sitting! Take a bowl and join!
murim.approach.table.third.6: Come, or Bok Manseok will eat your share.
murim.approach.table.second.1: Mealtime. A bowl at the counter, a place at the common table. Hurry.
murim.approach.table.second.2: Do not skip a meal. An empty stomach is a weak sword.
murim.approach.table.second.3: There is a queue at the counter. Join it and do not push.
murim.approach.table.second.4: The porridge is ready. Eat properly, then train.
murim.approach.table.second.5: Join the table. He who eats alone eats worse.
murim.approach.table.second.6: The bell has rung. The bowl is waiting.
murim.approach.table.first.1: Mealtime. A bowl at the counter, a place at the table.
murim.approach.table.first.2: Not eaten? Fix that. An empty dantian does not hold qi.
murim.approach.table.first.3: Go to the table. Without food a form is no form.
murim.approach.table.first.4: The bowl and the table wait. You do not have much time.
murim.approach.table.first.5: Do not keep the kitchen waiting. It gets little as it is.
murim.approach.table.first.6: Food is part of training. Eat calmly, chew longer.
murim.approach.table.elder.1: Child, the meal. Elders do not like it when juniors forget the body.
murim.approach.table.elder.2: Let us share a table. You, I and a bowl of porridge is enough.
murim.approach.table.elder.3: Go to the counter. The sect is modest, but it will not leave you hungry.
murim.approach.table.elder.4: Food is part of the path. Do not neglect it.
murim.approach.table.elder.5: Sit at the common table. Talk over porridge is shorter and kinder.
murim.approach.table.elder.6: The bell has called us all. Do not lag.
murim.approach.bubble.goal.5: There is something you could do.
murim.approach.bubble.welcome.6: The first days are the hardest.
murim.approach.bubble.office.spar.6: May I ask for a bout?
murim.approach.bubble.office.table.5: A seat is kept for you.
murim.approach.bubble.office.console.3: A bout is only a bout.
murim.bubble.watch_trait.lazy.3: Watching from the bench is easier.
murim.bubble.watch_trait.lazy.4: My laziness grows and I do not.
murim.bubble.watch_trait.lazy.6: Whoa. Now it is surely time to rest.
murim.bubble.watch_trait.eager.5: Which form do I start with?
murim.bubble.watch_trait.homesick.2: They will not believe it at home.
murim.bubble.watch_trait.homesick.3: I will write my brother of it.
murim.bubble.watch_trait.homesick.4: If only someone from home saw this.
murim.bubble.watch_trait.homesick.5: Beautiful, like dawn over the river.
murim.bubble.watch_trait.homesick.6: That is worth a letter home.
murim.bubble.watch_trait.gossip.3: I tell the rest before anyone!
murim.bubble.watch_trait.gossip.4: By supper the mountain will know.
murim.bubble.watch_trait.gossip.5: Did you see? Did you see?!
murim.bubble.watch_trait.gossip.6: If only I remember the details.
murim.bubble.watch_trait.rival.3: In memory. Tomorrow I repeat it.
murim.bubble.watch_trait.rival.5: He is no better. Just first.
murim.bubble.watch_trait.rival.6: I will show better, give me time.
murim.bubble.watch_trait.admirer.6: I will remember it for life.
murim.bubble.watch_trait.glutton.2: How much qi is that? How much porridge?
murim.bubble.watch_trait.glutton.3: After that, two bowls would be fair.
murim.bubble.watch_trait.glutton.4: They spend strength and eat little.
murim.bubble.life_elders.2: Tae Rok scolds the second row.
murim.bubble.life_elders.3: Tae Seong is at the chronicle late.
murim.bubble.life_elders.6: Gyeong Tak has a face like the gate.
murim.bubble.life_elders.7: The leader smiled at council, they say.
murim.bubble.life_elders.8: Elders argue over a candle like a sword.
murim.bubble.life_train.1: My back is not my own.
murim.bubble.life_train.3: The posts are taller than yesterday.
murim.bubble.life_train.4: I will not make it to noon.

murim.mastery.learned_echo: You learned “%s”. The understanding of your higher art already lives in it.
