command.murim.sect.repairs.no_sect: This world has no baked Mount Hua sect to compare with.
murim.bubble.repair.3: Who broke the wall this time?
murim.bubble.repair.4: Mend it. Say nothing of the cost.
murim.bubble.repair.6: Count the liang. Then count again.
murim.bubble.repair_crew.1: Not the first time. We will patch it.
murim.bubble.repair_crew.3: Easy now, the plaster is fresh.
murim.bubble.repair_crew.4: A little more and it is done.
murim.bubble.guard_stop.1: Halt! That is the head of the sect.
murim.bubble.guard_stop.2: Where to? The head sees no newcomers.
murim.bubble.guard_stop.3: Back, junior. The head is not for you.
murim.bubble.guard_stop.4: Stop. Who let you near the head?
murim.bubble.guard_stop.5: Not so close. The head is busy.
murim.bubble.guard_stop_elder.1: Halt! The elder sees no one uninvited.
murim.bubble.guard_stop_elder.2: Not so fast. Who sent you here?
murim.bubble.guard_stop_elder.3: Back. Elders are not for juniors.
murim.bubble.guard_turn_back.1: Not here, disciple. Not yet for you.
murim.bubble.guard_turn_back.2: This is closed to you for now.
murim.bubble.guard_turn_back.3: Back, please. Not your place yet.
murim.bubble.guard_turn_back.5: I must ask you to leave.
murim.bubble.guide_coming.1: I will take you to the mentor. Wait!
murim.bubble.guide_coming.3: Stay there, I am on my way.
murim.bubble.guide_coming.4: The mentor waits. I will lead you.
murim.bubble.alarm_blast.3: Who is blowing up the sect?!
murim.bubble.alarm_guard.3: I see smoke. I am going!
murim.bubble.alarm_guard.5: Hold the line, I will look!
murim.bubble.alarm_servant.1: We will mend it once it calms.
murim.sect.guard.lead_out: %s: "You may not be in %s yet. Come, I will see you out."
murim.bubble.guard_stop.6: Halt, junior. Whom do you seek?
murim.bubble.guard_stop_elder.5: Wait. Elders do not take juniors.
murim.bubble.guard_turn_back.6: This door is not yet yours, disciple.
murim.bubble.guide_coming.5: Sent to guide you. Stay put.
murim.bubble.guide_coming.6: Give me a moment, I am coming.
murim.bubble.wander_greet.2: Wait, friend! I am no enemy.
murim.bubble.wander_greet.3: Good road! Spare me a word?
murim.bubble.wander_greet.6: Greetings! Might I borrow a moment?
murim.bubble.wander_hit.1: Hey! I am not your enemy!
murim.bubble.wander_hit.2: Easy! I only want to talk!
murim.bubble.wander_hit.3: Hold on! I mean no harm!
murim.bubble.wander_hit.5: Wait! Put your hand down, friend!
murim.bubble.wander_hit.6: Not a foe, friend! Lower your hand!
murim.bubble.guard_break.1: My turn to eat. Cover me.
murim.bubble.guard_break.2: Going to eat. Hold the post.
murim.bubble.guard_cover.1: I have the post. Go eat.
murim.bubble.guard_cover.5: Take your time, I am here.
murim.bubble.council.1: The treasury can't pay for more repairs.
murim.bubble.council.2: The juniors need a stricter hand.
murim.bubble.council.3: Who keeps the gate at night this week?
murim.bubble.council.4: The herb stores are running low.
murim.bubble.council.5: Rain is coming. Check the roof tiles.
murim.bubble.council.6: The juniors' review is drawing near.
murim.bubble.council.7: The guild's grain is late again.
murim.bubble.council.8: Mount Hua is quiet. Too quiet.
murim.bubble.council.9: More scrolls were copied this month.
murim.bubble.council.10: Let the third generation train longer.
murim.bubble.council.11: Peace is no excuse to leave a post.
murim.bubble.council.12: I will not sign for new robes yet.
murim.bubble.council_open.5: The mountain waits. Let us speak.
murim.bubble.council_close.4: Go, and do what we decided.
murim.bubble.dispute.1: He took my place at the poles!
murim.bubble.dispute.3: I swung first, he stepped in!
murim.bubble.dispute.5: Ask anyone, I was there first!
murim.bubble.council_door.3: Come back when the elders rise.
murim.bubble.council_door.4: The elders are at tea. Wait.
murim.bubble.council_door.5: Not now. The head is speaking.
murim.invite.bubble.council.1: The head calls the council, Elder.
murim.invite.bubble.council.3: The elders gather in the hall above.
murim.invite.bubble.council.5: You are asked to sit with the council.
murim.invite.bubble.council.6: The head wishes your seat filled.
murim.invite.bubble.audit.1: Elder Tae Gyun asks for your seal.
murim.invite.bubble.audit.2: The ledgers wait for your eyes.
murim.invite.bubble.audit.3: The Finance Hall wants an audit.
murim.invite.bubble.audit.4: Elder, the books are laid out.
murim.invite.bubble.dispute.1: Two juniors quarrel in the court.
murim.invite.bubble.dispute.2: Elder, a quarrel needs your word.
murim.invite.bubble.dispute.3: They shout at the hall's gate.
murim.invite.bubble.dispute.5: Two disciples ask for a judge.
murim.invite.bubble.lead_formation.1: First Disciple, lead us at dawn.
murim.invite.bubble.lead_formation.3: The mentor asks you to lead.
murim.invite.bubble.lead_formation.5: The line wants a leader today.
murim.invite.bubble.lead_formation.6: Gyeong Pil asks you to lead.
murim.invite.bubble.drill.1: The juniors at the poles need you.
murim.invite.bubble.drill.2: Help the juniors practise at the poles.
murim.invite.bubble.drill.3: Gyeong Pil wants you at the poles.
murim.invite.bubble.drill.4: Show the little ones a stance.
murim.invite.bubble.drill.5: The third generation needs a hand.
murim.invite.line.council: The head holds the council in the hall above the stairs, on the second floor of the Main Hall. Sit at a table if you wish; nobody will mind if you do not.
murim.invite.line.audit: Elder Tae Gyun has laid out the ledgers in the Finance Hall. Come and look them over with him, if you have the time.
murim.invite.line.dispute: Two juniors are quarrelling in the court before the Main Hall. A word from an elder would settle it, if you wish to give it.
murim.invite.line.lead_formation: Gyeong Pil asks you to lead the dawn line today. Stand in front and the juniors will follow your beat.
murim.invite.line.drill: The juniors are at the poles. A First Disciple's eye would do them good, if you care to come and correct them.
murim.sect.journey.goal.council: go to today's council of elders in the council hall
murim.sect.journey.blocker.council: second floor of the Main Hall: sit at a table, nobody minds if you do not
murim.sect.journey.goal.audit: look over the treasury books with Tae Gyun
murim.sect.journey.blocker.audit: he is in his office on the top floor of the Finance Hall: stand by his desk, it is no duty
murim.sect.journey.goal.dispute: judge the quarrel of two juniors in the court
murim.sect.journey.blocker.dispute: they argue before the Main Hall: hear them out if you wish
murim.sect.journey.blocker.lead_formatio: take the front of the formation on the square and keep the beat
murim.sect.journey.goal.drill: drill the juniors at the poles
murim.sect.journey.blocker.drill: the third generation practises at the poles on the square; stand near and watch them work
murim.office.council.scene.1: Take your cushion, Elder. We have just begun.
murim.office.council.scene.2: The treasury asks for your word on the roof repairs.
murim.office.council.scene.3: Your counsel is noted. This table is yours too.
murim.office.audit.scene.1: The ledgers are in order, Elder. Every liang is counted.
murim.office.audit.scene.2: The porters' sacks match the tally. Look, here.
murim.office.audit.scene.3: Your seal is on the page. Thank you for coming.
murim.office.dispute.scene.1: He took my place at the poles, Elder!
murim.office.dispute.scene.2: I stood there first! He never kept it!
murim.office.dispute.scene.3: Ask anyone who was at the poles at dawn!
murim.office.dispute.scene.4: We will abide by your word, Elder.
murim.office.lead_formation.scene.1: Well led, First Disciple. The line kept the beat.
murim.office.drill.scene.1: Like this, First Disciple? My knees shake.
murim.office.drill.scene.2: Now I feel it. Thanks for the correction!
murim.rank.breakthrough.shaken: Breakthrough broken off, but your qi is whole: sit and begin again
murim.bubble.breakthrough.guard.1: I am here. Do not lose focus!
murim.bubble.breakthrough.guard.2: Not one step closer! Stay seated!
murim.bubble.breakthrough.guard.3: Hold on, I will cover you!
murim.bubble.breakthrough.guard.4: Sit straight, I am beside you.
murim.sect.spar.counted.clean_done: clean strikes done: report to the teacher
murim.rank.wall.boss_trial: For Second Rate: Six Elements Sword ★6, Falling Petal Sword ★3, wins against 3 different disciples and the mentor test (30 s or 3 clean hits; he always wins, no penalty). The fortress is optional.
dialogue.murim.hook.request: Ask for a favour to do
dialogue.murim.hook.direct: Ask to become a personal disciple
dialogue.murim.hook.clean_hint: Three clean strikes: hit right after his swing, not while he winds up. Touches add up from bout to bout, and a win gives one.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.drill.1: Today's exercise: %1$s Done so far: %2$s of %3$s.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.drill.2: You were told: %1$s So far %2$s of %3$s. Keep at it.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.drill_done.1: The exercise is done. Good. Your body remembers it.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.drill_done.2: Finished already? Then rest, and come back tomorrow.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.drill_done.3: Well done. The mastery grows from such small things.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.favour.1: Good. The sect will remember it.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.favour.2: So it is done. I thank you.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.favour.3: You kept your word. That counts.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.request.1: Take it. Come back to me when it is done.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.request.2: There is always work. Do it well and report.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.request.3: Good. Do not forget to come back.
The pills are received. The sect thanks you.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.direct.1: A personal disciple walks a harder road. Show me first.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.direct.2: You ask much. Then prove it in a bout.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.direct.3: We will see what you are made of.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.personal_lesso: Show me what you have learned. We begin.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.apology.1: An apology is the first step. Go to the one you wronged.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.apology.2: Words cost little, but say them honestly.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.apology.3: Go to him and say it to his face.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.repair.1: Restitution is made with deeds. Do as you were told.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.repair.2: Bring what is owed, and the matter is closed.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.repair.3: Finish it and the sect forgets.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.ceremony.1: The ceremony begins. Kneel and be still.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.ceremony.3: Do not move. It is almost done.
Not yet. Come back a little later.
Be patient. The ceremony cannot be hurried.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.lessons.1: The lessons are held in the morning. Do not miss them.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.lessons.2: Today's lesson is not yet marked for you. Join a bout or a drill.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.lessons.3: A day without a lesson is a day lost.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.none.1: I have nothing to say about it any more.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.none.3: Nothing is asked of you here.
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.notyet.1: Not yet. You still need this: %2$s
dialogue.murim.hook.reply.notyet.3: Come back when it is done: %2$s
murim.bubble.council_escort.1: Come, you may not be here.
murim.bubble.council_escort.3: Come out while the council sits.
murim.bubble.council_escort.5: Do not trouble the elders. Come.
murim.bubble.council_escort.6: I will see you to the door.
murim.bubble.council_escort_again.2: I told you: do not enter.
murim.bubble.council_escort_again.3: Back so soon? To the door.
murim.bubble.council_escort_again.5: I warned you. This way out.
murim.bubble.council_escort_again.6: Again? Leave the council in peace.
murim.tip.bed: Sleep in your bed: you wake up here.
murim.bubble.gate_nofoe.1: Easy! I am the gate guard, no foe.
murim.bubble.gate_nofoe.2: Hey, friend! I only keep this gate.
murim.bubble.gate_nofoe.3: Hold on! Let us talk first.
murim.bubble.gate_nofoe.5: No need! Come, let us speak.
murim.bubble.gate_nofoe.6: Peace! I guard the gate, that is all.
murim.bubble.gate_halt.2: You there, stop! State your business!
murim.bubble.gate_halt.3: Stop! Whom do you seek on this mountain?
murim.bubble.gate_halt.4: Hold, stranger! Come here and be seen.
murim.bubble.gate_halt.5: Stop right there! Who are you?
murim.bubble.gate_halt.6: Hey! You on the trail, come here!
murim.bubble.gate_answer.3: Patience, I am at the door.
murim.bubble.gate_answer.5: Easy on the wood! I am here.
murim.bubble.gate_later.2: This room is closed to you for now.
murim.bubble.gate_later.3: Not yet, junior. Ask an elder.
murim.bubble.gate_later.6: Not now, do not knock again.
murim.sect.knock.shut: The door stays shut. A sect tablet in your pack would open it.
murim.sect.knock.coming: The door stays shut, but your knock was heard: somebody is coming.
murim.sect.guard.hall_turn: %s: "Only First Disciples enter the main hall. The head comes out to the court himself when he needs you."
murim.sect.gate.broken: The sect gate is broken. The guards raise the alarm.
murim.bubble.alarm_flee.5: I will wait far from here!
murim.bubble.alarm_confront.1: Stop! You blow up our halls?!
murim.bubble.alarm_confront.2: Enough! This is a sect, not a quarry!
murim.bubble.alarm_confront.3: Did you do this? Answer me!
murim.bubble.alarm_confront.4: Do not touch the hall again!
murim.bubble.alarm_confront_again.4: I will not warn you again!
murim.bubble.alarm_confront_again.5: One more and you answer to us!
murim.bubble.alarm_confront_again.6: Is this a joke to you?!
murim.bubble.lesson_invite.5: We begin when you are ready.
murim.bubble.lesson_topic.3: Do not grip the sword too tightly.
murim.bubble.conduct_gentle.2: A lesson is in progress here.
dialogue.murim.farewell.formal.1: Thank you. I will take my leave.
dialogue.murim.farewell.formal.2: I am grateful. Until we meet again.
dialogue.murim.farewell.formal.3: Forgive the trouble. I shall go.
dialogue.murim.farewell.formal.5: That is all for now. My respects.
dialogue.murim.farewell.formal.6: I will not trouble you longer.
dialogue.murim.farewell.plain.2: I will return to my duties.
dialogue.murim.farewell.plain.3: I shall keep your advice in mind.
dialogue.murim.farewell.plain.4: With your permission, I will go.
dialogue.murim.general.self.formal.1: I am %1$s, %2$s. I serve the mountain as I can.
dialogue.murim.general.self.formal.2: %1$s, %2$s of the sect. My days pass in duty.
dialogue.murim.general.self.formal.3: They call me %1$s. Here I am %2$s.
dialogue.murim.general.self.formal.4: My name is %1$s, my place is %2$s. Little more to tell.
dialogue.murim.general.self.formal.5: %1$s. My post is %2$s. Ask what you need.
dialogue.murim.general.self.formal.6: I hold the post of %2$s. My name is %1$s.
dialogue.murim.general.self.plain.1: I'm %1$s, %2$s. Nothing grand, but honest work.
dialogue.murim.general.self.plain.3: Call me %1$s. I'm %2$s, still learning the mountain.
dialogue.murim.general.self.plain.4: I'm %2$s. The name's %1$s. Been here a while.
dialogue.murim.general.self.plain.5: %1$s, %2$s. I rise early and work hard.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.1: Nothing worth repeating yet. Come back later.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.2: They say the plums bloom early this year.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.3: Folk whisper, but I keep my ears shut.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.4: Ask the guards; they hear the road first.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.5: I heard a bell at night. That is all.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.6: Rumours? Not today. The mountain is quiet.
dialogue.murim.general.opt.where: Whom do I look for, and where?
dialogue.murim.general.opt.today: What is going on in the sect today?
dialogue.murim.general.where.none: No errand for you right now. Ask the seniors, or open your tablet for the map.
dialogue.murim.general.today.formation: It is the morning formation. Take your place in the yard.
dialogue.murim.general.today.breakfast: It is breakfast. The hall is open for the meal.
dialogue.murim.general.today.training: It is the training hour. The yard rings with practice.
dialogue.murim.general.today.dinner: It is dinner, and the hall is busy.
dialogue.murim.general.today.evening: Evening: free hours. Rest or train as you wish.
dialogue.murim.general.today.night: It is night. The sect sleeps; keep your voice low.
murim.loadout.sort.name: Name ↕
murim.loadout.breathing.busy: Change breathing only outside combat and meditation.
dialogue.murim.basics.menu: What would you like to understand? You can ask me again whenever you need.
dialogue.murim.basics.offer: Before you practise alone, I can explain qi, meditation and the rest. Ask now, or come back to the basics whenever you wish.
dialogue.murim.basics.qi: Qi is energy stored inside you. Techniques that use qi spend it; outer forms can work without it. Meditation gathers more. Purity tells you how clean the qi is; its nature must suit the technique.
dialogue.murim.basics.dantian: The dantian is your inner store of qi. Its capacity sets the size of your reserve. Learn a breathing method, then form its seed through meditation. More stored qi alone does not raise your rank: you must break through.
dialogue.murim.basics.meditation:
Learn a breathing method and sit on firm ground. Once your dantian forms, meditation replenishes qi. Stay seated during absorption or a breakthrough; standing will interrupt it.

[Meditation: %s]
dialogue.murim.basics.methods: A method is the route qi follows through your body. Read its manual and choose it before sitting. It shapes the qi’s nature and purity. The method and the activity are separate: Cleansing gathers qi; Echo understands an art.
dialogue.murim.basics.stars: Mastery grows through practice, fights and spars. Settle the reserve through the art’s Echo or a night in bed. A manuscript can limit your learning.
dialogue.murim.basics.breakthroughs: The path is Third, Second, First, Peak. Fill qi to the wall, meet the next rank’s condition, then meditate. After the warning, let the breakthrough finish: interruption can injure you and cost qi. Rising during the warning only postpones it.
dialogue.murim.basics.body:
Vary your walking, running, climbing, swimming, work and combat: each activity has a daily limit.
For harder training, carry the stone uphill, run from the lower gate to the sect or climb the south cliff. Some of your earlier work also counts.
dialogue.murim.basics.pills: Eat the pill, then promptly sit to meditate until absorption finishes. Rising interrupts it; unabsorbed benefit goes to reserve. Being hit during absorption can cause qi deviation. Find a safe place; unusual pills have their own dangers.
dialogue.murim.basics.seed: Feel the qi. Gather it steadily, neither letting it scatter nor crushing it too soon. When it holds together, compress it into a seed before you rise.
dialogue.murim.basics.echo: Sit with a known art’s book or page, or a sword held in its foundation. Give its memories time to settle into understanding. Rising too soon interrupts the Echo; empty hands lead to Cleansing.
dialogue.murim.basics.insight: Near completion, experience alone will not suffice. Seek insight in sparring and the meditation Echo. Practice at the wall is kept; seek a deeper manuscript if yours has reached its limit.
dialogue.murim.basics.readiness: Fill qi to the wall and harden your body. For Third Rate, make an art familiar. For Second Rate, settle the Six into the middle layers, learn Falling Petal, win against three different disciples and pass my test. For First Rate, bring Seven Plum to the middle layers; for the Peak, well past the middle. Then seek almost complete and complete mastery.

npc.murim.seo_han.title: Wandering Disciple of Mount Hua
dialogue.murim.seo_han.greet.1: Peace on your road, traveller. I am a disciple of Mount Hua, and I walk the roads for a while. The sect is taking disciples — care to join us?
dialogue.murim.seo_han.greet.2: Well met. You do not look like you belong to these parts. I am from Mount Hua, myself far from home. Looking for a teacher? Mount Hua is accepting now.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.greet.3: A quiet day for walking. I wear the plum of Mount Hua, though the road has kept me from the mountain for some time. Let me be plain: the Mount Hua Sect seeks disciples.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.who.1: Seo Han, of the second generation. The elders send us out to see the world, and I am still learning what it teaches.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.who.2: Only a second-generation disciple of Mount Hua. I carry no fame, just a sword, a worn pair of shoes and my master's advice.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.who.3: I am Seo Han. A sect is not only its walls, so some of us walk. When my road ends, I go home.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.point.1: That way. Walk until you see the mist over the peaks.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.point.2: There, past the hills. Keep it ahead of you and do not turn away until the white cliffs rise.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.point.3: Over there. You will know it when the clouds sit low on the stone.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.bye.1: Go with a steady heart. If the gate opens for you, say my name to the elders.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.bye.2: The mountain waits for those who walk to it. Safe road.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.bye.3: May the wind be at your back. We may meet again on the mountain.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.member.1: Brother, I have not seen you at the training ground yet. Forgive me, my road is long.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.member.2: A disciple of Hua, then. May our paths cross again at the mountain.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.member.3: Good to see the plum on a fellow traveller. Walk well.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.greet.4: Well met, traveller. Seo Han of Mount Hua, at your service. Ever thought of learning the way of the sword? Mount Hua is open.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.greet.5: Hello, friend. I am travelling to learn what the roads can teach a disciple of Mount Hua. If you seek strength, Mount Hua takes new disciples.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.greet.6: Rest your hand, traveller. I bring greetings from Mount Hua. The sect calls those with will. Maybe that is you?
dialogue.murim.seo_han.who.4: My name is Seo Han, a second-generation disciple of Mount Hua. My elders sent me to learn beyond our gates.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.who.5: I belong to the second generation of Mount Hua. The road is part of our training, too.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.who.6: Seo Han of Mount Hua. I practise the sword, and try to bring home more wisdom than dust.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.point.4: Follow my hand. Keep walking that way until mist gathers over the peaks.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.point.5: There, in the direction I am pointing. Look for the mist hanging over the mountain.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.point.6: That way lies Mount Hua. Walk on until you see its peaks beneath the mist.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.bye.4: May your journey be peaceful. Tell them Seo Han sent you when you reach the gates.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.bye.5: Safe travels, friend. Perhaps our next conversation will be on Mount Hua.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.bye.6: Keep your eyes on the road and your heart steady. Farewell.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.member.4: A fellow disciple on the road! May your journey go well.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.member.5: Greetings, brother of Mount Hua. We will meet again beneath the plum trees.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.member.6: Good to see one of our own so far from home. Peace on your road.
murim.bubble.guide_welcome.1: Come, I will take you to the mentor.
murim.bubble.guide_welcome.2: This way. I lead you to the mentor.
murim.bubble.guide_welcome.4: Walk with me. The mentor is near.
murim.bubble.guide_welcome.6: Stay close, I know the way.
murim.bubble.guide_wait.5: I am here. Do not lag!
murim.bubble.guide_back.1: You do not come? Back to my post.
murim.bubble.guide_back.2: I cannot wait more. Ask again.
murim.bubble.guide_back.3: Back to my work. Call me again.
murim.bubble.guide_back.6: My post calls me. Ask again.
murim.bubble.guide_stuck.1: I cannot get through. Ask again.
murim.bubble.guide_stuck.4: The road is shut for me. Sorry.
dialogue.murim.arrival.opt.introduce: I came to join the sect. Take me in.
dialogue.murim.arrival.opt.noguide: I do not need a guide.
dialogue.murim.arrival.tour.resume: We did not finish the tour. Shall we go on from the beginning, or will you look around yourself?
murim.sect.arrival.guide_stuck: %s cannot get through and hands you on.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.opt.why: Why should I go to Mount Hua?
dialogue.murim.seo_han.opt.gain: And what would I get there?
dialogue.murim.seo_han.recruit.1: The Mount Hua Sect takes disciples. You are strong, but your qi sleeps — on the mountain they will wake it.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.recruit.2: Our sect looks for people with will. Come to the gate — you will be taken in, given a breathing method and a sword.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.recruit.3: Want to grow stronger? Mount Hua teaches the way of the sword and of cultivation. The gate opens for those who arrive.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.recruit.4: I see a fighter without a school. Mount Hua takes such people: the mentor will show you how to gather qi in the dantian.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.recruit.5: Alone in this world it is hard. On Mount Hua you will have a roof, food, teachers and sword brothers.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.recruit.6: The Mount Hua Sect gathers disciples again. Reach the gate and tell the gatekeeper you want to learn.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.gain.1: A breathing method to gather qi and a mentor who teaches meditation. Then the Six Elements Sword.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.gain.2: A bed in the dormitory, food, lessons and sparring. The harder you work, the faster your breakthroughs.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.gain.3: Plum blossom sword arts, pills and a place among your own. And nobody holds you: roam the world whenever you like.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.gain.4: Strength. Down here you are just a man. On the mountain you become a master, star by star.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.gain.5: Teachers who show what books do not say, and brothers to cross swords with.
dialogue.murim.seo_han.gain.6: A path. Qi, body, sword — all taught in order. And a warm bed, which is not nothing.
murim.clue.copy_broken: The copy was broken off. Start again, nothing is lost.
murim.clue.cache_scrap.title: Torn scrap
murim.clue.cache_scrap.text: Chung Myung rested in Dry Stream Cave, beyond the South Peak saddle. Look for the pale forked pine. A disciple later went there carrying a copy of the Twenty-Four Movements. He never returned.
murim.clue.belt_note.title: Note by the belt
murim.clue.belt_note.text: The passage is blocked. I can feel a draft above. I'll try climbing along the soot marks.
murim.clue.box_note.title: Note from the box
murim.clue.box_note.text: I found the campsite. I'm leaving the box here. The lower cleft leads outside; I won't return through the cave-in.
murim.clue.frag_0.title: Fragment: the order
murim.clue.frag_0.text: Rain - Full Bloom - scatter - river - sea. This is the order, not the missing transitions. These scraps preserve only Rainfall. The rest of the art is kept below the Main Hall.
murim.clue.frag_1.title: Fragment: rainfall
murim.clue.frag_1.text: A drawing of falling rain, strokes close together.
murim.clue.frag_2.title: Fragment: Full Bloom
murim.clue.frag_2.text: Roots hold firm. Let the sword-branch bloom toward one foe before the petals pass.
murim.clue.frag_3.title: Fragment: the scatter
murim.clue.frag_3.text: The centre remains. The edges spread like petals around a still branch.
murim.clue.frag_4.title: Fragment: the river
murim.clue.frag_4.text: What is scattered gathers into a current. Do not break the river with your final step.
murim.clue.frag_5.title: Fragment: the sea
murim.clue.frag_5.text: Five waves, each wider than the last. The last one has no shore.
murim.spot.scrap_room: Under the leg of the wobbly table a torn corner of paper sticks out. Beside it lies a second piece with a matching ragged edge. You take both.
murim.spot.belt_note: A rotten disciple's belt lies by the water. Under a stone beside it, a note.
murim.spot.cave_wall: Five waves are cut into the wall behind the old campsite. Copying them takes a few breaths.
murim.spot.cache_box: The old box opens with a creak: silver in a cloth, a pill in waxed paper, and two sheets of writing.
murim.spot.cache_box.empty: The box is empty now. You keep what it gave.
murim.spot.stele_base: The steps lead to what is now the side of the stele. The old mounts face another direction.
murim.spot.stele_front: To those who held the slope when others withdrew.
murim.spot.stele_back: On the back a faded diagram is cut into the stone. You begin a sketch.
murim.spot.stele_low: The bottom line: The continuation rests where the water flows.
murim.spot.stele_lid: A pale rectangular lid sits among the basin stones. Under it is a dry case with a sheet inside.
murim.spot.strike_mark: A fresh diagonal cut in the post. The blade passed where a man had just been standing.
murim.spot.strike_plate: The footprint leaves the line. The strike lands where you stood.
murim.spot.strike_plate_back: On the back of the plate a more complex diagram is cut. You begin a sketch.
murim.strike.start: Stand on the line. When I swing, step off it and strike the side target.
murim.strike.early: Too early. You moved before the swing, so I could turn. Let's try again.
murim.strike.late: Too slow. You stayed on the line. Let's try again.
murim.strike.success: There. You didn't run away; you left the strike an empty space.
murim.bubble.quest.cache_whisper: Chung Myung hid a box there...
murim.bubble.quest.strike_advice: Ask the mentor. He'll explain why.
dialogue.murim.quest.cache.opt.ask: Were you just talking about a cache?
dialogue.murim.quest.cache.doyun: I heard something there... Beyond the South Peak. Manseok brought back a scrap, then suddenly stopped talking about it.
dialogue.murim.quest.cache.doyun_interes: So you are interested after all?
dialogue.murim.quest.cache.opt.doyun: Doyun said you brought back a scrap from beyond the South Peak. Let me see it.
dialogue.murim.quest.cache.gives: ...Fine. I was hiding my own failed search. Here, take the scrap.
dialogue.murim.quest.cache.caught: Looking under the table? I thought it was a treasure map too. I reached the cave-in and turned back.
dialogue.murim.quest.cache.recall_talk: I'm glad I showed you the scrap after all.
dialogue.murim.quest.stele.show: They turned it when the trail was repaired. You found the side people stopped seeing.
dialogue.murim.quest.stele.thanks: Thank you. I will show your sketch to the pupils of the hall.
dialogue.murim.quest.stele.after: I went over your sketch with a pupil today. He had walked past that stone a hundred times and never looked behind it.
dialogue.murim.quest.strike.hook: Ask the mentor. He'll explain why the blade missed.
dialogue.murim.mentor.opt.strike_why: How do I practise the dummy drill?
dialogue.murim.quest.strike.explain: Eight hits on the training-yard dummy—with the Downward Strike of Six Elements. Select it and carry every strike through. Your tablet holds the count; leave and return, and it will still be there.
dialogue.murim.quest.strike.given_alone: You have completed the dummy drill. Here is the complete Falling Petal manual. Practise it; contracts and the travelling peddler can provide pages.
dialogue.murim.quest.strike.given_asked: You have completed the dummy drill. Here is the complete Falling Petal manual. Practise it; contracts and the travelling peddler can provide pages.
dialogue.murim.quest.strike.recall_alone: You know how to watch first.
dialogue.murim.quest.strike.recall_asked: Remember where we started: the shoulder.
quest.murim.cache.title: The legend of Chung Myung's cache
quest.murim.stele.title: The stone that looks the wrong way
quest.murim.strike.title: Ask the mentor. Or check yourself
quest.murim.fragments.title: Fragments of the Twenty-Four Movements
quest.murim.missing.title: Don't leave me here
murim.bubble.quest.missing_hook: Yul Jin's not back from the East Peak.
murim.spot.missing_basket: A basket on its side. Herbs scattered, bark torn, a strip of cloth on a branch.
murim.spot.rain_wall: A cave wall below the ledge. The falling rain is drawn as swords.
murim.scene.escape: He is under the shelter. They fall back.
murim.scene.retry: The attack breaks off. Try again when you are ready.
murim.quest.missing: You do not have all the items required to turn this in. Check the assignment requirements.
dialogue.murim.quest.missing.hook: Yul Jin took a basket to the East Peak. He should be back by now.
dialogue.murim.quest.missing.ask: Check the trail below the pavilion, east of the stele ledge. Do not go alone if you hear shouting.
dialogue.murim.quest.missing.hurt: Here! Below the pine! They thought I found silver. All I found was a drawing. My ankle gave out when I ran.
dialogue.murim.quest.missing.opt.cover: Get up. I will cover you.
dialogue.murim.quest.missing.fighting: I can reach the shelter. Do not let them flank us!
dialogue.murim.quest.missing.lead: They are gone. Help me down to Gyeong Cho.
dialogue.murim.quest.missing.opt.lead: Lean on me. Let us go.
dialogue.murim.quest.missing.healer: Alive, and the leg is still attached. You can both stop being heroes now.
dialogue.murim.quest.missing.thanks_foug: Good thing you stood between us and them. In the cave behind the pine, the rain is drawn as swords. I wanted to know why.
dialogue.murim.quest.missing.thanks_cove: You kept them in front of you all the way to the trail. In the cave behind the pine, the rain is drawn as swords. I wanted to know why.
quest.murim.debt.title: Twelve taels at the gate
murim.spot.debt_bill: A bill pinned to the cart: «Beams for the repair. Balance: 12 taels.»
murim.spot.debt_crate: A crate under the broken decking, a blue rope caught on a beam. The lid carries the supplier's seal.
murim.clue.crate_fittings.title: Sealed crate of fittings
murim.clue.crate_fittings.text: A small crate, the supplier's seal intact. Worth exactly twelve taels.
dialogue.murim.quest.debt.offer: Twelve taels remain for the beams. You can pay, or return the unopened crate of fittings. It is worth exactly the same amount.
dialogue.murim.quest.debt.where: Ask Mun. I only know it went through the decking in the yard of the storehouse.
dialogue.murim.quest.debt.closed: That's it. The bill is settled. Tell Mun I will bring the next delivery as agreed.
dialogue.murim.quest.debt.confirm: The debt is correct. We did not need the fittings, but the crate fell through the decking in the yard.
dialogue.murim.quest.debt.recall_paid: I remember how you settled things at the gate. Good thing it did not take three meetings.
dialogue.murim.quest.debt.recall_returne: You got the crate out from under the decking. I will mend the boards myself, no bill for you.
dialogue.murim.quest.debt.supplier_bye: The bill is settled. Mind the road.
npc.murim.supplier.title: Timber merchant
quest.murim.impostor.title: A borrowed badge
murim.spot.impostor_receipts: Three receipts from different days, all in the same hand, all from one trader. Beside them a paper with the Hua seal: «one-time help».
murim.spot.impostor_chest: The lid is open. Blank seals and three badges of other sects.
murim.spot.impostor_chest.sneak: You might be seen. Crouch and approach quietly to look inside the chest.
murim.clue.receipts.title: Three receipts
murim.clue.receipts.text: Three receipts for the same «protection», dated on three different days.
murim.clue.chest_badges.title: Badges from the chest
murim.clue.chest_badges.text: Three badges of other sects and blank seals, from the impostor's road chest.
dialogue.murim.quest.impostor.start: Mount Hua protects this road. Protection must be paid for.
dialogue.murim.quest.impostor.opt.receip: Then why does she hold three of your receipts from different days?
dialogue.murim.quest.impostor.opt.chest: How many sects do you represent? There are three more badges in your chest.
dialogue.murim.quest.impostor.first: This is my first collection. Anyone who complains simply does not want to pay.
dialogue.murim.quest.impostor.half: Take half. We will say you checked everything.
dialogue.murim.quest.impostor.opt.refuse: The money goes back to the people who paid it. All of it.
dialogue.murim.quest.impostor.fight: If you want the cashbox, try taking it.
dialogue.murim.quest.trader.greet: A man with a Hua badge takes money from all of us. I did not dare refuse.
dialogue.murim.quest.trader.settle: You have the cashbox? Let me check the receipts and hand the money back to its owners.
dialogue.murim.quest.trader.done: Everyone has their money back now. I will not take a badge at face value again. Here, three taels from the traders.
dialogue.murim.quest.trader.after_talk: You caught him in his own lies.
dialogue.murim.quest.trader.after_fight: He has not been back since that fight.
npc.murim.impostor.title: Man in a Hua badge
npc.murim.trader.title: Roadside trader
quest.murim.thief.title: Two empty sacks
murim.bubble.quest.thief_hook: Two sacks gone, and the door is whole.
murim.spot.shelf_nail: The cloth caught on a nail. Dry rice lies beneath the decking.
murim.spot.sok_parcel: A small parcel under the shed, tied for the road. A family letter inside.
murim.clue.torn_cloth.title: Torn sack cloth
murim.clue.torn_cloth.text: A scrap of sack cloth from the nail on the shelf. This sack tore by itself.
murim.clue.family_letter.title: Family letter
murim.clue.family_letter.text: «There are three days until the next wages. Send a little rice if you can.»
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.hook: Two small sacks are missing from the shelf. The door is intact.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.ask: Look around here before we start blaming anyone. Someone walked to the door, and another trail stops under the shelf.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.opt.ask: I will look at the shelf.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.opt.watch: I will watch from behind the partition.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.watching: Fine. Stay out of sight. Someone should come before long.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.sok: One. I took one sack. I will answer for that, but I do not have the other.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.sok_out: You followed me? All right. One sack, nothing more. My sister's family needed it.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.opt.sleeve: There is rice dust on your sleeve.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.no_two: Just the one. Do not make it two to settle the account.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.letter_line: Here, read it. Three days until wages.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.half: Only one sack came back. Look at the shelf again, and at the floor under it.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.resolve: You checked both sacks. Good. Now, how do we close this?
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.opt.self: Let us speak to Yul Seok. I have worked out what happened to the second sack. He can explain the first himself.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.opt.report: Yul Seok took one sack. The other tore on a nail.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.opt.quiet: The rice is back. I will not give a name. Here are three taels for a parcel to the family.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.closed_self: Good thing you checked both sacks. Otherwise one man would have answered for two different troubles. I will hear him out.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.closed_report: Thank you. I will speak to him alone. The family will get the same help.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.closed_quiet: Understood. I know the shortage and the help. I do not need the name.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.recall_self: I told him myself, and the family got a ration. Thank you for letting me speak first.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.recall_report: I wish I had told him myself.
dialogue.murim.quest.thief.recall_quiet: My family sent a letter. They are well. Thank you. I will not forget your help.
npc.murim.yul_jin.title: Third-generation disciple
murim.bubble.spar.half_c: Half already, and I am just warm.
murim.bubble.spar.last_a: One more touch and I bow.
murim.bubble.spar.last_c: One good strike and it is over.
dialogue.murim.ack.1: Oh, you really did it. Next: %s.
dialogue.murim.ack.2: I see you managed. Good. Now: %s.
dialogue.murim.ack.3: Not bad. That counts. Next step: %s.
murim.pill.burst: The flow overfilled the dantian and struck back: it nearly tore you apart. Health, qi and strength are lost.
murim.pill.standup: The pill is absorbed. You rise.
murim.meditation.ring_hint: Hold [%s] to tighten, release to widen. Keep the edge in the bright band. If it trembles, you strained: let go.
murim.loadout.six_volume_two: The second volume of the Six Elements (sub-techniques) is not open yet. For now the art lives only in the basic-sword slot.
murim.bubble.pilfer.food: Less food in the pantry. Strange.
murim.bubble.pilfer.room: Someone has searched the room chests.
murim.bubble.pilfer.scrolls: Missing sheets... who reads at night?
murim.bubble.pilfer.supplies: Stores are low. Has someone taken some?
murim.bubble.pilfer.medicine: Herbs are missing. Who has been here?
murim.bubble.quest.debt_hook: The supplier is at the gate again.
dialogue.murim.quest.debt.hook: The supplier is waiting at the gate with his cart again. He says the sect owes him for a crate. You heard it, so go and sort it out.
dialogue.murim.quest.debt.opt.hook: I will go to the gate.
murim.bubble.quest.impostor_hook: Extortion in Mount Hua’s name, outside!
dialogue.murim.quest.impostor.hook: The trader outside the gate says a man wearing a Mount Hua badge is demanding money from her. Speak to her at her stall. Find out what happened first.
dialogue.murim.quest.impostor.opt.hook: I will see who it is.
murim.bubble.senior_affairs.4: We shall discuss it after tea.
murim.bubble.senior_affairs.5: There is time before the review.
murim.bubble.owner_visit.3: We need quiet here for now.
murim.bubble.owner_visit.6: I shall come out to meet you.
murim.bubble.herb_work.4: I will take the bag to the yard.
murim.bubble.herb_work.6: Let the infusion cool a little.
murim.bubble.council_news.1: A new elder joins our table.
murim.bubble.council_news.4: Good news for the whole sect.
murim.bubble.council_news.5: The sect has a new senior.
murim.bubble.council_news.6: May the new office serve well.
murim.bubble.council_review.6: The next review will be harder.
murim.bubble.staff_delivery.3: Thank you. I will take it.
murim.bubble.staff_water.2: I will fill one more vat.
murim.bubble.kitchen_cycle.5: I will save a late portion.
murim.bubble.kitchen_cycle.6: Time for us to eat as well.
murim.bubble.cleaning_cycle.2: Just this pile left to clear.
murim.bubble.cleaning_cycle.4: I will wait until the bout ends.
murim.bubble.night_awake.5: I will return to rest soon.
murim.bubble.struck_response.3: Let us keep our hands down.
murim.bubble.struck_response.5: This is no place for that.
murim.bubble.struck_response.6: I will step back a little.
murim.bubble.animal_concern.4: They are no opponents of yours.
murim.bubble.peer_whisper.1: Seems to be looking for someone.
murim.bubble.peer_whisper.2: Been in the yard a while.
murim.bubble.peer_whisper.4: Looks like they want to watch.
murim.bubble.peer_whisper.6: We can ask after the lesson.
advancement.murim.root.title: Mount Hua
advancement.murim.root.desc: The road begins at the foot of the mountain, where the plum blooms.
advancement.murim.join.title: Disciple of Hua
advancement.murim.first_feeling.title: First Breath
advancement.murim.first_feeling.desc: Feel qi for the first time in meditation.
advancement.murim.six_elements.title: Six Elements Sword
advancement.murim.stars_12.title: Twelve Stars
advancement.murim.stars_12.desc: Take any art to its limit.
advancement.murim.rank_third.title: Third Rank
advancement.murim.rank_second.title: Second Rank
advancement.murim.rank_second.desc: Break through to the second rank.
advancement.murim.rank_first.title: First Rank
advancement.murim.rank_peak.title: Peak
advancement.murim.camp_cleared.title: The Nest Is Burned
advancement.murim.boss.title: Master of the Fortress
advancement.murim.all_quests.title: All in Order
advancement.murim.all_quests.desc: Finish every errand on the mountain.
advancement.murim.spar_lost_sweeper.desc: Lose a spar to the sweeper.
advancement.murim.sticky_fingers.title: Sticky Fingers
advancement.murim.sticky_fingers.desc: Take something out of a sect chest or storeroom.
dialogue.murim.intro.1: Sit. We begin with the dantian, the inner store of qi. Yours has not formed yet. First you will learn to breathe and hold qi. The sword can wait.
dialogue.murim.intro.2: Internal techniques need qi. Outer sword forms work without it. Meditation replenishes your reserve. To break through, you must gather enough qi and meet the next rank’s requirements.
dialogue.murim.intro.3: You will start with the Six Elements Sword. Once you know it, we will move on to Falling Petal, then Seven Plum Blossoms.
dialogue.murim.intro.4: Sit and focus on your breathing. Once you feel qi, hold it steady and gather it into a dantian seed.
dialogue.murim.intro.5: Ask me for a breathing manual and study it. Then try meditating. If you get stuck, we will work through it together.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.greet.1: Stranger? Heading for a sect? Ours is the one over there: Mount Hua.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.greet.2: You walk like a man who wants a teacher. Come to Mount Hua, we have room.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.greet.3: Hey, traveller! The mountain is taking disciples. Interested?
dialogue.murim.recruiter.greet.4: A sword on your hip and no master? Mount Hua can fix the second part.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.greet.5: Well met. I hail from Mount Hua; we are always short of good hands.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.greet.6: You there! Looking for a sect? Ours is not far.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.who.1: I walk the roads for Mount Hua and ask every honest traveller one thing: do you want to learn?
dialogue.murim.recruiter.who.2: A disciple of the second generation. The elders send us to fetch people with a spark.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.who.3: Just a messenger of the plum. The sect is poor, the food is plain, the sword is true.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.who.4: Call me a recruiter. Nobody climbs our mountain unless somebody tells them it exists.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.who.5: I wear the plum of Mount Hua. The gate opens for those who knock, you know.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.who.6: One of the people who still believe the mountain needs new blood.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.point.1: It is there, past those hills. Keep the mist ahead of you and do not turn aside.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.point.2: That way. When white cliffs rise out of the haze, you have arrived.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.point.3: See where the clouds sit low? Under them lies Mount Hua. Go straight.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.point.4: Over there, friend. A long walk, but the road ends at our gate.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.point.5: Follow my hand. The mountain is bigger than it looks, you will not miss it.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.point.6: That direction. If your legs hold, you will be at the foot by the next dusk or two.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.bye.1: Go on, then. Knock at the gate and say a wanderer sent you.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.bye.2: Safe road. We will be glad to see you under the plums.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.bye.3: Do not dawdle. Rice is cheap on the mountain, a place in the rows is not.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.bye.4: Walk well. The mentor does not like to be kept waiting.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.bye.5: May the wind carry you to us.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.bye.6: Good. Tell them at the gate that you came on your own feet.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.member.1: Brother, you are already ours. Why stand about on the road?
dialogue.murim.recruiter.member.2: A fellow disciple! Go home, the mountain misses you.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.member.3: Ha, a plum on a plum. Walk well, brother.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.member.4: You wear our robe? Then you know the way better than I.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.member.5: Greetings, brother. Do not be late for formation.
dialogue.murim.recruiter.member.6: One of ours already. Then my work here is done.
murim.bubble.wander_recruit.2: Heading for a sect? That way!
murim.bubble.wander_recruit.6: Looking for a teacher? Follow me.
npc.murim.mok_rin.title: Wandering Disciple of Mount Hua
npc.murim.hwang_sol.title: Wandering Disciple of Mount Hua
npc.murim.jang_cheol.title: Wandering Disciple of Mount Hua
murim.meditation.hint.feel: Sit still and breathe. Moving or a blow breaks it. Crouch ([%s]) to stand up.
method.murim.purple_sky_qi.cost: Given by an elder to a trusted first-rank disciple. Quicker, purer, a wider reserve. Nature: pure. Cultivation speed ×2.5 → ×4.5, grows with stars.
method.murim.purple_sky_divine.cost: The head's own method. It is given to no one; it lies in the main vault. Nature: pure. Cultivation speed ×5 → ×15, grows with stars.
dialogue.murim.progression.opt.purple: Ask about the Purple Sky breathing
dialogue.murim.progression.purple_done: Take it. Purple Sky Enhanced Qi is not for every disciple. You earned our trust, so keep it close and do not show it to outsiders.
murim.bubble.progression.purple: Breathe. Let the sky colour your qi.
murim.sect.war.warn.0: Hands off! Is that a challenge?
murim.sect.war.warn.1: Watch yourself, stranger. I will not warn twice.
murim.sect.war.warn.2: That was a blow. Do it again and the mountain answers.
murim.sect.war.cry.0: He struck one of us! To arms!
murim.sect.war.cry.1: The mountain is attacked! Stop him!
murim.sect.war.cry.2: Blood on Hua soil. You will answer for it.
murim.sect.war.elder.0: Enough. I will end this myself.
murim.sect.war.elder.1: You chose this. Now bear it.
murim.sect.war.head.0: Who raises a hand on my mountain? Come, then.
murim.sect.war.head.1: Thirty years I have kept this peace. You broke it.
murim.sect.war.flee.2: I am only a servant, spare me!
murim.sect.war.bell.0: Ring the bell! Raise the mountain!
murim.sect.war.messenger.other.0: I have nothing to say to you.
murim.sect.war.messenger.other.1: This word is not for you.
murim.sect.war.warning: %s recoils: the next blow will be answered by the whole sect.
murim.sect.war.declared.elder: You raised a hand on an elder. The bell rings: the whole mountain turns against you, and the gate is shut. You are no longer one of them.
murim.sect.war.declared.other: Blood has been spilled. The bell rings: the whole mountain turns against you, and the gate is shut. You are no longer one of them.
murim.sect.war.head_fell: The head of Mount Hua has fallen. The mountain will never forgive this: there is no atonement.
murim.sect.war.messenger: A messenger waits outside the gate. Perhaps the mountain is ready to speak.
murim.sect.war.terms: The messenger: "The mountain may forgive, for %s silver taels and a penance in the cave. You return as the lowest of the low. Speak to me again if you agree."
murim.sect.war.poor: You need %s silver taels for peace.
murim.sect.war.peace: The war is over. The mountain takes you back at the very bottom: your name is marked with a scar, and the penance cave awaits.
murim.sect.war.pardon: The war is over. The mountain forgives you, but you are still a stranger here.
dialogue.murim.head_intro.greet: Come in. Stand easy; the hall is only a room. So you are the one the gate sent up.
dialogue.murim.head_intro.name: Your name is on the disciple roster. Now get to know your instructor and the others.
dialogue.murim.head_intro.opt.remember: I will honour it, Sect Leader.
dialogue.murim.head_intro.advice: Find Gyeong Pil first. He will teach you the basics and help you with your first lesson.
dialogue.murim.head_intro.farewell: That is all. Go back to your lessons. If you need me, ask your instructor where to find me.
murim.sect.head_intro.done: You are presented to the head. The register has your name.
murim.sect.head_intro.absent: The head is not at his seat. You will be presented at the morning formation instead.
item.murim.pill_fasting.desc: Fills hunger and keeps you fed.
item.murim.pill_antidote.desc: Cures poison; halves new poison for 3 minutes.
item.murim.pill_blood_replenishing.desc: Heals seven hearts and grants regeneration.
murim.pill.antidote.ward: Poison will burn half as long for a while.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_cho.pills_more: Plain medicines for the road and the training yard. You have %s merit left.
item.murim.int_pill_box.desc: One pill kind, up to 64. Use to select; sneak-use a placed box to move its lid.
murim.vault.rite.step: A tablet gives a little under your hand (%s of 4)
murim.vault.rite.silent: The tablets are silent. The lock has been changed
murim.vault.witness.shout: Who is touching the ancestors' tablets?!
murim.vault.witness.caught: %s saw you at the tablets. The sect changes the lock; the way will not answer for a day.
murim.plum.restored: A lost form returns from the fragments: %s (up to %s stars)
quest.murim.vault.title: The head's vault
murim.spot.ancestors_verse: A memorial stone stands beside the shrine, old characters cut into it. You read them.
murim.clue.vault_verse.title: The founders' rite
murim.clue.vault_verse.text: Honour the first ancestors before the rest, and honour them as the sect stands: the right hand first, then the left. Facing the shrine, touch the tablet nearest it on the right, then the tablet nearest it on the left, then the next on the right, then the next on the left. What the sect cannot open, the mountain keeps behind its ancestors.
murim.clue.green_forest_page.title: A page taken by the Green Forest
murim.clue.green_forest_page.text: The creased page lists old hiding places for the fragments. Another hand has added: “The sheets are back in the sect: two at the gate, two in the Hall of Scriptures, one in the training yard and one in the dining hall. Together they restore only Rainfall, up to five stars. The complete art remains in the vault.”
murim.clue.fortress_page.title: A page from a merchant's notebook
murim.clue.fortress_page.text: Heard at the Hua gate: the head's vault door is carved with the Twenty-Four Movements, and the sect can no longer open it, because the art is lost. Honour the first ancestors before the rest, and honour them as the sect stands: the right hand first, then the left. Facing the shrine, touch the tablet nearest it on the right, then the tablet nearest it on the left, then the next on the right, then the next on the left. What the sect cannot open, the mountain keeps behind its ancestors.

quest.murim.trials.title: Bouts with a condition
dialogue.murim.trial.menu: A rule makes a bout worth something. Win by the rule and the sect remembers it; break the rule and nothing is lost, you may ask again.
dialogue.murim.trial.opt.six_only: With the Six Elements Sword alone
dialogue.murim.trial.clean.rule: Not one of my blows may touch you. A block that still leaves a wound is a touch. Win like that and you have shown a guard, not luck. The ring, a minute at most. A win pays 3 merit and some practice of the Six Elements Sword.
dialogue.murim.trial.six_only.rule: The old way: no technique, no footwork, only the Six Elements Sword in your hand. Take the art as your foundation and a sword in hand first, or the bout does not count. Win by its forms alone. A win pays 2 merit and practice of the Six Elements Sword.
dialogue.murim.trial.parry.rule: Guard with the sword and meet my strike as it comes down: press the guard just as the blade lands, or right after your own swing. Steel rings on steel, and I reel. A plain block does not count. Parry one strike and win the bout. A win pays 4 merit.
dialogue.murim.trial.swift.rule: Forty seconds from the first blow, not one more. A bout that drags is a bout that tires you. Win before the time is out. A win pays 3 merit and some practice of the Six Elements Sword.
murim.trial.clean.title: A clean bout
murim.trial.six_only.title: The Six Elements alone
murim.trial.parry.title: A parried strike
murim.trial.swift.title: Forty seconds
murim.trial.short.no_hits: win without taking a single blow
murim.trial.short.six_only: win with the Six Elements Sword alone: no technique, no footwork
murim.trial.short.parry: parry at least %s strike(s) with the sword guard, then win
murim.trial.short.time: win within %s seconds of the fight
murim.trial.touched: Touched. The trial is lost; the bout goes on as practice.
murim.trial.cast: A technique. The trial is lost; the bout goes on as practice.
murim.trial.fail.lost: «%s» is not passed: you lost the bout. Ask again whenever you like.
murim.trial.fail.no_hits: You won, but you were touched. The trial is not passed; ask again.
murim.trial.fail.six_only: You won, but you used a technique or a step. The trial is not passed; ask again.
murim.trial.fail.parry: You won, but without a parry. The trial is not passed; ask again.
murim.trial.fail.time: The time is out. The trial is not passed; ask again.
murim.trial.six_needed: Take the Six Elements Sword as your foundation and a sword in hand, then ask again.
murim.trial.no_ring: Such bouts are held on the training square. Stand in a free ring and ask again.
command.murim.dev.group.spar: spar - stage a bout: a person in front of you, the first ring, a trial with a condition
command.murim.dev.help.spar:

murim.sect.head_scene.line1: Come in. Stand easy. You have reached Mount Hua.
murim.sect.head_scene.line2: Your name is in the disciple register. Have you met your instructor yet?
murim.sect.head_scene.line3: Listen to your instructor and practise the basics. Mount Hua needs disciples it can rely on.
murim.sect.head_scene.line4: Go to Gyeong Pil. Ask him if you need help.
command.murim.dev.group.head: head - stage the head introduction
command.murim.dev.help.head: /murim dev head intro - reset to a fresh member at the Main Hall and start the head cutscene.
command.murim.head.no_hall: No Main Hall layout in this world.
command.murim.head.busy: The mentor or head is busy. End their combat or conversation first.
dialogue.murim.general.where.here: You are speaking to me. Your next step: %1$s. %2$s
murim.sect.head_intro.here: Here he is — our sect head.
murim.sect.exam.missing.strike: Land eight Six Elements Downward Cuts on a training-yard dummy. Select the Downward Cut technique and let each strike connect. Your tablet records the count; you may leave and return.
murim.sect.journey.blocker.strike: Land eight Six Elements Downward Cuts on a training-yard dummy. Select the Downward Cut technique and let each strike connect. Your tablet records the count; you may leave and return.
murim.sect.exam.missing.take_six: Accept the Six Elements lesson from me first.
murim.sect.exam.missing.book: Learn Six Elements from the manual.
murim.sect.exam.missing.practice: Raise Six Elements to two stars.
dialogue.murim.general.matters: What matter do you wish to discuss?
dialogue.murim.general.talk: Speak. I have a moment to listen.
dialogue.murim.general.self.mentor: I oversee the foundation lessons. Ask me about your next assessment.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.mentor: Bring questions about your assessment to me before practice.
dialogue.murim.general.self.leader: I am responsible for the sect. Bring matters that require a decision.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.leader: The sect depends on each person doing their duty.
dialogue.murim.general.self.gatekeeper: I keep the gate. State your business before entering.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.gatekeeper: Report unusual visitors to the watch.
dialogue.murim.general.self.senior: I supervise practice. Keep your stance steady.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.senior: Ask your partner before beginning a bout.
dialogue.murim.general.self.disciple_a: I am still learning. The morning drills show me my faults.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.disciple_a: I would rather correct my footwork than repeat hearsay.
dialogue.murim.general.self.disciple_b: I practise with the juniors. We correct each other carefully.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.disciple_b: Our practice partners have been helping us correct our stances.
dialogue.murim.general.self.elder: I advise the disciples. A sound foundation takes patience.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.elder: Judge reports carefully before passing them on.
dialogue.murim.general.self.second: I help the juniors prepare for assessment.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.second: The younger disciples may need a practice partner.
dialogue.murim.general.self.disciple: I train here each day. There is much left to learn.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.disciple: I have no reliable news beyond the training yard.
dialogue.murim.general.self.guard: I guard these grounds. Keep the passages clear.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.guard: If you see trouble on the paths, report it to the watch.
dialogue.murim.general.self.steward: I keep the accounts and stores. Report any shortage.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.steward: Report missing supplies before the next distribution.
dialogue.murim.general.self.cook: I prepare the meals. Leave the bowls in order.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.cook: Tell the kitchen if a disciple cannot come for a meal.
dialogue.murim.general.self.porter: I carry the supplies. Please leave room on the steps.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.porter: Keep the steps clear for those carrying supplies.
dialogue.murim.general.self.gardener: I tend the trees. Take care near the young roots.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.gardener: Please leave fallen branches beside the path.
dialogue.murim.general.self.sweeper: I keep the courtyards clean. Leave the paths clear.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.sweeper: A clear courtyard is safer for practice.
dialogue.murim.general.self.water_carrie: I bring water to the households. Please return empty vessels.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.water_carr: Keep drinking vessels separate from wash water.
dialogue.murim.general.self.first: I answer for the disciples. Bring concerns to me before they grow.
dialogue.murim.general.rumour.first: Bring disputes to a senior before drawing swords.
dialogue.murim.head_intro.offer: I will take you to the head and introduce you. Will you follow me?
murim.bubble.office.ledger: Elder Tae Gyun, the ledger is ready.
murim.bubble.office.boxes: I’ll stow these and get the receipts.

murim.vault.head_note.title: A Torn Page
murim.vault.head_note.page_1: ...Went down again today. Facing the altar, I touched the tablets as the founders' rite asks: the near one on the right, the near one on the left, then the next pair, right and left. The floor by the altar opened, as always.
murim.clue.vault_archive.title: A treasury ledger
murim.clue.vault_archive.text: I have sealed grain accounts, medicine records and our oldest manuals together. Gold may buy another roof; only these teachings can raise Mount Hua again. Let no successor mistake the reserve for an ornament.
murim.vault.head_note.page_2: The iron door is silent again. My master said one form of the lost Twenty-Four Movements wakes it. The scraps preserve Rainfall; the complete art waits beyond the door below the Main Hall.

technique.murim.six_harmonies_strike.wea: A raised blade shows the shoulders before it falls.
book.murim.six_harmonies_strike: Set the feet firmly and raise the blade over the shoulder. Let the front leg receive the weight as the sword falls.
technique.murim.six_harmonies_chain: Six Elements Sword: Chain of Basics
technique.murim.six_harmonies_chain.weak: Each step must carry the next cut.
book.murim.six_harmonies_chain: Join the thrust to a horizontal cut, a diagonal, another horizontal and the overhead. Five strokes must share one breath, while the feet remain firm.
technique.murim.six_harmonies_wave.weakn: Stone stops the edge before flesh.
book.murim.six_harmonies_wave: Draw the sword low and send its edge forward with a broad rising cut. The wave travels only a short way; a stone wall admits no blade.
technique.murim.six_harmonies_fear.weakn: The still stare gives away the coming cut.
book.murim.six_harmonies_fear: Lower the sword and meet the foe with a still gaze. When his resolve falters, carry one vertical cut through the opening.
technique.murim.six_harmonies_counter.we: An unanswered stance leaves the sword waiting.
book.murim.six_harmonies_counter: Wait with the sword across the body. Let the foe strike the place you have left, then answer with the weight of the whole body.

dialogue.murim.red_vein.hook: I am choosing herbs for an old wound. Have a moment?
dialogue.murim.red_vein.explain: For Tae Seong. One Red Vein Fern and two Silver Vein Mugwort, all a hundred years old. Shears preserve the roots. Keep older herbs. Previously gathered samples are fine. I will prepare Mending myself; raw fern cannot treat the wound.
dialogue.murim.red_vein.opt.herbarium: Show me how to recognise them.
dialogue.murim.red_vein.herbarium: The herbarium shows a red vein inside the short fern branches and a white stripe on narrow mugwort leaves. Look for fern in a dark wet recess near water by the lower West Peak path, and mugwort in a bright forest clearing. Look steadily at a still trace to keep a tablet note.
dialogue.murim.red_vein.opt.hand_in: Hand over one fern and two mugwort.
dialogue.murim.red_vein.opt.alternative: What if the patch is empty?
dialogue.murim.red_vein.alternative: Another damp cave near water will do; try another bright clearing for mugwort. You can return after regrowth. If you prefer, I have one practice set for a silver tael. Buying it will not count as a wild herbarium discovery.
dialogue.murim.red_vein.opt.buy: Buy one set for one silver tael.
dialogue.murim.red_vein.done: Tae Seong’s medicine is ready; I will keep it for him. You have earned two merit and a Mending Pill in the chest beside the alchemist’s house. Each person has their own remainder there. You can ask the elder about his wound later.
dialogue.murim.red_vein.elder: Gyeong Cho brought the medicine. Damp weather bothers the old wound, but it is easier now. Thank you for your care.
murim.red_vein.request: Bring Gyeong Cho one Red Vein Fern and two Silver Vein Mugwort plants for Tae Seong’s medicine. Each must be a hundred years old. Look for fern in a damp cave near water and mugwort in a bright forest clearing. Speak to the healer to hand them over. There is no deadline.
murim.red_vein.done: Gyeong Cho has prepared Tae Seong’s medicine. You earned 2 merit. Collect your Mending Pill from the chest beside the alchemist’s house.
murim.red_vein.elder: Tae Seong received the medicine. No further delivery is needed.
murim.observation.red_vein_niche: Observation: the fern has a red vein within its short branches. The damp recess near water suits it.
murim.observation.red_vein_mugwort: Observation: a white stripe runs along the narrow mugwort leaves. The plant stands in the light.

dialogue.murim.second_strike.explain: Do not start the second strike before your opponent’s. Hold the pause, parry, then land a reply. We can try in an ordinary ring. You need not win. If it does not work, come back for the advice.
dialogue.murim.second_strike.opt.practic: Let us try in the ring.
dialogue.murim.second_strike.opt.review: I held the pause and replied.
dialogue.murim.second_strike.done: Your body remembers the pause now. Keep honing the basics. My advice adds to their existing reserve; if you have reached the limit, it will not move it.
murim.lesson.second_strike.advice: Gyeong Pil: in a practice bout, wait for an attack, parry it, then land a counterstrike. You do not need to win.
murim.lesson.second_strike.practiced: In practice I parried my partner’s strike and landed a reply after defending. I can return to the mentor.
murim.lesson.second_strike.reward: Lesson complete: help worth 10% of the next Six Elements star through the shared help reserve. No merit.
murim.lesson.second_strike.cap: Review complete. The help reserve or foundation limit is already reached: advice remains, with no further payment.

dialogue.murim.changed_breath.opt.try: I will try in the usual way.

murim.threshold.changed_breath.invitatio: Your breathing has changed. Come and see me.
murim.threshold.changed_breath.ready: The mentor checked: the actual threshold requirements are met. There is no need to rush.
murim.threshold.changed_breath.try: I chose to try. A breakthrough will follow the ordinary meditation path when I begin it myself.
murim.threshold.changed_breath.prepare: I chose to prepare. Advice does not raise my rank or replace its requirements.
murim.threshold.changed_breath.later: I postponed the attempt. I can return to the conversation without a deadline.
murim.threshold.changed_breath.meditated: After the mentor’s advice I began meditation. This is not yet a breakthrough.
murim.threshold.changed_breath.advanced: An actual advancement followed the advice. The advice gives no additional reward.

murim.cave.chungmyung.note:
Oh, you found my spot.

Got thrown out of the morning meeting again. Fine. The errand can wait, and my head is still pounding from last night. I'll sit here until it passes.

Don't touch the pills in the box. Or the wine.

Chung Myung

dialogue.murim.fragments.sources: You may read the fragments kept in the sect’s chests. The gate depot holds two sheets brought back from the dry stream; the scripture room holds two ancestor rubbings. One sheet is in the training-yard chest, another in the dining-room chest. Take them when you wish. They restore Rainfall alone, toward the middle layers; the full art remains in the vault.

dialogue.murim.mentor.next.done.seven_st: %s: Settle Weight Shift before your sword stroke; stop Chasing Step within reach and continue with Falling Petal.
dialogue.murim.mentor.opt.seven_stars: Teach me the Seven Stars Steps.
dialogue.murim.mentor.seven_stars_given: Third rank, and still your feet chase your sword. Take this book. Weight Shift sets your feet for Six Elements Sword; Chasing Step brings your blade within reach. Stop before his body. Read, then show me. Dark Fragrance can wait.
book.murim.style.seven_stars: Mount Hua teaches Seven Stars before Dark Fragrance. Three forms share one book and mastery. %3$s readies the art, %2$s selects a form, %1$s uses it. Weight Shift answers the enemy’s swing. Chasing Step: he backs off after your hit — you are on him again. At ★8, Seven Stars Dipper circles one foe with seven basic sword strikes; another enemy’s hit breaks the pressure.
technique.murim.seven_stars_shift.weakne: Two ticks to prepare; keep room to settle your feet.
book.murim.seven_stars_shift: Direction + %1$s. A short grounded step: 2 ticks to prepare, 4 to move, 6 to settle. Step within 8 ticks of a Mount Hua sword hit or finish to cancel recovery; begin the next Six Elements, Falling Petal or Seven Plum form within 10 ticks for a 30%% shorter wind-up. Shift after an enemy begins swinging and at most 6 ticks before melee contact to evade one hit. For 10 ticks, your next Six Elements form starts instantly and deals 20%% more damage.
technique.murim.seven_stars_follow.weakn: Pursuit needs a foe backing off after your hit; otherwise a short forward step.
book.murim.seven_stars_follow: %1$s (select with %2$s). He backs off — you are on him again. Within 2 seconds of your hit, chase a foe moving away 3–6 blocks ahead and stop at sword reach. Otherwise take a short forward step. Link within 8 ticks of a Hua sword hit or finish; your next Hua sword form within 10 ticks starts without wind-up.
item.murim.pill_plum_blossom.desc: Clears weakness and slowness after qi backlash, Tipsy and Hangover. Grants no qi.
item.murim.pill_plum_blossom.origin: Mount Hua · Return of Mount Hua, chapters 39–41.
dialogue.murim.gyeong_cho.plum_blossom: Here, for your meridians. Old Mount Hua used these for hangovers. Rest first; drinking can wait.
murim.bubble.blade_exam.call: %s. Into the ring. Three breaths. Let everyone watch.
murim.bubble.blade_exam.enter: Stand in the middle. Keep your feet planted. Three breaths beneath the blade.
murim.bubble.blade_exam.pass: So. You have met the edge of death. Let your first strike carry that resolve.
murim.bubble.blade_exam.fail: Your feet answered before your will. Enough for today.
murim.bubble.blade_exam.decline: Another day, then. The ring will still be here.
murim.bubble.blade_exam.reaction_1: He stopped it right at the forehead…
murim.bubble.blade_exam.reaction_2: Three breaths? I forgot to take even one.
dialogue.murim.mentor.opt.blade_exam: I will stand beneath your blade.
effect.murim.tipsy.description: Wine courage: +5% attack and incoming damage per level. Strong wine makes your steps unsteady.
effect.murim.hangover.description: Slowness I and Mining Fatigue I for two minutes. A Plum Blossom Pill cures this.
book.murim.twenty_four_plum_full_bloom: Roots sink deep; the sword becomes a branch. Hold to press one foe back with red blossoms; release for one heavy pass over the ground they reached.
book.murim.twenty_four_plum_full_bloom.f: Roots went deep, a stem rose firmly, and a branch spread toward the opponent. Hold %1$s with the sword pointing at one foe: a narrow front of red blossoms grows forward, steadily pressing him back. His projectiles, waves and rushes spend its reserve. A strong enough technique breaks the front; a broken front has no final strike. Release %1$s and petals pass once through the area already reached, then vanish together. The master cannot walk while holding the form; another foe can flank him.
technique.murim.dark_fragrance_rising.we: R on the ground: soar 3–8 blocks. A ceiling cuts the ascent.
book.murim.dark_fragrance_rising: %1$s on the ground: soar 3–8 blocks. A ceiling cuts the ascent.
dialogue.murim.mentor.practice.dark_frag: Rise from firm ground; leave room overhead, for a low ceiling stops the ascent.

book.murim.dark_fragrance_floating: %1$s in the air toggles a descending glide for 2–10 seconds; 2 qi/s. Attacks and landing end it.
dialogue.murim.mentor.practice.dark_frag: Catch the air as you fall, and release it when you wish to descend freely. Gliding consumes qi; striking or touching ground ends it.
technique.murim.dark_fragrance_rain.weak: R: automatically dodge 2–10 incoming hits over 1 second. Explosions and environmental damage still hit.
book.murim.dark_fragrance_rain: %1$s: automatically dodge 2–10 incoming hits over 1 second. Explosions and environmental damage still hit.
dialogue.murim.mentor.practice.dark_frag: Let your footwork carry you clear of a brief flurry. It cannot shelter you from fire, falling stone or an explosion.

book.murim.true_six_elements_sword: Mount Hua taught this simplified replacement before Chung Myung returned. The cuts come quickly and are easy to repeat. But shortcuts cannot lay the Six Elements foundation: a light cut, slow mastery, and no further forms await the reader.

book.murim.taiyi_sword: Taiyi Flummox Sword belonged to the old training curriculum that Mount Hua abandoned. Raise the sword and bring it down. The heavy overhead leaves a long recovery; one discarded exercise cannot match the true Hua arts.
technique.murim.taiyi_sword.description: Taiyi Flummox Sword belonged to the old training curriculum that Mount Hua abandoned. Raise the sword and bring it down. The heavy overhead leaves a long recovery; one discarded exercise cannot match the true Hua arts.
technique.murim.taiyi_sword.weakness: Sword required. One overhead cut, then a long recovery. Weak damage and slower mastery than the real Six Elements Sword.

murim.vault.cheongmun.title: Cheongmun’s letter
murim.vault.cheongmun.text:
To whoever opened the vault.

If you are reading this, Mount Hua still stands. We leave tomorrow, and not all of us will come back.

Everything we had is here, from the Six Elements to the Twenty-Four Plum Blossoms. Take what you can bear. A plum does not bloom faster for being rushed.

The youngest grumbles again that books are for those who cannot hold a sword. Let him grumble. When he comes back, he will come here for them himself.

Cheongmun
technique.murim.seven_stars_dipper: Seven Stars Steps: Seven Stars Dipper
technique.murim.seven_stars_dipper.weakn: Requires ★8 and a Hua sword basic. Another enemy’s hit breaks the pressure; blocked points are skipped.
book.murim.seven_stars_dipper: At ★8, select with %2$s and press %1$s with one foe within 4 blocks. Seven grounded step-strikes over 1.4 seconds use your Six Elements or Seven Plum basic sword style. Pressure roots the foe, who can still attack. Blocked points are skipped. Another enemy hitting you interrupts the form. Costs 4 qi; cooldown 20 seconds.
dialogue.murim.bamboo_hand.ask: Teach me the Bamboo Leaf Hand.
dialogue.murim.bamboo_hand.given: The sword stays sheathed. First learn to turn strength aside; then learn to stop it. Here is a complete copy of the restored manual.
technique.murim.bamboo_leaf_hand.descrip: Empty main hand. Time %1$s with a frontal melee or palm-qi hit; A/D chooses the redirect side. A nearby enemy takes the blow; otherwise it cracks the ground.
technique.murim.bamboo_leaf_hand.weaknes: Requires an empty main hand and a precise opening.
technique.murim.bamboo_iron_wall.descrip: Empty main hand. Time %1$s with a frontal melee hit to stop it and stun the attacker. Costs more qi; cannot stop projectiles.
technique.murim.bamboo_iron_wall.weaknes: Requires an empty main hand and a precise opening.
technique.murim.bamboo_sword_fingers.des: Empty main hand. Touch one enemy within 2.5 blocks: collapses a charging technique or a sustained Tang thread. Otherwise deals only light damage.
technique.murim.bamboo_sword_fingers.wea: Requires an empty main hand and a precise opening.
technique.murim.bamboo_bending.descripti: Empty main hand. Sidestep an enemy rushing towards you and throw them past you, knocking them down. Slow enemies are unaffected.
technique.murim.bamboo_bending.weakness: Requires an empty main hand and a precise opening.
technique.murim.bamboo_wind_leaf.descrip: Empty main hand. Hold %1$s for up to one second to catch and return incoming arrows, Tang daggers or tridents. One catch at star 7, two at 10, three at 12.
technique.murim.bamboo_wind_leaf.weaknes: Requires an empty main hand and a precise opening.
technique.murim.bamboo_rustling_grove.de: Empty main hand. Six pressure-point jabs in 0.6 seconds weaken one enemy’s attack by 30% for six seconds. Ordinary mobs may drop their held weapon.
technique.murim.bamboo_rustling_grove.we: Requires an empty main hand and a precise opening.
dialogue.murim.mentor.practice.bamboo_le: Time the turning touch against a frontal blow.
dialogue.murim.mentor.practice.bamboo_ir: Meet the blow without reaching after it.
dialogue.murim.mentor.practice.bamboo_sw: Touch the charging hand before the technique is released.
dialogue.murim.mentor.practice.bamboo_be: Step aside only when the enemy commits to the rush.
dialogue.murim.mentor.practice.bamboo_wi: Catch an approaching weapon and return it along its path.
dialogue.murim.mentor.practice.bamboo_ru: Keep each pressure-point jab light and precise.
dialogue.murim.mentor.next.done.bamboo_l: %s: Practice turning, stopping and returning force with an empty hand.

dialogue.murim.mentor.six_progress.unrea: Read the Six Elements manual first. A sword in the hand cannot replace understanding.
dialogue.murim.mentor.six_progress.begin: Your Six Elements are taking root. Let each form settle before you hurry to the next.
dialogue.murim.mentor.six_progress.middl: Your Six Elements have grown steady. Work on joining the forms without losing your balance.
dialogue.murim.mentor.six_progress.settl: Your Six Elements are close to maturity. The remaining flaws show themselves in a bout and in quiet reflection.
dialogue.murim.mentor.six_progress.compl: Your Six Elements are complete. Keep their foundation alive while you study the arts that follow.
